title: Security Relief Supervisor
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to become an integral member of the Infront Security Operations Team. This is a casual position with a variety of duties. The successful applicant will be required to work a combination of day and night shifts based on operational requirements. This position is comprised of supervisory duties, rostering duties and Security Officer duties, with opportunities for advancement within the company.
Main duties will include, but are not limited to:
  • Conduct random audits of onsite Security personnel and take corrective action where required
  • Respond to any complaints and escalate as required
  • Roster staff at short notice using a computer based rostering system
  • Respond to incident reports compiled by staff
  • Conduct Security Site Inductions in accordance with Client requirements
  • Ensure compliance with all WHS obligations
  • Provide detailed end of shift reports
  • Be conversant with all client SOPs
  • Perform regular Security Officer duties on various sites


Requirements

Requirements
You must be able to demonstrate your ability to multi-task and work autonomously. You must be a self-motivated people person, with good problem-solving abilities and supervisory experience.

To be considered for the role you will possess the following:

  • A current QLD Security Licence
  • A current QLD Drivers Licence
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Knowledge and understanding of IR systems and processes
  • Great trouble shooting and problems solving skills
  • Good honest work ethics
  • Staff rostering experience
  • Be a people person
  • Work well under pressure
  • Capable of undertaking the physical patrol and guarding requirements for all sites (e.g. prolonged standing, foot patrol and driving long distances)
If you believe you meet this criteria and would like to join our Operations Team, please submit your resume and a cover letter.

We would like to thank all applicants for their interest, however only short-listed applicants will be contacted for the interview process.

title: Enrichment Specialist - Highbridge Middle
location: 1162 River Ave, Bronx, NY, 10452 (Highbridge Middle School)
description:
Originally founded in 1991 as Harlem RBI, DREAM has grown to annually serve more than 2,500 youth across East Harlem and the South Bronx through a network of seven PreK-12, extended-day, extended-year DREAM Charter Schools and community sports-based youth development programs. Through our commitment to rigorous academics, social-emotional learning, deep family and community engagement, and health and wellness, we create lifelong learners who are equipped to fulfill their vision of success in and out of the classroom. We dream big, as well, with an aggressive five-year plan to expand to serve 3,500 students across seven schools—growing our organization’s impact and leveling the playing field for all children. To learn more, visit .

Responsibilities

  • Grades PreK-3: Design and deliver a series of lesson plans for an enrichment activity aligned to the DREAM program model and that supports interest exploration and enrichment exposure for early elementary students;

  • Grades 4-8: Design and deliver a series of lesson plans for an enrichment activity aligned to the DREAM program model and that culminates in a project or presentation;

  • Collaborate with Youth Workers, Dean of Student Life and Associate Director of Extended Learning and Enrichment to provide a cohesive and fun experience for youth;

  • Embed literacy throughout all instruction;

  • Prepare all materials before activities begin and facilitate a thorough clean up afterwards;

  • Encourage youth to positively participate in activities;

  • Serve as a role model while demonstrating professional behavior;

  • Implement all health and safety protocols as required, including ensuring child safety and responding appropriately to any incidents;

  • Note: Activities that require materials/resources will be given a conservative budget on an as-needed basis.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age by the role’s start date;

  • High school diploma required;

  • Bachelor’s degree or certification in related field preferred;

  • 2+ years experience working with groups of youth, or similar experience preferred;

  • Ability to independently plan and implement lessons in specialty area;

  • Clear passion for specialty area;

  • Understanding of effective youth development strategies and conflict resolution;

  • Exemplary social, organizational, and communication skills;

  • Dedication to the program and ability to collaborate with colleagues to ensure a positive, productive youth experience;

  • Ability to work in-person during all program hours required;

  • A strong belief in the mission and values of DREAM, including the belief that all students can succeed, and a deep desire to make a difference in the lives of our students, families, and community.

Location

  • Highbridge: 1162 River Ave Bronx, NY 10452

Benefits

DREAM offers the following benefits to our part-time employees:

  • 403(b) retirement plan, with employer matching up to 4% after one year of employment (12-month continuous period) in which you work a minimum of 1,000 hours;

  • Disability benefits;

  • Referral bonuses;

  • Discounted school meals through our in-house Scratch Food Program;

  • Access to our Employee Discount Program, offering savings on travel, entertainment, retail, and more;

  • High-performing part-time staff have the opportunity to apply for the DREAM Teaching Fellowship, through which they can earn a Bachelors or Masters degree and become full-time teachers at DREAM.

Commitment

  • Start date: 11/30/2026

  • End date: 6/4/2027

  • Days & hours: 3 times a week, Monday-Thursday; 3:00pm - 6:15pm, Employees can choose any three of those four days, in coordination with their manager.

  • Dates and hours are subject to change.

Compensation

DREAM offers competitive compensation commensurate with relevant experience with the potential for a seasonal increase. The rate for this position for incoming staff is between $30 and $38 per hour. New hires receive an offer within the range based on relevant experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the role. Enrichment Specialists are eligible for seasonal compensation increases based on tenure, in accordance with DREAM’s compensation practices. Compensation for Enrichment Specialists who continue their employment with DREAM may exceed the incoming range band above.
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
At DREAM, diversity, equity, and inclusion are a matter of mission.
From our schools to our playing fields, DREAM is committed to building a team where each individual can bring their full identity and experience to work because representation matters—it enriches our team culture, enhances our ability to innovate, and strengthens our impact in and out of the classroom. DREAM engages staff that represent and appreciate the diversity of our majority Black and Hispanic student body, while working to ensure that our practices are equitable, welcoming, and productive. We are dedicated to creating a world where youth, especially youth of color, have permission to dream—along with the tools and opportunities to make their dreams reality.
Come dream with us.
DREAM Maxims
All Kids Can. This Kid Can.
DREAM is Family.
Fun is a Serious Value.
Teamwork Makes the DREAM Work.
Fail. Persist. Exceed.
DREAM Big.

title: Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer based in Ireland.

This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of databases, developer tooling, integrations, and open source.
You’ll help build and maintain drivers, adapters, migration tools, and integrations that make a distributed time-series database easier to use across modern data ecosystems.
Your work will connect database technology with widely used tools and frameworks across analytics, data engineering, observability, and application development.
You’ll collaborate closely with experienced engineers and contribute to projects that are developed transparently in public GitHub repositories.
The position offers broad technical ownership, with opportunities to work across multiple programming languages, protocols, frameworks, and infrastructure environments.
You’ll also engage directly with open source communities and technology partners to improve integrations and solve real-world developer challenges.
It’s a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving existing software, and shipping high-quality technology used by other developers.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain database drivers and adapters, including JDBC and Python/SQLAlchemy integrations.
  • Build and improve connections between the database platform and external tools such as Grafana, Tableau, and Airflow.
  • Develop and maintain internal administrative tooling, including command-line utilities and administration interfaces.
  • Improve PostgreSQL compatibility and strengthen integration capabilities across the wider database ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain migration tools supporting movement between different database systems and storage formats.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including reference architectures, integration examples, and implementation guidance.
  • Collaborate with open source communities and technical partners on joint projects and ecosystem integrations.
  • Work directly with product managers to translate technical needs into clear requirements and feasible solutions.
  • Take ownership of existing codebases, continuously improving their quality, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Debug complex technical issues across different components and systems, taking a full-stack approach where necessary.
  • Ensure software components are thoroughly tested, documented, communicated, packaged, and successfully delivered.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience as a software engineer, with the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from development through delivery.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
    • Good working knowledge of Python and Java, with experience in additional languages such as Rust, C++, Go, Swift, or Zig considered an advantage.
    • Understanding of technical standards, protocols, and APIs, particularly technologies such as HTTP, PostgreSQL Wire Protocol, Python DB API, and JDBC.
    • Experience with Test-Driven Development and a strong commitment to software quality.
    • Knowledge of software versioning, packaging, distribution, and deployment in polyglot software environments.
    • Understanding of how software components are operated and maintained in production environments.
    • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across multiple layers of a system.
    • A self-directed, hands-on mindset and the ability to overcome technical and organizational obstacles to move projects forward.
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, open source contributors, and external technical partners.
    • A genuine interest in open source software and collaborative development practices.
    • Existing open source contributions are a plus, but are not required.
    • Experience with message-bus technologies such as AMQP, Kafka, MQTT, or ZeroMQ and their broker implementations is desirable.
    • Knowledge of or experience with DevOps practices and containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Competitive compensation.
      • Flexible working hours designed to support autonomy and work-life balance.
      • Flexible holiday arrangements.
      • Fitness and wellness-related perks.
      • Education and professional development benefits.
      • Participation in an Employee Stock Options Plan.
      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on challenging database and ecosystem projects.
      • Exposure to a broad open source technology ecosystem and opportunities to collaborate with external technical communities.
      • An open, collaborative, and internationally distributed working environment.
      • Opportunities to take ownership of projects and contribute to the evolution of database technology.
      • A diverse and inclusive workplace that values different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Project Manager - Operations
description:
About Us

Company Overview

Foundation Building Materials (FBM) is a leading construction materials distribution company serving the commercial and residential construction markets across United States and Canada. In conjunction with Unified Door & Hardware Group (UDHG), a premier provider of commercial door, frame, and hardware solutions, FBM supports a broad range of construction and architectural projects nationwide.

Together, FBM and UDHG’s 8,000+ Team Members are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and employee development. By combining scale, specialty expertise, and a customer-first mindset, we deliver high-quality products and services to contractors, builders, and project teams across diverse markets. As the organization continues to grow and evolve, we are investing in strong, forward-thinking talent to support our long-term success.

Overview

Position Overview

At Foundation Building Materials (FBM), the Project Manager is responsible for overseeing complex and large-scale commercial and residential construction projects. This role serves as a critical liaison between customers, vendors, project teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure products are competitively priced, accurately specified, delivered on schedule, and maintained in proper condition throughout the project lifecycle. The Project Manager reviews project details, specifications, and orders to identify product opportunities, validate scope requirements, and support successful project execution from bid through final delivery.

Responsibilities and Qualifications

Key Responsibilities Project Review & Scope Analysis
  • Review project plan, specifications, and bid documents to identify project requirements and specialty product opportunities.
  • Analyze project scope to ensure product selections align with the job, customer needs, code requirements, and installation specifications.
  • Identify potential scope gaps, product substitutions, value engineering opportunities, and specification conflicts.
  • Collaborate with sales and project teams to develop complete and accurate material packages for customer proposals.
Procurement & Vendor Negotiation
  • Serve as the primary decision-maker for sourcing and procurement of products for large-scale commercial and residential construction projects, balancing customer requirements, project specifications, lead times, and company profitability.
  • Lead negotiations with vendors, manufacturers, and suppliers regarding pricing, freight, delivery schedules, and service-level commitments to secure the most favorable commercial terms for the company and its customers.
  • Exercise independent judgment in evaluating vendor proposals, comparing product alternatives, and selecting sourcing strategies that optimize cost, quality, availability, and overall project performance.
  • Analyze market conditions, material cost fluctuations, vendor pricing trends, and supply chain constraints to develop procurement strategies that protect margins and reduce financial risk.
  • Make purchasing recommendations and procurement decisions on behalf of the company, including approval of vendor selections, pricing structures, and product substitutions within established authority levels.
  • Evaluate and recommend value engineering opportunities by identifying alternative products, manufacturers, or sourcing solutions that meet design specifications while improving cost efficiency or lead times.
  • Develop and maintain strategic vendor relationships to improve pricing leverage, negotiate favorable terms, and ensure high service standards, product quality, and reliable delivery performance.
  • Resolve vendor disputes, pricing discrepancies, product availability issues, and escalations by negotiating practical business solutions that minimize operational disruption and financial exposure.
  • Partner with leadership and sales teams to support bid strategy, margin optimization, and large-project procurement planning, providing recommendations that directly influence revenue and profitability.
  • Continuously assess vendor performance, compliance, and purchasing trends to identify consolidation opportunities, cost-saving initiatives, and process improvements.
Order Management & Project Coordination
  • Manage purchase orders, order placement, and order tracking to ensure material accuracy and timely fulfillment.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and customers to align procurement schedules with project timelines and milestones.
  • Monitor order status and proactively address delays, shortages, backorders, or specification changes that may impact project completion.
  • Support project forecasting and material planning to ensure uninterrupted jobsite operations.
Logistics, Delivery & Material Handling
  • Coordinate deliveries to ensure materials arrive on schedule and in accordance with jobsite requirements.
  • Ensure products requiring climate-controlled or specialized storage are handled, transported, and stored properly to preserve product integrity and manufacturer warranty requirements.
  • Work closely with operations, warehouse, and transportation teams to optimize delivery schedules and minimize project disruption.
  • Resolve delivery, freight, damage, and logistics issues in a timely manner.
Documentation & Compliance
  • Prepare, review, and process submittals, product documentation, certifications, and other project-related materials.
  • Maintain accurate records of quotes, purchase orders, project documents, product specifications, and vendor communications.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with contractual requirements, customer specifications, and internal company standards.
  • Support billing review, credits, returns, and discrepancy resolution as needed.
Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for products and provide technical guidance to customers and internal teams.
  • Partner with sales, operations, purchasing, accounting, and project stakeholders to support project execution and issue resolution.
  • Maintain consistent communication with customers regarding order status, lead times, delivery schedules, and project changes.
  • Build strong customer relationships through responsive service, technical expertise, and proactive problem-solving.
Additional Responsibilities
  • Monitor market trends, pricing fluctuations, and product innovations to identify opportunities for improved sourcing and competitive advantage.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to procurement processes, vendor performance, and project execution.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of business objectives.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years of project management, sales support, customer service, construction materials, distribution, or related industry experience
  • Strong understanding of procurement, specialty products, order management, pricing, logistics, and customer relationship management
  • Experience working with ERP, CRM, and project management systems
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, and Word
  • Ability to analyze information, solve problems, and make sound business decisions
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
  • Extensive knowledge about specialty ceiling products

Compensation and Benefits

Reports ToDistrict Manager Ops Compensation

The listed pay range reflects the expected base rate for this position. Within the range, individual pay may vary based on experience, qualifications, and work location within state. This is a full-time position with competitive pay and benefits.

Benefits

At FBM, we’re committed to supporting our employees both personally and professionally. We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to help you thrive inside and outside of work. Our excellent package includes:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision plans with leading national providers
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) / Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Company Provided Basic Life and Accident Death & Dismemberment (AD&D)
  • Voluntary Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D)
  • Critical illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Coverage
  • Legal Insurance Plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) & Paid Company Holidays
  • 401(k) plan with generous company match

Statements

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity and inclusion and are dedicated to creating a workplace where all employees feel respected and empowered. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process or while employed, please contact Human Resources at Talent@myfbm.com.

title: Front Office Coordinator
description:
Overview

Make a Difference. Grow in Your Career. Thrive with Us.

About the Role

At Mindpath Health, we’re on a mission to make mental health care more accessible and more human. As a national leader in mental health services, we empower our clinicians, support our teams, and prioritize care that helps people truly thrive.

The Front Office Coordinator is a vital member of the Front Office team, supporting both clinicians and patients. This role delivers consistently friendly, high-quality customer service across all patient interactions, helping to create a welcoming, safe, and patient-centered environment. The Front Office Coordinator manages front desk and general administrative functions related to coordinating patient care, utilizing Electronic Health Record and Practice Management systems to maintain accurate, up-to-date records and facilitate effective communication across departments in alignment with Mindpath Health standards.

This role is full-time (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday) onsite in our San Marcos office.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the first point of contact for patients and visitors, delivering a positive, professional patient experience in person and by phone
  • Schedule appointments; answer, triage, and route incoming calls and messages; and communicate patient needs to clinical staff in a timely manner
  • Collect co-pays and outstanding balances, explain paperwork, and ensure accurate completion of patient forms
  • Collect, verify, and update patient demographic and insurance information
  • Assist patients with understanding Mindpath Health policies, procedures, and services
  • Recognize situations requiring escalation and use effective de-escalation techniques to support patient safety and satisfaction
  • Support clinicians by managing arrivals, scheduling changes, incoming communications, and general administrative tasks (faxing, copying, scanning)
  • Collaborate effectively with front office staff, clinical teams, and leadership to support daily operations and continuous process improvement
  • Identify patient satisfaction concerns and contribute recommendations for resolution
  • Adhere to company policies and maintain strict compliance with patient privacy and confidentiality standards

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience using EMR/EHR and/or practice management systems required
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of recent experience in a clerical, administrative, receptionist, or front office coordination role
  • 1+ year of customer service experience, preferably in a healthcare setting
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word), multiline phone systems, and accurate data entry/typing
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective relationships with patients, clinicians, leadership, and staff
  • Demonstrated empathy and compassion when supporting individuals experiencing mental health challenges
  • Ability to remain calm, professional, and effective when assisting upset patients or families
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with keen attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Effective problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to think independently under pressure
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Commitment to maintaining strict confidentiality of all personal and protected health information

CompensationThe pay rate for this position is $23 per hour.

Why Join Mindpath Health?

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job, you’re stepping into a community built on support, inclusion, and growth.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Life & Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid time off starting at 15 days per year
  • Paid parental leave
  • Tuition reimbursement

About Us

Mindpath Health is redefining how mental health care is delivered. Today, we operate across six states, providing a full range of psychiatric and therapy services via in-person and telehealth appointments. Our team is deeply committed to supporting total health through compassionate, collaborative care.

If you're looking for a purpose-driven organization where your work truly matters, we’d love to meet you.

Mindpath Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Software Engineer  (Flutter/Dart)
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Connected Warfare (CW): The Connected Warfare simulaivision builds systems to support global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every mac robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time sensitive decision, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

Warfighter Systems (WS): Warfighter Systems brings cutting-edge technology directly to those on the front lines. Wearable tech, immersive mission command tools, and seamlessly integrated software and hardware create an ecosystem that enhances situational awareness, survivability, and combat effectiveness. From training to battlefield operations, Anduril’s Warfighter Systems organization designs tools that move at the speed of war, ensuring that soldiers are better connected, more lethal, and more resilient.

ABOUT THE JOB
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead the development and optimization of a tactical edge client across Android mobile and Linux in-vehicle systems. In this role, you will own application performance on resource-constrained hardware, collaborate closely with product and platform teams, and mentor junior engineers

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Flutter/Dart: widget lifecycle, rebuild cost, platform channels, multi-platform builds
  • Reactive state management: Riverpod, Redux, Rx, Combine; MVVM
  • Performance: Flutter DevTools, systrace/perfetto, frame budgets, memory & GPU analysis, startup time and battery management
  • Android: process and activity lifecycle, foreground services, doze/background limits,
    permissions, ANRs, adb/logcat
  • Linux: system services, filesystem and permissions, packaging, shell
  • Networking: gRPC streaming, TLS and trust stores, reconnection/backoff, offline-first, degraded-link behavior
  • Architecture: best practices on large codebases, one-way dependencies, unit and widget test discipline
  • Must Be Clearance Eligible
  • Able to travel up to 25%


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Geospatial: map rendering, tile pipelines (MBTiles, raster/vector), coordinate systems, terrain elevation
  • Experience using Kubernetes
  • SDK/API design: versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation, docs and samples
  • Native interop: Kotlin/MethodChannels, JNI, FFI, ObjC++
  • TypeScript: WebView bridges, OpenLayers
US Salary Range
$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

title: New Graduate Engineer, Software (Starfall)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, SOFTWARE (STARFALL)

As a Software Engineer on the Starfall Engineering organization, you will design and implement software and firmware for the next generation of avionics systems at SpaceX. You will be responsible for ensuring your system behaves as expected and troubleshoot when necessary. You will have a direct impact on our ability to launch SpaceX systems frequently, safely, and reliably.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - we want our engineers to bring fresh ideas from all areas. We look for engineers who love solving problems and seek to make an impact on an inspiring mission. As we expand this team, we're looking for versatile, motivated, and collaborative engineers. Our team is involved in designing the vehicle systems at every phase of development. Our software engineers are responsible for the life cycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and operational support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and deliver high-quality software and firmware for common processors and micro-controllers
  • Support launch operations
  • Collaborate with peers and customers
  • Bring up and validate devices that communicate-to and fly-in space
  • Analyze test results and bugs which require in-depth investigations
  • Hands-on integration and troubleshooting of flight hardware/software systems
  • Work in a dynamic environment with changing needs, requirements, and challenges

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, math, physics, or other STEM discipline
  • Professional development experience in C++ or C languages (internship experience is applicable)
  • Graduating in the class of 2026 or 2027

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Development experience with microcontrollers
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in C++
  • Solid fundamental knowledge of computer architecture and networks
  • Familiarity with NXP microcontrollers
  • Commitment to high standard of software development, including adherence to software process and best practices
  • Linux and bash shell scripting
  • Understanding of verification methodologies
  • Excellent communication & documentation skills, and ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary environments

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be available to work extended hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Head of Digital Technology - Manufacturing US
description:
Make your mark for patients

UCB is embarking on one of the most significant investments in its history through the development of a new state-of-the-art biologics manufacturing campus in Georgia, USA.

Designed to power the future of biologics manufacturing, this new facility will strengthen UCB's global manufacturing network, expand supply capabilities for future medicines, and support our long-term ambition of bringing innovative treatments to patients around the world. The project combines advanced manufacturing technologies, digital innovation, data-driven decision making, and operational excellence to create a future-ready manufacturing ecosystem.

As a true greenfield initiative, the BioNexUS program offers a unique opportunity to influence the digital foundation of a world-class manufacturing site from the earliest design phases through commercial operations.


We are looking for a Head of Digital Technology - Manufacturing US, who is visionary, collaborative and strategic to join us in our Digital Technology team, based in our Atlanta office in the United States. This hybrid role requires 40% onsite presence and 20% domestic/international travel.


About the role

You will lead the digital technology strategy and execution for this flagship biologics manufacturing program. You will ensure digital capabilities are embedded into the facility from the beginning, enabling an intelligent, connected, compliant and future-ready manufacturing environment. You will help shape UCB's vision for the Manufacturing Plant of the Future by bringing together digital technologies, enterprise systems, cybersecurity, data platforms, automation integration and advanced manufacturing capabilities.


Who you'll work with

You will be working in a team that collaborates closely with engineering, manufacturing, automation, quality, supply chain and operations leaders across the United States and Europe.

You will serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders throughout the project and work closely with engineering firms, technology vendors, system integrators and cross-functional delivery teams. Together, you will ensure digital technology solutions support both near-term program objectives and the long-term operational vision for the site.


What you'll do

  • Lead digital technology delivery from design through operational handover.
  • Define the technology roadmap for a future-ready manufacturing facility.
  • Embed cybersecurity, compliance and validation requirements into program design.
  • Drive integration between operational and enterprise technology systems.
  • Translate digital, AI and data strategies into business outcomes.
  • Lead technology governance, vendors and delivery partners.
  • Represent technology strategy in senior program decision-making forums.
  • Enable smart manufacturing and future digital manufacturing capabilities.


Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science or related discipline.
  • 8+ years leading complex manufacturing technology programs or projects in manufacturing.
  • Experience delivering large-scale technology programs from design through implementation.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing technology architecture and system integration, including informational and operational technology.
  • Experience managing scope, budgets, timelines, risks, vendors and governance structures.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity, validation, data integrity and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience partnering with engineering, manufacturing and business stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive strategic decisions.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and executive engagement capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science or related discipline.
  • Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing or major capital programs.
  • Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical or other regulated manufacturing industries.
  • Experience integrating enterprise and operational technology environments.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, startup or operational readiness activities.
  • Knowledge of advanced manufacturing, artificial intelligence or smart factory initiatives.
  • Experience developing long-term digital technology strategies.
  • Experience building teams and operating models within complex program environments.
  • Experience working across global and matrixed organizations.


This positions reasonably anticipated base salary range is $236,800 - $310,800 per year. The actual salary offered will consider internal equity and may also vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless explicitly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. UCB invites you to voluntarily self-identify during the application process. Provision of self-identification information is entirely voluntary and a decision to provide or not provide such information will not have any effect on your application for employment, your employment with UCB, or otherwise subject you to any adverse treatment. Any information you provide will be considered confidential and will be kept separate from your application and/or personnel file and will only be used in accordance with applicable laws, orders, and regulations.



Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on US-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com for application to US based roles. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: Art Director - Disney Television Animation
location: Glendale, California, United States of America
description:
About this Role and our Studio


Disney Television Animation (DTVA) has over 40 years of legacy as a top producer of kids & family entertainment. Our work is integral to The Walt Disney Company, bringing Disney-branded characters and stories to families’ homes across the globe.


DTVA creates both long-form and short-form content spanning traditional 2D, rig-based 2D, CG (preschool), CG (premium), and stop-motion. We create shows in a broad range of unique and innovative styles, and we aim to match the right talent with the right production in terms of skill and artistic style.

By submitting an application for this Art Director role, you may be considered for any Art Director positions that arise until the expiration date provided.


Applications submitted to this job posting will remain valid until December 31, 2026.



What you will do


This is a key leadership role that partners with the Executive Producer, Producer, Production Designer (if applicable), and Vendor Studio to execute the creative vision of the show while working within the schedule and budget for the series.


The Art Director will oversee and work directly with the design team to ensure a quality and consistency of style throughout the series, from the opening title, body of episode to end credits. They must be experienced in the creation of detailed style guides and be comfortable dealing with internal and external departments on a daily basis. They will have strong management skills to oversee and give feedback to artistic crew. They will be responsible for anticipating and problem-solving complexity issues. This role requires collaboration with and leadership of a diverse group of people in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities:


  • Work closely with the Executive Producer and Director(s) on all aspects of the episodic look and mood
  • Oversee assembly & approval of “199” main model pack to be sent to the assigned vendor animation studio as well as use for internal reference.
  • Partner in setting the visual style of the series, creating conceptual and production artwork. This includes the Art Review, Black and White Line Art Review and Color Art Review for Executive approval. Subsequent reviews for later seasons may also be required if style evolves.
  • Oversee entire design team including Designers, BG Painters and Color Designers, assigning work and monitoring their schedules to create and maintain consistency with the design of the project
  • Approve all color backgrounds and color created by the Color Designers for the characters, props and effects
  • Read Outlines/Scripts, attend Storyboard pitches and Animatic reviews, flagging potential complexity or design count issues.
  • Maintain production schedule provided by Producer to ensure cost effective, timely production
  • Communicate and problem-solve with vendor animation studio. Work with the Production team and the Digital department, create tools as well as information/”do’s and don’ts” document to help vendor studio achieve the required look within our budget and schedule.
  • Partner with the Producer, Line Producer, and Production Supervisor to create schedules and casting assignments.
  • Work with the TDs to ensure color correct and technically accurate deliveries are achieved.
  • Regularly communicate with our Partner Studio(s) and lead episodic design and asset launches.
  • May oversee Assistant Art Director if applicable.

Required Qualifications and Skills


  • 5-7 years of experience in artistic animation production
  • Experience leading a team preferred
  • Experience working with vendor animation studios preferred
  • Knowledge of drawing software that includes Photoshop, Illustrator, Harmony and 3D technology, where applicable
  • A broad knowledge of artistic styles, latest technology and film is essential
  • Strong leadership qualities with the ability to partner with Creatives and Executives, collaborate with peers, and manage and mentor artists
  • Ability to oversee multiple projects and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to align with style and sensibility of show
  • Positive attitude with the ability to be flexible
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, written, e-social skills and acumen
  • Ability to travel outside of the country

Education


  • Bachelor degree or equivalent work experience

Location


  • This is a fully on-site role based in Glendale, CA.

The pay rate for this role in California is $3,016.5 - $3,921.45 per week, which follows the pay scale agreed upon in the Collective Bargaining Agreement. The base pay actually offered may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits.

title: Campus Security Officer
description:
The MBKU Campus Safety & Security Department is dedicated to ensuring the University community’s right to a safe environment through exemplary and professional service. Officers are responsible for protecting MBKU buildings, grounds, assets, employees, students and visitors against criminal activity, accidents, fires and natural disasters. This may be accomplished by foot patrol of campus, walkways, parking lots, administrative and academic buildings as well as other satellite locations.

  • Work Shift: Monday through Friday 12:30 PM - 9:30 PM
  • Location: Anaheim, California

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide security to premises and MBKU personnel by patrolling all buildings to ensure that the campus is safe and secure
  • Maintain high visibility while conducting patrol check(s)
  • Inspect all exterior and interior doors to ensure that they are secured and lights off after hours
  • Provide lock/unlock services for University community
  • Check in authorized vendors, visitors, and guest
  • Patrol and inspect property to protect it from theft, vandalism, or other criminal activities
  • Escort any loiterers or unauthorized visitors off campus
  • Document shift activity in daily activity report (DAR)
  • Patrol all parking lots for any violations and issue warnings or citations if necessary
  • Effectively and appropriately respond to any emergency situations
  • Monitor Closed Circuit TV (CCTV) cameras
  • Operate access control system
  • Accept additional duties and/or responsibilities as assigned or modified by your supervisor or the Director of Campus Safety & Security

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Be of good moral character, with no felony convictions or misdemeanor convictions
  • Able to communicate effectively orally and in writing
  • Be able to think quickly and critically
  • Be mindful of customer service and public service
  • Exercise good judgment in potentially dangerous situations
  • Conduct oneself with Integrity, Professionalism, and be Dependable
  • Work well independently, with others, and with little to no supervision
  • Maintain emotional control under high stress situations
  • Be proficient in the use of Microsoft Word
  • Successfully secure a Security Guard Card, Pepper Spray Permit, and Baton Permit issued by the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS).
  • Be able to meet deadlines with severe time constraints

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED)
  • Six months of related experience and/or training

title: Managing Consultant, MarTech
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Managing Consultant, MarTech based in Netherlands.

As a Managing Consultant, MarTech, you will own client engagements end-to-end, combining strategic consulting, technical leadership, relationship management, and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with senior marketing and growth stakeholders while remaining close enough to the technology to design solutions and challenge technical decisions. Acting as a player-coach, you’ll shape customer data and marketing technology strategies while directing engineers and implementation partners. You’ll identify opportunities for growth, connect recommendations to measurable business outcomes, and ensure solutions are delivered effectively. The role offers exposure to diverse industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America. It is ideal for an experienced consultant who enjoys moving between executive conversations, strategic problem-solving, and hands-on technical work.

Accountabilities

  • Own client engagements from initial discovery through strategy, solution design, delivery, renewal, and expansion, acting as the primary relationship owner.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and serve as the senior point of contact when clients need strategic guidance or escalation.
  • Run a consistent client cadence, including biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Maintain at least three months of planned work across each account while proactively monitoring budgets, utilization, pacing, and potential overages.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting recommendations to measurable metrics and business outcomes.
  • Develop growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients and demonstrate the commercial value of progressing toward greater levels of marketing and data maturity.
  • Design customer data and MarTech architectures spanning customer data platforms, analytics, lifecycle messaging, warehouses, and integrations.
  • Perform strategic hands-on work where needed, including taxonomy design, measurement planning, attribution modeling, segmentation logic, and quality assurance of critical implementations.
  • Direct engineers and contract developers, review their work, and ensure technical delivery meets the agreed client objectives before reaching the customer.
  • Delegate implementation work appropriately while remaining sufficiently technical to challenge estimates, identify weak solutions, and make informed architectural decisions.
  • Support pre-sales through discovery, opportunity identification, scoping, proposal development, and live presentations.
  • Build proposals covering scope, phasing, effort, investment, and business case, ensuring estimates are commercially viable and delivery expectations are realistic.
  • Partner with Sales through qualification and closing, then transition opportunities into successful delivery where appropriate.
  • Document, estimate, and secure written confirmation for all scope changes before additional work begins.
  • Drive account expansion and contribute to commercial growth across the client portfolio.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 4 years directly owning client relationships.
    • Fully fluent English, as this is the primary working language.
    • Strong understanding of the complete marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost and why.
    • Deep understanding of modern marketing technology, including advertising platforms, customer data platforms, marketing engagement tools, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Strong advisory-level expertise across MarTech systems, with the ability to recommend appropriate technologies, assess how different components connect, understand operational trade-offs, and identify when an existing technology stack can be used more effectively.
    • Ability to critically evaluate funnel reports, cohort analyses, attribution models, and other marketing analytics to challenge assumptions and connect findings to business outcomes.
    • Demonstrated track record of retaining and growing client accounts, with measurable commercial results that can be clearly explained.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, scoping, proposal development, and delivery against the solutions sold.
    • Experience with GDPR and consent management as an integral part of client engagements.
    • Strong technical depth in at least three of the following MarTech areas, with working familiarity across the others: customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, and GA4; lifecycle and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, and Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and dbt; tag management including Google Tag Manager and server-side GTM; CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot; and consent management tools such as OneTrust, Cookiebot, and Didomi.
    • Ability to combine executive-level consulting skills with practical technical knowledge and hands-on experience.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive problems through to resolution.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to balance strategy, delivery, commercial priorities, and technical challenges within the same engagement.
    • Professional working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a plus.
    • Experience managing engagements across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working with both European and North American clients is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Annual compensation of $70,000–$125,000 USD, depending on experience and location.
      • Additional bonus or commission linked to client account growth.
      • Full-time contractor engagement with direct international contracting terms.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
      • National holidays off.
      • Highly transparent working environment.
      • Significant autonomy and room to develop and implement your own ideas.
      • Opportunity to work across diverse industries, business models, and technology stacks rather than being limited to a single client environment.
      • Exposure to both European and North American markets from one role.
      • Opportunity to work with evolving customer data architectures, including warehouse-native approaches, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL.
      • Ability to combine the full commercial and delivery lifecycle of an account within a single senior role.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Client Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Client Platform based in Canada.

This is a senior full-stack engineering role focused on enabling product teams to build and deliver high-quality digital experiences efficiently. You will work across shared front-end libraries, design systems, developer tooling, and a server-driven UI platform. The role combines React and TypeScript development with backend GraphQL engineering and API design. You will help shape the contracts that power web and mobile experiences while ensuring performance, accessibility, observability, and reliability. The position involves solving complex technical challenges within a large monorepo and distributed service environment. You will also contribute to architecture, technical standards, testing practices, and mentoring in a collaborative Agile team.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and evolve GraphQL schemas within a federated graph, including server-driven UI contracts consumed by web and mobile clients.
  • Manage GraphQL schemas as versioned contracts, identifying breaking changes, coordinating migrations across client teams, and keeping generated client models synchronized.
  • Develop, scale, and optimize GraphQL APIs, RPC endpoints, and SQL queries supporting digital client experiences.
  • Build front-end applications and shared component libraries using React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on performance and accessibility.
  • Partner with product and design teams to architect and deliver customer-facing features end-to-end.
  • Use observability tools to diagnose production issues, improve user experiences, and establish effective monitoring and alerting through Datadog.
  • Identify technical debt, production bottlenecks, scalability risks, and opportunities to improve code quality and platform performance.
  • Contribute to system design, architecture, feature delivery, and technical standards within a collaborative Agile environment.
  • Develop comprehensive automated tests for new features and bug fixes, working with QA to strengthen testing pipelines and CI/CD workflows.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  • Incorporate agentic development tools such as Claude Code into daily engineering workflows while maintaining strong quality standards.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
    • Strong JavaScript, TypeScript, and React skills, combined with solid UX instincts.
    • At least 2 years of experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas for product surfaces used across multiple clients, including iOS, Android, and web.
    • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and browser technologies, including the DOM, events, and platform APIs.
    • Solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design.
    • Experience working with production systems at scale, including load testing, tracing, performance analysis, and optimization.
    • Experience investigating and resolving production performance regressions, including CPU hotspots and latency issues in high-throughput services.
    • Experience participating in on-call rotations and owning production release cycles end-to-end.
    • Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainable code, and software craftsmanship.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing technical specifications, runbooks, and cross-team design documentation.
    • Experience developing APIs with Node.js, Bun, or another server framework such as Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, or Laravel.
    • Experience building multi-client or white-label platforms, including geo-based routing and per-brand configuration.
    • Experience with Kubernetes and operating services in containerized environments.
    • Comfortable working with terminal-based development tools, Git, GitHub or similar platforms, and modern code editors.
    • Experience with testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, ExUnit, RSpec, or pytest.
    • Experience with Apollo Federation at scale or GraphQL APIs using Absinthe is a plus.
    • Mobile development experience with Swift or Kotlin, as well as knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL, is desirable.
    • Familiarity with hexagonal architecture, Domain-Driven Development, background job processing, asynchronous event infrastructure, open-source contributions, or startup environments is a plus.
    • Passion for sports or esports is considered an advantage.

      • Published salary range of $135,000–$180,000 USD annually.
      • Competitive compensation package.
      • Potential bonus eligibility for non-sales positions.
      • Comprehensive benefits for eligible employees.
      • Education and conference reimbursement.
      • Opportunities for career progression.
      • Opportunities to mentor and support other engineers.

title: Vice President Asset Recovery
description:
Summary
The Vice President of Asset Recovery provides enterprise leadership for the credit union’s asset recovery strategy, portfolio risk management, loss mitigation, and bad debt recovery programs. Reporting to the CFO, the Vice President establishes the department’s strategic direction, operating standards, performance expectations, and risk controls; advises senior management on delinquency, charge-offs, recoveries, and emerging portfolio risks; and ensures the function protects credit union assets while complying with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedures.

Essential Functions

1. Establish and lead the enterprise asset recovery strategy, including multiyear priorities, annual goals, performance measures, staffing plans, and department initiatives aligned with the credit union’s financial objectives and risk appetite. Represent Asset Recovery in credit union leadership meetings and enterprise projects.

2. Direct the analysis of collection performance, delinquency trends, loss exposure, recovery results, and portfolio risk. Translate findings into forecasts, strategic recommendations, resource priorities, and adjustments to collection and loss-mitigation strategies.

3. Build effective partnerships with senior management and leaders across Lending, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and Member Service to coordinate loss-mitigation priorities, resolve systemic issues, and reduce credit union losses.

4. Build and lead a high-performing Asset Recovery team by establishing an effective organizational structure, clarifying decision rights and accountability, overseeing workforce planning and succession, setting performance expectations, and ensuring leaders provide appropriate coaching, development, and workflow management.

5. Establish decision frameworks, approval authorities, escalation protocols, and quality standards for complex collection matters. Provide executive direction on significant exceptions and ensure management decisions are consistent, well documented, and aligned with policy, risk tolerance, and member-service standards.

6. Maintain executive oversight of the Asset Recovery compliance and control environment. Ensure policies, procedures, practices, monitoring, training, and corrective actions remain aligned with Sierra Central Credit Union requirements and applicable federal and state laws and regulations.

7. Own the governance of Asset Recovery policies, procedures, standards, and delegated authorities, ensuring they are current, consistently applied, appropriately approved, and responsive to regulatory, portfolio, operational, and strategic changes.

8. Provide executive oversight and final escalation support for the most complex, sensitive, or high-risk delinquent accounts and member situations. Ensure significant matters receive appropriate legal, compliance, financial, and member-impact review.

9. Sponsor continuous improvement across Asset Recovery by evaluating operating models, technology, analytics, member-contact strategies, and vendor solutions. Prioritize and lead initiatives that improve recoveries, reduce losses and operating costs, strengthen controls, and enhance the member experience.

10. Establish approval criteria and provide executive recommendations for legal actions, repossessions, foreclosures, settlements, and charge-offs, balancing expected recovery, cost, compliance obligations, reputational considerations, and member impact.

11. Oversee relationships with legal counsel, insurance providers, collection agencies, repossession firms, and other third-party service providers. Establish performance, cost, compliance, service, and risk expectations; monitor results; and take corrective action to protect credit union assets.

12. Prepare monthly, or as needed, reports as required by senior management. Ensure all reports prepared by the department are accurate and timely.

13. Attend ongoing education opportunities and industry events to keep abreast of developments in the field. Coach and develop all Asset Recovery department staff.

14. Establish the Asset Recovery performance-management and quality-assurance framework, including key performance indicators, service standards, control measures, management reviews, and corrective-action expectations. Hold department leadership accountable for sustained quality, efficiency, compliance, and results.

15. Additional duties as assigned

title: Senior Test Systems Engineer – LabVIEW / HMI / Data Acquisition
description:
About Vidac Solutions

Vidac Solutions is a growing engineering and systems integration company based in Fenton, Missouri. We design and build custom industrial test systems, data acquisition systems, environmental test equipment, and automated solutions for manufacturing customers.

Our projects combine mechanical, electrical, controls, instrumentation, and software engineering to solve unique customer problems. As a smaller engineering company, our team members have significant ownership of their work and the opportunity to influence how we design and deliver systems.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Test Systems Engineer to take technical ownership of the software, HMI, and data acquisition side of our custom test systems.

A key initial responsibility will be supporting and developing our existing NI LabVIEW-based applications, including applications used for HMI, data acquisition, test monitoring, control, and reporting. The successful candidate must be comfortable inheriting existing LabVIEW applications, understanding code developed by others, troubleshooting problems, and independently supporting deployed systems.

Our current systems commonly incorporate Yokogawa GM10 data acquisition hardware, instrumentation, sensors, PLCs, and industrial communications.

While LabVIEW experience is important for supporting our existing systems, we are not looking solely for a LabVIEW programmer. We want an engineer who understands industrial test systems and data acquisition architecture and can help determine the best software and technology platforms for future Vidac systems.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of existing NI LabVIEW applications used in Vidac test systems.
  • Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and maintain LabVIEW applications for HMI, data acquisition, monitoring, control, and reporting.
  • Configure and integrate Yokogawa GM10 and similar industrial data acquisition systems.
  • Develop operator interfaces for displaying measurements, trends, alarms, test status, and system controls.
  • Acquire, process, store, display, and export test data from instrumentation and industrial equipment.
  • Interface software with sensors, instrumentation, PLCs, controllers, and other equipment using industrial communication protocols.
  • Participate in the full project lifecycle from customer requirements and system architecture through programming, FAT, commissioning, and customer support.
  • Troubleshoot problems across software, communications, instrumentation, networking, and hardware.
  • Work directly with customers and Vidac engineers to define system requirements and translate them into reliable test-system solutions.
  • Document software architecture, communications, configuration, and deployment procedures so systems can be effectively supported throughout their lifecycle.
  • Implement and maintain appropriate source-control and software revision practices.
  • Support existing customer systems and diagnose issues with previously deployed equipment.
  • Evaluate LabVIEW and alternative HMI, SCADA, programming, and data acquisition platforms for future applications.
  • Help establish scalable software and data acquisition standards for future Vidac systems.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience developing industrial test, measurement, automation, HMI, or data acquisition systems.

  • Strong working knowledge of NI LabVIEW, including the ability to understand, troubleshoot, and modify applications originally developed by another programmer.
  • Experience integrating software with instrumentation and physical hardware.
  • Strong understanding of data acquisition, sensors, analog and digital signals, communications, and industrial networking.
  • Ability to troubleshoot problems that cross software and hardware boundaries.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take technical ownership of existing systems.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with customers and other engineering disciplines.

A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred. Equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.

Experience That Would Be Especially Valuable

Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required:

  • Yokogawa GM10 / SMARTDAC+ systems
  • Modbus TCP/IP or Modbus RTU
  • OPC-UA
  • EtherNet/IP
  • NI DAQ hardware
  • PLC integration
  • Allen-Bradley / Rockwell automation
  • SQL or other databases
  • NI TestStand
  • C#, C++, Python, or similar programming languages
  • Industrial HMI or SCADA platforms
  • Automated test equipment
  • Environmental or performance test systems
  • Git or other source-control systems

NI Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD), Certified LabVIEW Architect (CLA), or equivalent demonstrated LabVIEW experience is preferred but not required.

What Success Looks Like

Initially, success means quickly becoming capable of supporting Vidac's existing LabVIEW-based systems and providing continuity for active customer projects.

Over time, this position will become a technical owner of Vidac's test-system software and data acquisition architecture, helping establish standards that make our systems easier to develop, document, support, and scale.

We are interested in engineers who can support what we have today while helping us build a stronger technology platform for tomorrow.

Why Join Vidac Solutions

  • Meaningful ownership - you won't be one programmer among hundreds. Your decisions will directly influence the systems we build.
  • Interesting engineering - our projects combine software, instrumentation, controls, electrical, and mechanical engineering rather than repetitive application development.
  • Variety - every customer and test application presents a different engineering challenge.
  • Customer exposure - you'll see your systems move from concept through fabrication, testing, installation, and operation.
  • Technology influence - you'll have an opportunity to help determine the software and data acquisition platforms we use going forward.
  • Growth opportunity - as Vidac expands, this role has the potential to grow into broader technical leadership responsibility.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Vidac Solutions is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer committed to a diverse workforce. Minority/Female/Disability/Vet/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.
