title: Services District Educator
description:
OVERVIEW

Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. At Ulta Beauty, some of the industry’s most highly-esteemed beauty leaders share themselves, as well as their expertise. Building authentic community. Creating a real sense of belonging—even as they’re plotting a bold, strategic course of exciting innovations destined to revolutionize the industry.

Think robust organizational support. Ever-increasing levels of investment. And a healthy dose of personal empowerment and growth opportunity. All with a company of unwavering strength and stability.

We are the future of beauty services. Be part of the transformation.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Services District Educator (SDE) is responsible for developing high-performing services teams within one’s district who consistently deliver growth in salon hair sales. The SDE influences and educates all stylists within their district as well as the store leadership to drive performance fueled by education. The SDE is responsible for building an annual education calendar and training on techniques, business acumen, the latest trends, and new service launches. The SDE is a licensed cosmetologist who also contributes to the sales of the district by maintaining a personal clientele. The SDE is responsible for the technical assessment of all licensed service providers and contributes to salon retention and staffing through effective recruiting and training. This position requires a drive for results, high levels of business acumen, a passion for the beauty industry, exceptional guest service, and an aptitude to continue to upskill one’s personal skill set to drive the success of others.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions)

The Services District Educator is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Build the Ulta Beauty brand through exceptional training, technical skills, product knowledge and behind-the-chair experience.
  • Consistently deliver sales growth in hair services and professional hair product sales.
  • Identify training needs by partnering with the services training team and implement programs to train salon professionals on all service behaviors, techniques and initiatives.
  • Travel to district stores to evaluate and elevate behind-the-chair progress and business building behaviors for stylists.
  • Elevate store leadership through regular store visits and teaching best practices that promote sales growth and drive a positive guest experience.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain a limited clientele and service guests approximately 8 hours per week.

People

  • Build a team culture that embodies the Ulta Beauty brand, delivering exceptional service and modeling on-brand, Ulta Beauty behaviors.
  • Attract, hire, and retain a diverse team of services professionals for the district, while teaching Experience Managers and General Managers how to network and recruit.
  • Evaluate technical and behavioral interviews for stylists, skin care professionals, and arch experts in the district.
  • Serve as a support partner to the Experience Managers (EM), Field Business Leader (FBL) and District Manager (DM).
  • Lead change and innovation by helping the team through the change-curve.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Demonstrate an aptitude to learn and teach best practices that promote sales growth, service techniques and product knowledge.
  • Partner with the DM and FBL in assessing talent as it relates to top-line service sales growth/results.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and infection control procedures before, during, and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines.
  • Lead the execution of technical and business training strategies, including networking and recruiting strategies within the district.
  • Host/attend all required conference calls and prepare PowerPoint presentations for meetings.
  • Manage the district training calendar, all class preparations and communications.
  • Facilitate the services portion of EM onboarding in partnership with the FBL.
  • Support new SDE onboarding.
  • Lead, contribute, and participate in Ulta Academy trainings.
  • Attend corporate directed events and meetings.
  • Attend brand partner trainings.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Cosmetology or barber license required
  • Redken Haircolor Certification is preferred (must be completed within six months of hire)

Experience

  • 2+ years of training experience, to include a superior knowledge of all back-bar products, services and retail recommendations
  • 2+ years of coaching/leadership experience
  • Understanding of, and proficiency with, the salon business, color, design and texture

Skills

  • Proficient with technology (e.g. Microsoft Office programs, Point of Sale system and Apple devices)
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks
  • Strong critical reasoning skills to react under pressure, use good judgment in ambiguous situations, and be flexible/adaptable
  • Ability to build strong partnerships with various associate levels and work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify information into clear, concise steps using various vehicles of communication

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible, full-time schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Ability to travel up to 75% of the time including overnight stays

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent mobility during shift
  • Frequent standing, walking, and bending during shift
  • Continuous pulling, pushing, and twisting during shift
  • Continuous lifting, carrying, and/or moving up to 25 lbs. during shift
  • Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift
  • On a frequent basis, requires the ability to work with/around chemicals
  • Frequent use of a computer, telephonic devices, and related office supplies

If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job.




The pay range for this position is $61,800.00 - $73,500.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn services pay pursuant to the Company’s Services Compensation Plan and additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Eligible associates may also earn overtime pay as required by applicable law and tips paid by service guests. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

ABOUT

At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

title: IT Specialist: SAP Finance
description:
Information Technology (IT) develops and optimises the engine that powers De Beers’ digital and technology ecosystems, enabling our people to work safely, effectively and sustainably. This is a senior functional leadership role accountable for the effective management, support, governance and continuous improvement of SAP Finance solutions across the organisation.

The role provides deep SAP Finance and business-process expertise and works with Finance stakeholders, business process owners, IT teams and service providers to ensure that solutions are stable, compliant, standardised and aligned with business objectives. To own and continuously improve SAP Finance solutions by translating business requirements into effective functional designs, maintaining solution integrity, overseeing service and vendor performance, and enabling Finance transformation through standardised and sustainable technology capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

SAP Finance functional ownership

  • Act as the functional owner and primary IT point of contact for SAP Finance solutions within the assigned scope.
  • Maintain the functional integrity, standardisation and effective use of the SAP Finance landscape.
  • Translate Finance requirements into sustainable SAP solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, design principles and control requirements.
  • Provide functional guidance on process design, configuration, integration, controls and improvement opportunities.

Solution delivery and continuous improvement

  • Lead requirements analysis, solution design, functional specification, configuration, testing, implementation and post-deployment support.
  • Assess enhancement demand based on business value, risk, architectural alignment, supportability and total cost of ownership.
  • Promote standard SAP capabilities and fit-to-standard design, limiting customisation to justified business requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, reporting improvement and improved user experience.
  • Ensure solution documentation, test evidence, configuration records and operating procedures remain complete and current.

Service and operational management

  • Oversee the performance, availability and support of SAP Finance services against agreed service levels and operating procedures.
  • Lead the resolution of priority incidents and recurring problems, including root-cause analysis, remediation planning and prevention of recurrence.
  • Monitor service trends and drive measurable service improvement actions.
  • Coordinate clear and timely stakeholder communication during service disruptions and material delivery risks.
  • Provide functional coaching and knowledge transfer to business users, support teams and delivery partners.

Vendor and commercial management

  • Manage functional delivery by SAP support and implementation partners.
  • Monitor supplier performance against contractual commitments, service levels, quality measures and delivery outcomes.
  • Review estimates, statements of work and solution proposals for completeness, value, feasibility and alignment with requirements.
  • Strengthen internal knowledge and documentation to reduce operational dependency on external providers.

Governance, risk and compliance

  • Ensure SAP Finance solutions comply with applicable IT controls, security standards, financial control requirements and organisational policies.
  • Support audit activities, user access reviews, control testing, evidence provision and remediation within the SAP Finance domain.
  • Ensure changes follow approved architecture, change, testing, release and deployment governance.
  • Identify technology, service and process risks, assess potential business impact and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Participate in relevant design, change, service and governance forums.

Stakeholder and project leadership

  • Partner with Finance stakeholders, process owners and IT teams to maintain a transparent and prioritised demand pipeline.
  • Communicate service performance, decisions, dependencies, risks and delivery progress to relevant stakeholders.
  • Lead or participate in SAP Finance projects, upgrades, migrations and transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across SAP and integrated applications to achieve end-to-end business outcomes.
  • Work safely, act as a safety leader and consider risks to people and the environment before undertaking activities.
  • Relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional qualification in Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, Business Systems or a related discipline.
  • Substantial hands-on functional experience supporting or implementing SAP Finance solutions in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated configuration and process knowledge across the SAP Finance capabilities within the role’s defined scope.
  • Experience across the solution lifecycle, including requirements, design, configuration, functional specification, testing, deployment and production support.
  • Experience managing SAP application support or implementation partners and reviewing delivery estimates and proposals.
  • Experience in incident, problem, change and release management within an enterprise service environment.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management experience with senior Finance and IT stakeholders.
  • Experience working across multiple business units, legal entities or countries in a multinational and multicultural environment.
  • SAP Finance certification is preferred. Current SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is advantageous.

Required functional and technical capability

  • Strong knowledge of SAP Finance and Controlling processes and configuration relevant to the assigned scope, which may include General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, cost and profit centre accounting, internal orders and financial close.
  • Understanding of end-to-end Finance processes, financial controls and the implications of system design for data quality, reporting and auditability.
  • Knowledge of SAP integration with related domains, including Sales and Distribution, Materials Management, Project Systems, Plant Maintenance and external applications.
  • Ability to produce high-quality business requirements, functional designs, specifications, process maps, test scenarios and support documentation.
  • Knowledge of SAP application lifecycle management, transport and release controls, service management and production support practices.
  • Understanding of enterprise architecture, cyber security, access controls, data governance and change governance relevant to SAP Finance.
  • Ability to analyse complex incidents and requirements, identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions.
  • Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and relevant SAP Fiori applications.
  • Participation in an SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, conversion or major Finance transformation.

Advantageous capability

  • Experience with SAP Joint Venture Accounting in a mining, resources or multinational operating environment.
  • Exposure to SAP Treasury, profitability analysis, product costing, Group Reporting or other specialist Finance capabilities relevant to the application landscape.
  • Experience with reporting, analytics, workflow or intelligent automation capabilities that support Finance processes.

title: Rare Reimbursement Executive, Texas Region (Houston)
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Rare Reimbursement Executive, Texas Region (Houston) who is self-aware, patient centric and collaborative to join us in our Market Access and Affordability Team. This is a field-based position that requires up to 50% daily and overnight travel will cover Greater Houston & South Texas and is designed to support Central Time Zones. Ideal candidates reside in the greater Houston Metroplex.

About the Role
You will ensure that appropriate patients have access to UCB rare disease products and Patient Services. You will also provide ethical commentary on local, regional, and national payer coverage and their pharmacy and medical policies to all engaged sites of care. You will leverage your knowledge in the market access and reimbursement journey encompassing procurement, payer policies and coverage, benefit design, prior authorizations, appeals, exceptions, denials, coding and payer payment guidelines, site of care regulation/requirements, understanding of coding guidelines with demonstrated knowledge of the complex payer environment. You will relay detailed benefit information in order to maximize the Provider and Staff experience including market dynamics, coverage, billing, coding and reimbursement policies for all sites of care involved.

Who you’ll work with
Internally, you will work with stakeholders across Market Access, Sales, the Patient Assistance Program, Marketing and Compliance. Externally, you will work with sites of care, patients and their respective payer, specialty pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a liaison to all engaged sites of care administering UCB rare disease product(s) through a patient’s medical benefit and pharmacy benefit.
  • Provide support to patients and accounts specific to benefit verifications, product procurement processes, reimbursement information, billing, coding, and coverage details.
  • Provide on-demand education, including Lunch and Learns or Dinner presentations, for office staff regarding Reimbursement and support services.
  • Advises all sites of care on payer specific nuances related to utilization management protocols, appeals processes and the year -end re-authorization verification process.
  • Work with all engaged sites of care to inform them on matters related to access and reimbursement of UCB rare disease products.
  • Sole point of contact for all stakeholders should a Medical Claim denial be presented by a provider.
  • Develop strategic coverage, access and reimbursement relationships with their local Medicare Part A/B Contractors and attends Medicare Part A/B Contractor open meetings.
  • Provide coverage updates, policy changes and communications to internal UCB colleagues.
  • Provide strategic coverage and reimbursement, benefit recertification support and marketplace feedback to internal colleagues aligned to their geographies.
  • Monitor, interpret, and communicate local, regional, and national payer policy updates impacting UCB Rare Disease therapies.
  • Provide reimbursement education and ethical commentary regarding medical and pharmacy benefit coverage, benefit design, utilization management requirements, coding practices, reimbursement methodologies, and payer policy changes.
  • Disseminate relevant coverage and policy updates to internal stakeholders and aligned cross-functional teams.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s preferred)
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical or biotech experience required
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of medical and pharmacy benefit reimbursement including benefit investigation required
  • 4+ years Reimbursement/Account Management experience preferred
  • Excellent working knowledge of evolving reimbursement landscape and the practice management environment
  • Neurology or Rare Disease experience preferred

The reasonably anticipated salary range for this position is $ 155,000-203,000 per year. The actual salary offered will take into account related knowledge, skills, experience and location among other factors and may fall outside the expected range.

title: Buyer
description:
Buyer:


At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

B&A is looking for an Buyer to join a contract with a federal government client in support of an important mission. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a great team while supporting…

Responsibilities

  • Sourcing & Competition: Prepare RFQs; identify and solicit qualified suppliers; obtain and evaluate competitive quotations; document competition and sole/single-source circumstances; and conduct or support supplier selection, as applicable, in accordance with company procurement procedures.
  • Approved Suppliers & Source Control: Procure from approved and authorized sources in accordance with established procedures and verify supplier-source considerations including authorized distribution, product traceability, counterfeit-part risk, obsolescence, and other supply-chain risks.
  • Price Analysis & Price Reasonableness: Perform and document price analysis and price reasonableness determinations using competition, historical pricing, market research, catalog or published pricing, and other appropriate techniques consistent with company procurement procedures.
  • Supplier Negotiations: Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, lead times, payment terms, minimum-order quantities, freight/shipping terms, warranty provisions, and other commercial terms within delegated authority and document negotiation outcomes as required.
  • Purchase Order Administration: Convert approved requisitions into purchase orders; incorporate applicable terms, conditions, and contractual flowdowns as identified by Contracts; obtain required approvals; issue and administer purchase orders and authorized changes; and maintain complete, accurate procurement files in accordance with established procedures.
  • Production Material Support: Work from MRP/material requirements, BOMs, production schedules, and program priorities to place procurements in support of production commitments; identify material shortages, long-lead items, and schedule risks; and communicate potential impacts to Material Planning and program stakeholders.
  • Supplier Management: Obtain and maintain supplier order acknowledgments; monitor supplier delivery, quality, responsiveness, pricing, and other performance indicators; expedite critical materials; maintain current supplier commitments and status; and coordinate with Quality, Engineering, and Material Planning to resolve supplier performance issues.
  • Receiving/Quality Coordination: Work with Receiving and Quality to resolve receiving discrepancies, nonconforming material, returns/RMAs, replacements, shortages, overages, and supplier corrective actions.
  • Compliance & Procurement Records: Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable procurement files consistent with company policies, ethical procurement practices, and applicable FAR/DFARS requirements; and support CPSR, DCMA, internal audit, and other procurement reviews.
  • Cross-functional Support: Coordinate with Engineering, Material Planning, Production, PMO, Contracts, Quality, Finance/Accounting, and Warehouse/Receiving to support procurement execution, material availability, supplier issue resolution, and production requirements.
  • Supplier Development & Small Business Participation: Support identification and utilization of qualified small-business suppliers and maintain procurement records necessary to support applicable program and company small-business objectives.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum five years of progressive procurement/purchasing experience, including experience purchasing tangible materials, components, equipment, and/or manufactured products in a production, integration, manufacturing, or Government-contracting environment.

Required Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including intermediate proficiency with Excel and working proficiency with Outlook and Word; ability to organize and analyze procurement data and effectively communicate supplier and material status.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders regarding procurement status, material risks, commercial issues, and required actions.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent procurements with competing production priorities, supplier lead times, and delivery requirements while maintaining accurate status and procurement documentation.
  • Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS requirements applicable to purchasing and supplier management in a U.S. Government contracting environment, including competition, price reasonableness, procurement documentation, applicable purchase-order flowdowns, and counterfeit-part avoidance.
  • Working knowledge of commercial purchasing terms and conditions, including payment terms, freight/shipping terms, warranties, delivery requirements, and supplier order acknowledgments.
  • Working knowledge of supplier-source controls applicable to authorized distribution, product traceability, counterfeit-part avoidance, obsolescence, and supply-chain risk.
  • Experience using ERP/MRP systems for requisitions, purchasing, material planning, purchase-order management, supplier records, receiving coordination, and procurement reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate supplier quotations and perform and document price analysis and price reasonableness determinations.
  • Ability to negotiate pricing, delivery, terms, and supplier commitments within delegated authority.
  • Ability to maintain complete and auditable procurement files supporting supplier selection and price reasonableness decisions.
  • Ability to read and interpret Bills of Material (BOMs), manufacturer part numbers, technical specifications, drawings, and product configuration information sufficient to support purchasing activities.

Desired Skills

  • Direct DoD/Federal production procurement experience preferred.
  • Experience with Unanet GovCon ERP and/or Unanet AIM is preferred.
  • Professional procurement or supply-chain certification (e.g., CPSM, CSCP, or equivalent) preferred; candidates without certification may be required to pursue an approved certification following employment.

Security Clearance

  • Eligible to obtain a security clearance

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.
  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
  • Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

More About B&A:

B&A delivers secure, innovative, and mission-critical IT solutions to support the United States Government across all three branches—Executive, Legislative, and Judicial—focused on National Security, Defense, and Intelligence. Our team of cleared professionals specializes in Agile DevSecOps, Cloud Migration and Modernization, Data Science and Analytics, Human Capital Management, Operations and Enablement, Application Transformation, All-Source Intelligence, Geospatial Production, Engineering and Integrated Services, and Cybersecurity.

Notable Clients B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

Benefits and Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

  • The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
  • A formal mentorship program
  • Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
  • Brand Ambassador program
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
  • Monthly teambuilding events
  • B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

EEO

B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. B&A complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy covers conduct occurring at B&A’s offices, and other workplaces (including client sites) and all other locations where B&A is providing services, and to all work-related activities.

EEO is the Law

B&A participates in e-Verify. We provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s I-9 Form to confirm work authorization.

description:
Overview

Substitute Program LeaderStatus: Part-Time

Pay Rate: $20.50/hour

Substitute Program Leaders may work at different sites throughout the region and receive their assignments based on their availability. Substitute Program Leaders work directly with a group of students (ratio is contingent upon CDC guidelines), acting as a positive adult role model, coach, and mentor. Substitute Program Leaders must have a genuine interest in the growth, development, and provision of a safe and nurturing environment for the students they teach. Substitute Program Leader’s ability to establish authority through leadership, communication, and most importantly patience, will be required in giving our students the stability and nurturing atmosphere they need to succeed.   • Identify student needs and communicate to Site Coordinator, teachers, school administration, parents, and volunteers as appropriate.
  • Commit to a full-year program, demonstrated by arriving on-time, every day and completing time cards appropriately.

  • Experience working with young children and the ability to inspire and motivate.

  • Additionally / 48 college semester or 60 college quarter units required / and/or by passing an Instructional Aide Test (in some districts)
  • Ability to speak and write standard English appropriate in a public school setting.
  • Must be available at least 5 days a week (Monday-Friday)
  • Program start and end times are roughly between 1:00 PM- 6:00 PM. Times may vary due to minimum day schedules at school sites.

description:

About The Role

Software Engineer

Haarlem, Netherlands

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world's toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely worldwide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role

Planet's Platform teams build and operate systems that enable customers to access and analyze Planet's daily and high resolution imagery, as well as derived products like Basemaps. We enable customers to browse data catalogs, stream data via tile services, and orchestrate geospatial analysis.

This position is to be a contributing member of our Platform teams, developing and deploying imagery access and analysis capabilities for our customers using a tech stack that includes Go, Python, Java, Postgres and Kubernetes on major cloud platforms like Google Cloud. We emphasize scalable, observable systems leveraging open source technologies and standards when applicable.

The team is distributed throughout Europe and North America and thrives on clear asynchronous communication. Success in this role requires strong collaborative communication skills to build coworker relationships across several time zones as well as the ability to contribute to occasional team on-sites hosted in Planet's global offices.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Haarlem 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own

  • Build, deploy and maintain performant, distributed large-scale services and highly-available APIs in Go, Java and/or Python with a strong emphasis on customer experience
  • Work closely with engineers and product managers across multiple cross-functional teams to align product & engineering goals and objectives
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, observable, and well-documented production code
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality and standards
  • Use AI tooling throughout the development lifecycle and holding AI-assisted work to the same bar as anything you'd write by hand
  • Learn and grow as a developer while making a positive impact on our products and customers; bringing the team along with you as your expertise grows
  • Own the operation of these APIs and services by embracing Site Reliability Engineering culture, measuring performance, load testing, creating and fine-tuning alerts, dashboards, runbooks, and responding to incidents
  • Participate in rapid response on-call rotation in support of the team's external and internal services

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in software development within a production environment working preferably with Python, Java and/or Go
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Geosciences, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices and development methodologies
  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills - written and verbal; you are comfortable writing an engineering design proposal and soliciting feedback to drive collaborative decisions
  • Familiarity with GCP or AWS
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently, navigate uncertain and sometimes ambiguous problem spaces, and take calculated risks
  • Experience working with diverse data storage systems such as relational databases, document stores, and key-value stores
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
  • Experience with Git, large codebases, reviewing merge requests, and running complex CI/CD pipelines
  • Comfortable working with Docker containers
  • Solid intuition of when AI is useful in software development and when it is not
  • Experience deploying to Kubernetes

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Familiarity with geospatial concepts and standards; you've worked with GeoTIFFs, GeoJSON, and STAC
  • Familiarity with remotely sensed products and associated metadata; you know why someone wants an ortho-rectified product
  • Worked with observability platforms such as Grafana

We're dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That's why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. title: Asset Management Excellence Lead
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for an Asset Management Excellence Lead who is rigorous and collaborative to join our Service Excellence team, based in our offices in Brussels, Belgium.

About the role

As Asset Management Excellence Lead, you will define and govern how UCB manages its information technology assets and configuration data globally. You will play a central role in transforming our operating model from traditional technology operations towards service and process management. In this newly created position, you will build asset management capabilities, strengthen inventory accuracy, support regulatory compliance and contribute to the implementation of ServiceNow.

This is an individual contributor role focused on process ownership, governance and stakeholder engagement. You will be an expert user of ServiceNow rather than a technical ServiceNow developer.

Who you’ll work with

You will be working in a newly established Service Excellence team that brings together service management process leads.

Reporting to the Head of Global Information Technology Infrastructure and Services, you will collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, architecture, compliance, procurement and other service management teams.

You will also work closely with external managed service providers and ServiceNow implementation partners. Through clear standards, communication and process discipline, you will help asset owners and suppliers maintain accurate, complete and compliant information.

What you’ll do

  • Define, establish and continuously improve global information technology asset and configuration management processes using Information Technology Infrastructure Library principles
  • Own standards covering the complete asset lifecycle, including requests, procurement, deployment, maintenance, changes and secure decommissioning
  • Champion the configuration management database, ensuring that asset records, ownership information, data relationships and inventories remain accurate, complete and reliable
  • Translate asset management needs into clear ServiceNow requirements, working with platform teams and implementation partners on integrations, automation, controls and validation
  • Establish policies, controls and reporting that support pharmaceutical quality requirements, cybersecurity regulations, audit readiness and traceability across systems and suppliers
  • Define and monitor performance indicators while driving improvements in process maturity, automation, accountability, inventory accuracy and data quality
  • Build productive relationships across UCB and with external providers, encouraging asset owners to follow agreed processes and maintain compliant information

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Master’s degree in Information Technology or any related field
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL and practical experience establishing or improving service management processes
  • At least five years of relevant experience in IT asset management, configuration management or a related service management function
  • Practical asset management experience using ServiceNow. Experience supporting new implementations, major transformation or organisational restructuring would be a plus
  • The ability to lead through expertise, structure and engagement, driving process adoption and accountability without relying on direct reporting authority
  • Experience working with external service providers, implementation partners and geographically distributed teams, including nearshore and offshore resources
  • Experience working in regulated environments, combined with a rigorous and data-driven approach
  • Fluent in English. Any other language would be a plus

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

About Design Technology at DLR Group

DLR Group’s Design Technology team advances the digital practice of design across our integrated architecture, engineering, and interiors teams. The team supports and develops the technologies, standards, workflows, and tools that enable our designers to work more effectively and solve increasingly complex challenges.

Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in digital practice, research and development, and client-facing digital services, with capabilities spanning BIM, computational design, reality capture, GIS, automation, artificial intelligence and machine learning, digital review, connected BIM, and design visualization.

Position Summary

As a Technology Project Manager – Design Technology at DLR Group, you will lead the definition and coordination of technology projects that support our community of architects, interior designers, and engineers. Blending project management with product thinking, you will work with stakeholders to identify business needs, define requirements, shape project scope, and prepare solutions for development.   • Strong critical thinking and complex problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple perspectives and develop practical solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing enterprise-wide technology programs or software solutions
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams or coordinating work across multiple stakeholder groups
  • Familiarity with architecture, interior design, engineering, or other design-industry workflows
  • Familiarity with technologies and platforms commonly used in the AEC industry, including Revit, Rhino, BIM, or related tools

title: ServiceTitan Administrator
description:
ServiceTitan Administrator

Overview

Cassidy Service Partners is seeking an experienced ServiceTitan Administrator to support and optimize ServiceTitan across our growing multi-location organization.


This role will serve as a hands-on administrator responsible for user support, system configuration, pricebook and inventory implementation, training, documentation, and maintaining consistency across multiple ServiceTitan tenants. The ideal candidate has direct ServiceTitan administration or implementation experience and understands how configuration changes can impact scheduling, dispatch, pricebook operations, inventory, and reporting.


This is an execution-focused role working within established processes and standards. This position does not manage the data warehouse, write code, perform pricing analysis, or require SQL or Power BI experience.


What You'll Do

ServiceTitan Administration

  • Manage new-user accounts, permissions, roles, and business-unit access across multiple ServiceTitan tenants
  • Provide Tier 1 ServiceTitan support, troubleshooting, and user guidance
  • Escalate technical issues to ServiceTitan Support with complete documentation and supporting evidence
  • Track escalated issues through resolution
  • Execute approved configuration changes
  • Replicate approved model-tenant configurations across additional locations and tenants
  • Help maintain consistency and standardization across the ServiceTitan environment

Pricebook & Inventory Support

  • Execute approved pricebook updates across multiple ServiceTitan tenants
  • Manage imports and exports for services, materials, equipment, categories, assemblies, and other approved changes
  • Maintain consistency between individual tenants and the established model tenant
  • Maintain inventory master data including vendors, warehouses, trucks, purchase-order types, and item mappings
  • Support vendor-managed inventory workflows
  • Complete validation exports before and after changes to ensure accuracy
  • Identify and escalate inconsistencies before changes are implemented
  • This role executes approved pricing and pricebook changes but does not perform pricing analysis, margin modeling, or pricebook strategy.

System Quality & Weekly Maintenance

  • Confirm technician schedules are properly entered for upcoming weeks across all tenants
  • Test online scheduling functionality across service zones
  • Verify appropriate scheduler entry points are available for applicable job types
  • Review proposed configuration changes for potential impacts to scheduling, dispatch, pricebook operations, and reporting
  • Maintain checklists and sign-off documentation for recurring system reviews
  • Identify inconsistencies or potential downstream issues before changes go live

Vendor & Working Meetings

  • Participate in recurring ServiceTitan vendor and success meetings
  • Participate in product rollout and implementation meetings
  • Support voice-agent optimization sessions
  • Participate in recurring pricebook working sessions
  • Execute approved actions resulting from these meetings
  • Maintain written meeting summaries, action items, and open-item tracking
  • Escalate decisions requiring leadership or business-owner approval

Program & Project Support

  • Support the ServiceTitan portion of new acquisitions and integrations
  • Configure users, roles, permissions, and business units for newly acquired operations
  • Replicate approved model-tenant configurations
  • Coordinate pricebook loads and validation
  • Work with ServiceTitan's onboarding and implementation teams
  • Support training and cohort logistics during integrations
  • Replicate approved FieldPro configurations across tenants
  • Maintain report-distribution rosters and exclusion lists
  • Support established Paylocity processes once documented
  • Provide first-line support for basic desktop and IT-related tickets

Training, Adoption & Best Practices

  • Own and maintain ServiceTitan training materials, SOPs, quick-reference guides, video tutorials, and onboarding content
  • Lead ServiceTitan onboarding and training for new employees and acquired companies
  • Develop and maintain standardized best practices for scheduling, dispatching, memberships, estimates, opportunities, call booking, inventory, and pricebook management
  • Identify inconsistent ServiceTitan usage across locations
  • Recommend standardized operating procedures to improve consistency
  • Monitor recurring support issues and user adoption trends
  • Update training materials based on identified needs
  • Partner with field and operational leaders to improve ServiceTitan utilization and business outcomes

Documentation

  • Maintain accurate and current ServiceTitan runbooks and operating procedures
  • Document repeatable processes so they can be consistently executed across the organization
  • Create clear procedures from established workflows and leadership direction
  • Maintain documentation as configurations, processes, and business needs evolve

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on ServiceTitan administration experience
  • Strong understanding of ServiceTitan users, roles, permissions, and business units
  • Experience with ServiceTitan pricebook import/export processes
  • Working knowledge of scheduling and dispatch configuration
  • Experience creating SOPs, runbooks, or procedures that other employees have successfully followed
  • Strong Excel skills, including working with large import templates and datasets
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues methodically and recognize when escalation is appropriate
  • Strong written communication skills when working with ServiceTitan Support, vendors, and field leadership
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in an interrupt-driven support environment
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to validating changes before implementation
  • Ability to recognize how configuration changes may affect other areas of the ServiceTitan environment

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience implementing, migrating, or standing up a ServiceTitan tenant
  • Experience participating on the customer side of a ServiceTitan implementation
  • Multi-location or multi-entity ServiceTitan experience
  • ServiceTitan Certified Administrator certification
  • Experience within HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home-services/trades organizations
  • Familiarity with inventory or vendor-managed inventory workflows
  • Experience supporting ServiceTitan during acquisitions or new-location integrations

What This Role Does Not Cover

This position is focused on ServiceTitan administration, implementation, user support, training, and system consistency. It does not include:

  • Data warehouse management or data-pipeline development
  • Programming or application development
  • SQL development
  • Power BI development
  • Pricing analysis or margin modeling
  • Pricebook strategy or pricing decisions
  • Acquisition data extraction, cleansing, or migration architecture
  • Enterprise architecture decisions

What Success Looks Like

  • Within the first six months, the successful ServiceTitan Administrator will be able to independently manage routine ServiceTitan administration across our locations, maintain consistent weekly system checks, execute approved pricebook changes accurately, and resolve or appropriately escalate user-support requests.
  • You will also begin taking ownership of recurring ServiceTitan working meetings, maintain accurate documentation and training materials, and support ServiceTitan setup for acquisitions and new locations using established playbooks and standards.
  • Most importantly, you'll become a trusted ServiceTitan resource who can recognize potential downstream impacts before making changes and help ensure our teams are using the platform consistently and effectively.

Working at Cassidy Service Partners

Cassidy Service Partners has been serving South Florida since 1960. As our organization continues to grow across multiple locations and brands, technology and standardized processes play an increasingly important role in how we support our employees and serve our customers.


We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, building repeatable processes, helping users get more from technology, and bringing consistency to a growing organization.


Cassidy Service Partners maintains a drug-free workplace.

We trust that this information will assist you in making an informed decision as you consider your next employer.

Cassidy Service Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Newborn Hearing Screen Technician - Part Time
description:
Overview

Join us in making a difference in the early detection of hearing loss in newborns as a Newborn Hearing Screen Technician! As a newborn hearing screen technician, you will provide hearing screens in the hospital after a baby is born. You will work on-site at one or more hospital locations to screen newborns for hearing loss. At Pediatrix, you will receive on-the-job training. This includes annual certification accredited by the American Academy of Audiology. By offering this certification, we strive to ensure our employees are adept in improving early detection of hearing impairments and encouraging timely intervention. Riverside Regional Medical Center

Responsibilities

The Hearing Screen Technician (HST) performs hearing screens and provides education to parents on the relevance of hearing screens and the importance of early intervention.

  • Comply with all company and facility policies and procedures including, but not limited to, appropriate PPE, required vaccinations and other safety/security protocols, Company and Hospital Orientations and annual compliance modules; Raise any questions or concerns from hospital staff and/or leadership as appropriate to HS Manager.
  • Evaluate each patient for “screen readiness” prior to performing a screen; the technician will only screen patients that are in the appropriate state to achieve a reliable result (fed, quiet, not moving/agitated, calm)
  • Collect all necessary data/demographics for each baby. Perform the hearing screen and all screen-related services on all eligible babies during each shift. Ensure documentation protocol is followed for every screen.
  • Treat each screened baby (and his/her family) with the care and consideration required at this important development milestone.
  • Upload all screen results/billing/state reporting by the end of each shift and ensure the stats for each screen are complete and reconciled, unless otherwise instructed by Site Supervisor.
  • Perform all screens in an efficient manner and follow the appropriate process to minimize time in the patient room, without sacrificing quality or patient education / satisfaction.
  • Ensure all relevant information is provided to the party responsible for each screened baby, and the parent/guardian receives appropriate education about the necessity of the screen, and what to do with the results.
  • Notify Site Supervisor of all missed and final refer babies.
  • Schedule Outpatient appointment for refer babies, where appropriate. Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Experience Industry: Entry Level Healthcare

Minimum Qualification/Education Level:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED).
  • Current CPR Certification or must obtain upon offer.
  • Flexibility to work on weekends and national holidays required

    • One to three months of previous experience with newborns and in a medical setting

  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

.

Take great care of the patient, every day and every way.TM At Pediatrix & Obstetrix, that’s not only our motto at work each day; it’s also how we view our employees and their families. We know that our greatest asset is YOU.

We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that fit your life and lifestyle, supporting your health and overall well-being. Benefits offered include, but are not limited to: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Healthcare FSA, Dependent Care FSA and HSAs, as well as a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Some benefits are provided at no cost, while others require a cost share between employees and the company. Employees may also select voluntary plans and pay for these benefits through convenient payroll deductions. Our benefit programs are just one of the many ways Pediatrix & Obstetrix helps our employees take care of themselves and their families.

Pediatrix Medical Group is one of the nation’s leading providers of highly specialized health care for women, babies and children. Since 1979, Pediatrix has grown from a single neonatology practice to a national, multispecialty medical group. Pediatrix-affiliated clinicians are committed to providing coordinated, compassionate and clinically excellent services to women, babies and children across the continuum of care, both in hospital settings and office-based practices. title: Head of Data & AI
description:
We make some of the world's hardest materials: synthetic diamond and tungsten carbide. Our products are found anywhere from surgical tools and semiconductors to the machinery that helps build and maintain infrastructure.

Behind that sits a business that runs on data, and increasingly on AI.

As our new Head of Data and AI, you'll lead the next stage of that journey, reporting directly to the Head of IT and Digital Transformation and shaping how data, analytics and AI create value across the organisation.

This is a global role supporting 24/7 manufacturing operations across six factories, so the data and AI you deliver has to work around the clock.

You’ll own our data platform, our analytics and AI products, and the cloud compute that powers them.

Leading a high-performing team of four you'll set the direction for how E6 turns data into better decisions, whether that's optimising manufacturing processes on the shop floor, accelerating innovation in R&D, or improving efficiency across corporate support functions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll shape strategy and still care about how the pipelines run.

  • Own the E6 data and AI strategy end to end, from a single source of truth through to AI products that people actually use day to day.
  • Lead and grow a team of four across data engineering, analytics, and AI, setting priorities and building capability.
  • Run our cloud compute estate globally. You’ll own capacity, cost, performance, and security for the platforms our data and AI workloads depend on, with the resilience that 24/7 manufacturing demands.
  • Deliver governed, real-time data foundations across all six factories: trusted datasets, shared definitions, master data, and quality controls that reporting and AI can rely on.
  • Take AI from pilot to embedded, with clear use cases, measurable value, and guardrails for responsible use.
  • Set and enforce data governance, ethics, and privacy standards in line with our Data Trust and Integrity framework and relevant regulation.
  • Work with senior stakeholders across E6 and De Beers to make the case for investment and show the return.

We’ve mapped this role to the Government Digital and Data (DDaT) Capability Framework so expectations are clear. You’ll bring:

  • Data and AI leadership (expert): a track record of setting data vision and direction, and being the strategic authority people turn to.
  • Data governance and ethics (practitioner): you’ve built the standards, not just followed them.
  • Data engineering and platforms (practitioner): you understand pipelines, APIs, and how to build for scale, and can hold your own with the engineers.
  • Machine learning and applied AI (practitioner): you know where models add value, and where they don’t.
  • Cloud compute (practitioner): hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure (Azure and Databricks), covering cost, capacity, resilience, and security.
  • Stakeholder leadership (expert): you can convince a CFO of the value and explain the same thing to a plant manager.
  • People leadership: you’ve led and developed technical teams, ideally across multiple sites or time zones.

Right to work

All applicants must be able to provide documentation verifying their eligibility to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not provided for this role.

title: Mining Engineer
description:
The Dragline Mining Engineer will provide dedicated technical support to dragline operations, playing a key role in short‑term planning, design and execution. Reporting to the Technical Services Superintendent, this position focuses on enabling safe, efficient and reliable dragline performance while supporting broader site production objectives.

You will contribute to front‑end daily planning and short‑term schedules (up to approximately six months), ensuring dragline activities are well integrated with supporting operations at Capcoal Surface Operations. This role offers the opportunity to be closely involved in mine plan development and execution during a period of transition and future growth.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and maintaining short‑term dragline schedules and designs
  • Supporting daily production planning and dragline sequencing
  • Providing technical advice to dragline operations to support safe and efficient execution
  • Assisting with spoil placement strategies, strip sequencing and design optimisation
  • Working closely with operations and planning teams to ensure alignment between plans and execution
  • Contributing to mine plans that support future growth and production targets
  • Supporting continuous improvement initiatives within dragline operations
  • Maintaining compliance with safety, environmental and operational standards

This role is well suited to an engineer looking to build or further develop dragline experience in a supportive technical services environment.

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • A tertiary qualification in Mining Engineering, Civil Engineering or a related discipline
  • A minimum of a couple of years’ experience in a mining engineering role
  • Dragline experience or strong exposure to large‑scale open‑cut operations (preferred)
  • Experience in short‑term mine planning, scheduling or design
  • Familiarity with dragline planning and/or mining design software
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with operational teams
  • A practical, execution‑focused approach to engineering
  • A strong commitment to safety, compliance and continuous improvement
  • 8 days on, 6 days off roster
  • Full-time permanent position based at Capcoal Surface Operations, Middlemount QLD
  • FIFO, DIDO, or residential lifestyle options
  • Free camp and mess
  • Relocation Assistance Provided
  • Attractive Salary & Annual Bonus + 12% Superannuation
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Free access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

What we offer
When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package and a range of flexible work arrangements that support the balance of work, family and individual circumstances. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programs, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too.

Who we are
We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. Anglo American is a leading global mining company focused on the responsible production of copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients – future-enabling products that are essential for decarbonising the global economy, improving living standards, and food security. Our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively to unlock enduring value from precious natural resources for our shareholders, for the benefit of the communities and countries in which we operate, and for society as a whole. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives.


Background checks

Inclusion and Diversity
Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

How we are committed to your safety
Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Bet Engine
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Bet Engine based in Canada.

This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on highly critical systems powering sportsbook wagering, grading, casino transactions, financial records, and regulatory controls. You will design and scale high-performance APIs and services where accuracy, resilience, and reliability are essential. The role combines hands-on software development with architecture, production performance optimization, and technical leadership. You will work across modern, legacy, internal, and third-party systems while solving complex integration and data challenges. Collaboration spans multiple business domains and engineering teams in an agile environment. The position also offers opportunities to mentor engineers and influence technical direction across business-critical platforms.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, scale, and performance-tune GraphQL APIs, low-latency gRPC services, and SQL queries supporting wagering, grading, financial ledgers, responsible gaming, taxation, regulatory enforcement, promotions, and risk management.
  • Own highly complex technical problems, develop solution proposals, and present designs to leadership and partner teams for feedback and alignment.
  • Design, architect, and deliver new features end-to-end within a collaborative Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Identify production bottlenecks, performance risks, reliability issues, and scalability constraints, then drive improvements across the platform.
  • Establish and refine monitoring and alerting with Datadog for owned systems and services.
  • Investigate and remediate production performance regressions involving CPU, I/O, memory, latency, and other high-throughput system constraints.
  • Mentor engineers through technical specifications, pairing, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Work with stakeholders across diverse business domains to deliver reliable products, operational improvements, and cost-efficiency initiatives.
  • Bridge internal, third-party, legacy, and modern systems through integrations, data migrations, data translation, and supporting infrastructure.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
    • Strong computer science foundation, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design.
    • Proven experience working with production systems at scale, including load testing, tracing, performance analysis, and identifying areas for improvement.
    • Experience with production on-call rotations and ownership of software release cycles from end to end.
    • Strong software craftsmanship principles and a focus on clean, maintainable architecture.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience creating technical specifications, runbooks, and cross-team design documentation.
    • Experience with modern web frameworks and API development, such as Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, Laravel, or Node.js.
    • At least 2 years of experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas for products serving multiple clients such as iOS, Android, and web.
    • Experience building multi-client or white-label platforms, including geo-based routing and client-specific configuration.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and MySQL, including normalization, denormalization, and performance-versus-flexibility tradeoffs.
    • Experience with Kubernetes and operating services in containerized environments.
    • Comfortable working with terminal-based tools, Git, GitHub or similar platforms, and modern development environments.
    • Experience with testing frameworks such as ExUnit, RSpec, Jest, pytest, or equivalent.
    • Experience with background job processing technologies such as Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery, or Beanstalk.
    • Experience with asynchronous event-processing infrastructure such as Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, or Google Cloud Pub/Sub.
    • Experience with agentic software development tools, agentic workflows, and validating the quality of agent-generated outputs is a strong asset.
    • Experience building financial, legal, or process-accounting systems where correctness, traceability, and auditability are critical.
    • Experience with Elixir, hexagonal architecture, Domain-Driven Development, open-source contributions, or startup environments is a plus.
    • Interest in or experience with sports and/or esports is a plus.

title: Digital Banking Business Analyst
description:

The Digital Banking Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business units, digital banking stakeholders, vendors, and technology teams to support, enhance, and optimize the Bank's digital banking platforms and services. This role is responsible for analyzing business needs, identifying process improvements, managing system enhancements, supporting digital banking initiatives, and ensuring a positive customer and associate experience across digital channels.

The Digital Banking Business Analyst will work closely with Digital Banking, Operations, Information Technology, Compliance, and Retail Banking teams to implement solutions that improve efficiency, support strategic objectives, and maintain regulatory compliance.

Why Fremont Bank?

Founded in 1964, Fremont Bank is one of the oldest independently owned banks in the Bay Area and has been consistently recognized as a Top Workplace for the past 15 consecutive years. Our foundation is built on relationships — with our clients, our associates, and our communities.

We offer:

    • Foster a supportive and empowering environment for associates
    • Deeply invest in the well-being of our local community

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

  • Gather, document, and analyze business requirements for digital banking products, services, and system enhancements.
  • Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements and process documentation.
  • Facilitate meetings with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define project scope, and establish business objectives.
  • Conduct gap analyses and recommend solutions to improve digital banking processes and customer experience.
  • Create workflow diagrams, business requirements documents, user stories, and process maps.

Digital Banking Support & Optimization

  • Support digital banking platforms including online banking, mobile banking, bill pay, remote deposit capture, person-to-person payments, and related services.
  • Research and troubleshoot system issues, coordinating resolution efforts with vendors and internal technology teams.
  • Monitor system functionality and identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
  • Assist with system upgrades, releases, and implementation of new products and services.
