title: Creative Strategist (Contract/Full-time)
description:
Who we are:

Open is a modern studio reimagining the way people practice mindfulness. We blend music, sound, breath, and movement to create powerful shared experiences both in-person and online. Inspired by art, culture, and design, we believe in the power of direct experience to transform lives.

Based in Venice, our growing team is diverse, ambitious, and dedicated to building the future of wellness. We’re backed by Founders Fund (Keith Rabois), Susa, LVMH (Miyuki Matsumoto), Coatue (Arielle Zuckerberg), Slow, SV Angel, Maveron, Jack Dorsey, Adrian Aoun, Jonathan Neman (Sweetgreen), Harpreet Singh Rai (Oura), and Tony Xu (DoorDash)

The role:

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist to turn Open’s brand into compelling paid social creative, with a focus on Meta, Google, TikTok and Youtube ad strategy + creative production.

Working where strategy, creativity, culture, and consumer insight meet, you’ll pair cultural instincts with an understanding of what earns attention and drives action. You’ll develop ads that feel distinctive to Open and give people a reason to practice with us.

From the first hook through production and testing, you’ll own the creative process: developing concepts, writing scripts, briefing creators, guiding edits, and translating performance learnings into the next round of work. You’ll partner closely with the growth team to connect brand storytelling with measurable results.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop ad concepts grounded in Open’s practices and products, audience motivations, cultural insights, and creative performance.

  • Write clear, compelling copy across hooks, scripts, headlines, and ad messaging that reflects Open’s voice while driving attention, understanding, and action.

  • Shape hooks, scripts, storyboards, and messaging angles for creator content, testimonials, product demonstrations, and brand storytelling.

  • Translate ideas into production-ready briefs with clear direction for talent, visuals, pacing, and editing.

  • Partner with designers, editors, creators, and the growth team to take concepts from brief through final delivery.

  • Manage creative production timelines, feedback, and deliverables across multiple concepts and variations.

  • Build creative testing plans across hooks, formats, messages, and audiences, with a clear hypothesis behind each test.

  • Review results with the growth team and build a reusable library of winning hooks, concepts, and audience insights to guide future production.

What drives success for this role:

  • 3+ years in influencer marketing, talent management, or creator partnerships

  • Experience working on brand partnerships or sponsored campaigns, and an understanding of what partners need from creator work

  • A strong network of creators and agents, and a sharp eye for who is right for a brand

  • Comfortable negotiating rates and terms, and managing budgets and contracts

  • Excellent communicator who builds real relationships with creators and partners alike

  • Organized and detail-oriented, able to run many creators and campaigns at once

  • Data-minded, you know which numbers matter and how to report on them simply

  • Genuine interest in mindfulness, music, and the power of shared experiences

title: Finance Intern – Summer 2027
description:
• Location: Mundelein, Illinois

  • Pay: $26.00 per hour

  • Program start: Tuesday, May 25, 2027, with limited flexibility for academic calendars

  • Duration: 10 weeks, with the possibility of extending up to two additional weeks based on business needs and intern availability

  • Schedule: Full time, 40 hours per week, on site

Help Turn Financial Information into Better Decisions

As a Finance Intern at MacLean-Fogg, you will connect what you are learning in the classroom with the financial decisions behind a manufacturing business. You will work with finance and accounting professionals to understand business performance, check financial information, and help teams make informed decisions.

You will take ownership of a meaningful project with guidance from an experienced team. Depending on your assignment, you might investigate spending trends, improve a financial report, support a budgeting process, analyze product costs, or make a recurring task more accurate and efficient. At the end of the program, you will present your work, findings, and recommendations to leadership.

One application connects you with the Finance internship assignments available at this location. Tell us which areas interest you. We will consider your interests, coursework, and experience alongside available projects and business needs.

Finance Areas You Could Explore

Assignments vary by location and may include:

  • Accounting and Financial Reporting: Help organize supporting information, reconcile records, and prepare reports used to understand business results.

  • Budgeting, Forecasting, and Financial Analysis: Compare actual results with plans, investigate differences, and help explain trends.

  • Cost and Manufacturing Finance: Explore how materials, labor, inventory, and operating decisions affect costs and performance.

  • Finance Data and Process Improvement: Improve spreadsheets, organize data, document processes, and help make reporting more reliable and efficient.

You do not need experience in every area. Your assignment will reflect the work available at your location and the support you need to learn.

What You Will Do

  • Gather, organize, and check financial or operating information for completeness and accuracy.

  • Use spreadsheets and other tools to analyze information and explain what you find.

  • Support finance and accounting activities while learning how they connect to the business.

  • Ask questions, investigate differences, and seek guidance when information does not make sense.

  • Work with colleagues in Finance and other departments to understand their needs.

  • Handle confidential information carefully and follow established review and approval processes.

  • Complete a defined project and share practical findings and recommendations.

What You Bring

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, or a closely related business discipline with relevant coursework.

  • Interest in understanding financial information and how a manufacturing business operates.

  • Basic familiarity with Excel or similar spreadsheet tools through coursework, projects, or work.

  • Willingness to learn, ask questions, check your work, and follow through on commitments.

  • Ability to work full time and on site for the internship, with limited start-date flexibility for academic calendars.

All college class levels are welcome. Previous internship experience is not required. Coursework, student activities, personal projects, volunteering, and any type of employment can demonstrate your potential.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • A cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

  • Coursework or projects involving accounting, financial analysis, economics, statistics, or business data.

  • Experience using spreadsheet formulas, charts, pivot tables, or lookup functions.

  • Experience organizing information, managing a student-organization budget, improving a process, or explaining a recommendation.

You do not need prior manufacturing experience or knowledge of our financial systems. We will help you learn the tools and processes used in your assignment.

What You Can Expect

  • Competitive pay of $26.00 per hour.

  • A meaningful project with a defined deliverable.

  • Guidance, feedback, and opportunities to learn from an experienced team.

  • Exposure to the connection between Finance and the work of a manufacturing business.

  • An opportunity to present your work and explore your career interests.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

The physical demands below represent those required to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Sit at a workstation and use a computer for extended periods.

  • Move throughout manufacturing areas to observe equipment, processes, and production activities.

  • Occasionally lift and carry tools, samples, or parts weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, and reach when observing equipment or components.

  • Review drawings, gauges, measurement equipment, and other visual information.

  • Wear required personal protective equipment, which may include safety glasses, hearing protection, and safety footwear.

  • Work in office and manufacturing environments where noise, temperature variation, and airborne particulates may be present.

What to Expect After Applying

Our hiring process includes an application, Criteria assessments, application and assessment review, a recruiter screen, and a 45-minute interview with the hiring team. Candidates selected for an offer receive a conditional offer followed by required pre-employment screening before hire.

This position requires a pre-employment drug screen after a conditional offer. A criminal background check may also be required, depending on the role. Screening and employment decisions are administered consistent with applicable law.

About MacLean-Fogg

MacLean-Fogg is a fourth-generation, family-owned American manufacturing company headquartered in Mundelein, Illinois. Founded in 1925, we design and manufacture engineered components and solutions for automotive and industrial markets.

Our portfolio includes MacLean-Fogg Component Solutions, OMCO, Mallard Manufacturing, and Threadstrong. Across our companies, we share a commitment to Safety, Integrity, People, Excellence, and Stewardship while investing in our people, manufacturing capabilities, customers, and communities.

title: Data Engineering Intern - Central IT Solutions
description:
Company Description

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from a single laboratory in Nantes, France, with more than 65,000 employees in a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in more than 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to assess the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability, and purity of biological substances and products.



Pronto/a a candidarsi? La preghiamo di leggere la descrizione almeno una volta prima di fare clic su "Candidati".

About the role

We are transforming laboratory operations into a fully digital, data-driven and increasingly intelligent laboratory environment.

As a Data Engineering Intern – Digital Laboratory, you will work on real-world projects that connect laboratory systems, data platforms, analytics and automation.

Your main focus will be data engineering: extracting, transforming, integrating and structuring laboratory data so that it can be used for Power BI, automation, AI and future machine-learning applications.

You will work with technologies such as Python, SQL, APIs, cloud data platforms and Power BI, while gaining exposure to laboratory systems and digital transformation in a regulated Life Sciences environment.

This is an opportunity to work on projects designed to eliminate manual data handling, reduce paperwork and unnecessary system interactions, and make laboratory processes faster and more intelligent.


What you will work on

1. Laboratory Data Engineering

  • Develop Python and SQL solutions for data extraction and transformation.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines for laboratory and operational data.
  • Transform raw data into structured, reusable datasets.
  • Support the development of laboratory data lake/lakehouse capabilities.
  • Automate recurring data preparation activities currently performed manually.
  • Implement basic data-quality checks and validation rules.
  • Help document data sources, structures and transformations.

2. Laboratory Systems Data

  • Work with data originating from laboratory systems.
  • Support extraction and analysis of data through appropriate, supported integration mechanisms.
  • Analyze, and identify opportunities for standardization and reuse.
  • Help create datasets that can be used for laboratory analytics and reporting.
  • Work with laboratory application specialists to understand how laboratory data is generated and used.
  • You do not need previous industry experience. We are looking for strong technical fundamentals and curiosity about laboratory technology.

3. Power BI & Analytics Automation

  • Support automated Power BI datasets, create and improve dashboards and manage reporting pipelines.
  • Build data transformations that eliminate manual Excel preparation.
  • Help develop reusable data models for laboratory KPIs.
  • Investigate data-quality issues affecting dashboards and reports.
  • Improve reliability and automation of recurring reporting processes.

4. Data Integration & APIs

  • Work with REST APIs and system integrations.
  • Develop scripts and connectors to move data between systems.
  • Investigate different approaches to integrating laboratory and enterprise applications.
  • Help build reusable integration components rather than one-off data extracts.

5. AI & Machine Learning Exposure

Although data engineering is the primary focus, you will also be exposed to AI and ML projects.

You may contribute to:

  • Preparing datasets for ML models.
  • Data pipelines supporting AI applications.
  • Anomaly detection and laboratory performance analytics.
  • AI-agent and RAG-based solutions.
  • Data preparation for predictive laboratory use cases.
  • Experimenting with automation technologies.
  • The objective is to understand how good data engineering enables useful AI, rather than simply experimenting with AI tools.

6. Digital Laboratory Automation

You will also help identify opportunities to remove unnecessary manual work.

For example:

  • Manual Excel extraction → automated pipeline
  • Repeated data entry → system integration
  • Manual report preparation → automated Power BI
  • Paper-based information flow → digital workflow
  • Manual data investigation → AI-assisted analysis
  • You will work with the team to turn these opportunities into practical solutions.


What we are looking for:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree or recently graduated in: Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics / Statistics, Engineering or a related field.
  • Good understanding of Python.
  • Good understanding of SQL and relational databases.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Interest in data engineering and technology.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies independently.
  • Good English communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Power BI.
  • Experience with Azure or another cloud platform.
  • Experience with data pipelines / ETL / ELT.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
  • Python libraries such as pandas.
  • Basic understanding of data lakes/lakehouses.
  • Basic knowledge of machine learning.
  • Experience with Power Automate or RPA.
  • Interest in AI, LLMs or AI agents.
  • Previous experience with laboratory, healthcare or pharmaceutical data.


You do not need to know all of these technologies. Strong Python/SQL fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important. xysqume


Additional Information

  • Location: Vimodrone (hybrid – 2 days remote/week)
  • Duration: 6 months internship
  • Flexible working hours
  • Salary: 1000€/month + €8 ticket restaurant/day


This is a 6-month internship role with no guaranteed extension, but strong performers may be considered for extension or full-time opportunities.

description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for an Academic Center Executive (ACE) Rare – Neuromuscular who is accomplished, highly networked within the hospital systems, and who takes initiative to join us in our Rare Disease Organization team, based in Dallas, Texas.

The Academic Center Executive (ACE) represents the UCB rare portfolio in the key academic centers of excellence educating appropriate healthcare professionals on our promoted gMG products and the role these products could play in the lives of patients living with generalized myasthenia gravis.

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Experience in supporting biologic therapy administered by a designated health care provide

  • Promotional product experience with REMS requirements
  • Command of key medical, scientific, and healthcare concepts, language, and practices related to neurology and rare diseases

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Location: Onsite at a government site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area
Type: Full-time, W-2
Compensation: $80,000–$130,000 annually, depending on experience and assignment
Experience: Approximately 1–5 years of relevant experience; we are hiring at multiple levels

One posting, several possible routes. Via Logic is hiring for multiple openings at different experience levels. Your work may center on identity and access, secure cloud configuration, network controls, monitoring, automation, or resolving cloud security findings. The broad experience and compensation ranges reflect the different openings; we will explore where your strengths fit best.

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

These openings support CBP work. Applicants must:

  • Be U.S. citizens.
  • Be able to complete the CBP suitability process and receive a favorable determination before starting the assignment. The process includes a background investigation and review of credit history.
  • Meet any additional clearance requirement for the specific opening. Some assignments may require a Secret or Top Secret clearance, and specialized assignments may require SCI eligibility. We will confirm the requirement as we match candidates to openings.

Your Mission

  • Implement and improve security controls across cloud services and workloads.
  • Support identity and access, network protections, logging, monitoring, and secure configuration in cloud environments.
  • Investigate misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and security findings; partner with platform and application teams to fix the underlying issues.
  • Help automate security checks, guardrails, and repeatable response or remediation tasks.
  • Support cloud security assessments, incident response, and clear documentation of changes and technical decisions.
  • Bring your experience to related DevSecOps, security engineering, or modernization work when the assignment calls for it.

What You Bring to the Expedition

  • Approximately 1–5 years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, cloud security, infrastructure security, or a related technical field. We will consider the depth of your work alongside your years of experience.
  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and some of its identity, networking, logging, or security services.
  • Experience identifying or fixing security gaps in cloud resources, access, configurations, or workloads.
  • The ability to work with engineers and system owners to put practical controls in place and explain why they matter.
  • The ability to work onsite in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

Experience with infrastructure as code, scripting, CI/CD, container security, cloud networking, or security automation is welcome. Specific platforms and tools vary by assignment; you do not need to have used every item listed here.

Why Explorers Stay

  • Healthcare coverage and paid time off that give you room to take care of life outside work.
  • Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help each other grow.
  • Opportunities to deepen your specialty and explore adjacent areas of cybersecurity as new assignments open up.
  • Meaningful work protecting systems that support a federal mission.

How We Work

  • These roles work onsite at a government site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. The specific site depends on the assignment.
  • You will work with Via Logic teammates, government partners, and other technical teams using tools approved for your work environment.
  • Schedules depend on the opening. We will discuss any extended hours or on-call expectations before moving forward with a specific assignment.
  • When virtual meetings are part of the work, we expect active participation and use video when appropriate and permitted by the customer environment.

Your Route Into Via Logic

Tell us what you have secured, configured, or improved in a cloud environment. We are hiring for multiple openings at different levels through this posting, and a few clear sentences can tell us a lot. If your experience also reaches into DevSecOps, network security, or broader security engineering, we want to hear about that too.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges -not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a product area end-to-end, from identifying customer problems through discovery, prioritization, delivery, and measurement. Working closely with Engineering and Design, you’ll turn product vision into high-quality experiences and measurable business outcomes. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to operate in an ambitious, fast-paced B2B environment. You’ll help define a 12–18 month product vision while exploring what an AI-first finance experience should look like. Success will require a strong customer focus, strategic thinking, proactive communication, and a genuine sense of ownership.

  • Own the product roadmap for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, iteration, and measurable outcomes.
  • Define, manage, and track OKRs with your product squad, communicating progress and outcomes clearly.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design on discovery, technical scoping, prioritization, trade-offs, and delivery.
  • Conduct direct conversations with customers and customer-facing teams to identify meaningful problems and build evidence-based product priorities rather than simply inheriting an existing backlog.
  • Identify dependencies across adjacent product areas and proactively address potential risks before they impact delivery.
  • Represent customer needs in cross-functional discussions, ensuring product decisions and trade-offs remain grounded in user value.
  • Develop and communicate a 12–18 month product vision, with a particular focus on creating an AI-first user experience.

    • Requirements

    • At least 2 years of experience working in a B2B product environment.
    • Demonstrated success conceptualizing, developing, launching, and scaling products in a fast-paced setting.
    • Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, evidence-light problem spaces and define solutions from scratch rather than relying on a pre-scoped backlog.
    • Strong experience collaborating directly with Engineering on technical decisions, trade-offs, and dependency management.

    • Strategic mindset with the ability to maintain a multi-quarter vision rather than focusing exclusively on immediate priorities.

title: Lead Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist management with the operations of the store by performing clerk duties in the designated department (grocery or freight), leading by example, and assisting the department manager in general department operations as directed. Answer customer questions and complaints in a professional manner and assure all customers receive fast, friendly service. Perform the duties of a grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker in addition to assisting assigned employees in the performance of their tasks as appropriate, including notifying them of their breaks and lunches. Performs other related work.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve and thank customers. Maintains and encourages an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Provides customer service by performing the duties of a clerk in the designated department (grocery or freight). **Refer to Grocery Clerk, Cashier/Checker and/or Freight Stocker job descriptions for complete list of responsibilities.
  • Performs a lead role in customer service which may include handling customer complaints and requests, approving checks, selling gift certificates, issuing refunds, receiving returned check payments and answering any questions the customer must have.
  • Continuously monitors area activities, including customer traffic flow, coverage of checkout lanes, etc.
  • Maintains cleanliness and eye-appeal of work area, storage area, equipment and retail displays according to company policy and legal regulations; and cleans work area by mopping, sweeping, taking out garbage, etc.
  • Ensures the department/area of responsibility is kept clear of excess carts, baskets, garbage, etc.
  • Monitors arrivals, breaks, lunches and departures of employees in area of responsibility. Communicates with immediate supervisor regularly.
  • Assists immediate supervisor as needed or directed.
  • Assists clerks by providing direction and leadership, demonstrating and performing clerk responsibilities and assigned tasks, and answering employee questions.
  • May monitor cashier money handling procedures and assists with scan system procedures (i.e. UPC codes not on file, scan pricing errors, etc.).
  • May fill department racks/shelves, displays, coolers, handle and use cleaning materials, department machines and equipment, pull cardboard and face the wall and aisles, perform cashiering duties, perform other duties as needed or directed.
  • Maintains a constant awareness of customer and employee safety.
  • Stocks and rotates merchandise in any area of the store as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed.

Requirements

Education:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Experience:

  • Communicating clearly and professionally, utilizing excellent verbal, written and inter-personal communication skills, establishing and maintaining a good rapport with co-workers, supervisors, vendors, customers and others.
  • Providing leadership, exhibiting interpersonal skills by maintaining composure and professionally addressing difficult and sometimes angry individuals including customers, vendors and co-workers.
  • Applying clear understanding of overall company practices, including in-depth knowledge of polices/procedures, in order to effectively judge and react to customer activity.
  • Demonstrating initiative and self-direction to perform a variety of simultaneous skills (multi-tasking).
  • Conducting visual inspections, reading reports, computer printouts, register and computer screens, etc.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, multiply and divide) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately with honesty and integrity.
  • In Montana and Oregon the minimum age is 18 years old. All other states the minimum age is 21 years old.

Ability to:

  • Consistently provide world class customer service to internal and external customers.
  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Perform all duties described in the appropriate department specific job description (grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker).
  • Understand overall company practices through previous experience in designated department (grocery or freight) or equivalent.
  • Properly use cleaning chemicals in accordance with manufacture’s guidelines and instructions.
  • Properly handle food products per State and County laws, and WinCo standards.
  • Reach, lift and maneuver objects of varying dimensions and weights up to 50 lbs. frequently.
  • Stand for long periods of time, walk and move rapidly, bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, machines, equipment and work aides.
  • Understand state & federal regulations if certification is needed.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must meet age requirements listed above.
  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Refer to appropriate department specific job description (grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker) for complete list.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

title: Managing Consultant, MarTech
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Managing Consultant, MarTech based in Germany.

As a Managing Consultant, MarTech, you will own client engagements end-to-end, combining strategic consulting, technical leadership, relationship management, and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with senior marketing and growth stakeholders while remaining close enough to the technology to design solutions and challenge technical decisions. Acting as a player-coach, you’ll shape customer data and marketing technology strategies while directing engineers and implementation partners. You’ll identify opportunities for growth, connect recommendations to measurable business outcomes, and ensure solutions are delivered effectively. The role offers exposure to diverse industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America. It is ideal for an experienced consultant who enjoys moving between executive conversations, strategic problem-solving, and hands-on technical work.

Accountabilities

  • Own client engagements from initial discovery through strategy, solution design, delivery, renewal, and expansion, acting as the primary relationship owner.

  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting recommendations to measurable metrics and business outcomes.
  • Develop growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients and demonstrate the commercial value of progressing toward greater levels of marketing and data maturity.
  • Design customer data and MarTech architectures spanning customer data platforms, analytics, lifecycle messaging, warehouses, and integrations.
  • Perform strategic hands-on work where needed, including taxonomy design, measurement planning, attribution modeling, segmentation logic, and quality assurance of critical implementations.
  • Direct engineers and contract developers, review their work, and ensure technical delivery meets the agreed client objectives before reaching the customer.
  • Delegate implementation work appropriately while remaining sufficiently technical to challenge estimates, identify weak solutions, and make informed architectural decisions.

    • Ability to critically evaluate funnel reports, cohort analyses, attribution models, and other marketing analytics to challenge assumptions and connect findings to business outcomes.
    • Demonstrated track record of retaining and growing client accounts, with measurable commercial results that can be clearly explained.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, scoping, proposal development, and delivery against the solutions sold.
    • Experience with GDPR and consent management as an integral part of client engagements.
    • Strong technical depth in at least three of the following MarTech areas, with working familiarity across the others: customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, and GA4; lifecycle and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, and Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and dbt; tag management including Google Tag Manager and server-side GTM; CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot; and consent management tools such as OneTrust, Cookiebot, and Didomi.
    • Ability to combine executive-level consulting skills with practical technical knowledge and hands-on experience.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive problems through to resolution.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to balance strategy, delivery, commercial priorities, and technical challenges within the same engagement.
    • Professional working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a plus.
    • Experience managing engagements across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working with both European and North American clients is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Annual compensation of $70,000–$125,000 USD, depending on experience and location.

      • Full-time contractor engagement with direct international contracting terms.
      • Flexible paid time off.

      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.

description:
Vi har travlt og udvider vores team til væveriet i Herning. Vil du gerne arbejde med fremstilling af produkter og har du sans for detaljen? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Det er en fastansættelse med arbejdstider mandag-torsdag fra 07:00-15:30 og fredag til kl. 14:00.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver

· Overvåge og passe vævemaskinerne

· Opsætning af garnspoler på gatter, udbedring af fejl og løbende kvalitetskontrol

· Sikre at anlægget kører med minimal nedetid

Du skal kunne holde flere bolde i luften samtidig og have et godt overblik. Du skal være indstillet på et længerevarende samarbejde i trygge og stabile rammer. Oplæringsperioden varer cirka 3 mdr. hvorefter du kan arbejde selvstændigt sammen med kollegaerne.

Du har måske tidligere erfaring med produktion, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at sætte dig ind i hvordan produktionsanlægget virker. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring! Vi forventer dog, at du taler og forstår dansk og bor i en radius af 40 km.

Vi tilbyder dig godt kollegaskab og en arbejdsplads med godt sammenhold.

Løn efter kvalifikationer og overenskomst.

Send dit CV og ansøgning til camilla@hsv.dk senest d. 31/10. Vi kalder løbende til ansættelsessamtaler, hvor vi vil fortælle meget mere om os og stillingen. Når vi finder den rette kandidat, fjernes opslaget.

Hvem er vi?

Herning Special Væveri A/S er en familievirksomhed i 2. generation. Siden 1986 har vi produceret vævede metervarer til kunder i hele verden fra vores fabrik i Herning. Vi er et stærkt hold med 10 ansatte, hvor vi løfter i samlet flok for at give kunderne tekstiler i topkvalitet.

You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. This is a high-ownership opportunity for an experienced client leader who can connect strategy, technology, and commercial outcomes.

Accountabilities

  • Own the executive-level relationship across a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary strategic contact for senior marketing and growth stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain a strong client cadence through biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews covering results, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Keep clients proactively informed about progress, budgets, timelines, risks, and decisions, ensuring there are no unexpected developments.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting each challenge to the relevant customer pain, metric, business impact, and potential solution.
  • Build and defend growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients, using measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle strategies, experimentation roadmaps, and performance readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions and recommendations into clear business implications that executive stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Scope projects and translate client requirements into sufficiently detailed briefs for architects and engineers, while remaining accountable for the quality and business relevance of the final outcome.
  • Lead project execution through sprint cadence, board management, dependencies, risks, timelines, and critical-path oversight rather than performing the technical implementation yourself.
  • Review completed work against agreed client objectives before delivery and ensure commitments are fulfilled to the expected standard.
  • Run pre-sales discovery, qualify opportunities, develop proposals, and present scope, phasing, investment, and business cases directly to prospective clients.
  • Partner with Sales throughout qualification, discovery, and closing before taking ownership of the account during delivery.
  • Price and scope technical work with profitability and delivery feasibility in mind.
  • Own retention and expansion across your portfolio, ensuring scope changes are estimated, documented, and approved before work begins.
  • Maintain a six-month forward roadmap so future engagements can be planned and contracted before existing scopes come to an end.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 5 years owning senior client relationships with direct revenue responsibility.
    • Fully fluent English, combined with professional working proficiency in at least one additional European language such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
    • Strong understanding of the full marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost between stages.
    • Solid understanding of how marketing technology supports modern marketing operations, including advertising, customer data platforms, marketing engagement, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Advisory-level knowledge of modern marketing and customer data technologies, with the ability to assess technology choices, understand trade-offs, evaluate how systems work together, and challenge poor technical recommendations without being responsible for configuration or coding.
    • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and data-driven approaches for improving marketing performance and returns.
    • Demonstrated success retaining and expanding client accounts, ideally supported by measurable commercial results.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, qualification, scoping, proposal development, and presenting solutions to executive buyers.
    • Experience scoping and pricing technical work in a way that balances client value, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
    • Understanding of how European businesses purchase, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent requirements.
    • Advisory command of customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4; lifecycle tools such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, or Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt; tag management; CRM; and consent management platforms.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive issues through to resolution.
    • Excellent strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to balance client value, delivery quality, account health, and profitability.
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, particularly with senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an environment where consulting, delivery, and business development can compete for attention.
    • Experience working with clients across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working across both European and North American client portfolios is a plus.
    • Experience building or helping establish a regional practice is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
      • National holidays off.
      • Highly transparent working environment with clear visibility into business and client objectives.
      • Significant autonomy and room to develop and act on your own ideas.
      • Opportunity to own the full commercial lifecycle of client accounts, from initial discovery through renewal and expansion.
      • Exposure to a broad range of industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America.
      • Opportunity to advise clients on emerging customer data architectures, including warehouse-native approaches, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL.
      • The chance to work across the full customer data and revenue operations ecosystem rather than being tied to a single platform or vendor.

title: Data Portfolio Lead
description:
Make your mark for patients

Data Portfolio Lead

We are looking for a Data Portfolio Lead who is curious, collaborative, and outcome-oriented to join us in our Transformation initiative program, Ruby, based in either our United States office, in Europe: in our headquarters in Belgium or in our UK based office located in Slough.

About the role

You will improve critical business decisions and processes across an assigned portfolio by ensuring the right data is available, connected, and usable. You will identify high-value business questions, translate them into integrated data products, and coordinate contributions across data domains. You will also define the shared business meaning and context of these products, helping ensure they are trusted, reusable, governed, and ready to support analytics and artificial intelligence. Your focus will be to turn important business questions into trusted data products and measurable business outcomes.

Who you'll work with

You will be working in a team that connects business, data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and technology expertise. You will partner with business and process owners, business analysts, data product leads, data operations, data governance teams, subject matter experts, and digital technology teams. Together, you will align reusable data capabilities with portfolio priorities and deliver scalable solutions that support decision-making and business value.

What you'll do

  • Partner with business and process leaders to identify high-value questions, decisions, and opportunities to improve processes through data.
  • Translate business questions into prioritized data product opportunities, clear requirements, acceptance criteria, success measures, and measurable outcomes.
  • Combine relevant data products across domains to create integrated, fit-for-purpose solutions for specific business needs.
  • Define and maintain business concepts, relationships, shared meaning, and context for cross-domain data products.
  • Align reusable data capabilities with portfolio priorities in partnership with data product leads and business analysts.
  • Validate and test data and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities for accuracy and fitness for purpose with business stakeholders.
  • Ensure portfolio data products are discoverable, reusable, governed, scalable, and ready for analytics and artificial intelligence.
  • Monitor adoption, usage, and business impact, using feedback and measurement to drive continuous improvement and value realization.

Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Bachelor's degree in business, data, analytics, life sciences, information management, technology, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Experience connecting business strategy, process improvement, data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience working across business functions and data domains, translating business questions into data, analytical, and technology requirements.
  • Experience combining multiple domain data products into fit-for-purpose solutions that answer specific business questions.
  • Experience defining business concepts, shared meaning, relationships, or information models for cross-domain data products.
  • Experience partnering with business analysts on specifications, acceptance criteria, testing, validation, and success measures.
  • Strong business acumen, data fluency, systems thinking, problem-solving, stakeholder influence, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences environments is preferred, with a collaborative and accountable approach across organizational boundaries.

title: Recovery Mentor-JEFFERSON- SUD

We are seeking 2 certified Peer Support Specialist or Certified Recovery Mentor to work in our low-barrier substance use disorders program at the BHRN-Behavioral Health Regional Network. Position is located at our Madras BHRN Engagement Center which is open daily from 8 am -10 pm and shifts may include late afternoon, evening, or weekends. Come join our BHRN Team!!


JOB SUMMARY: The Peer Support Specialist will provide support and encouragement to individuals with Substance Use Disorder (SUD) in both the hospital and outpatient settings to facilitate the development of their recovery skills, provide opportunities for individuals to direct their own recovery process, and support the learning and utilization of skills needed to foster recovery. The Peer Support Specialist will be knowledgeable of available service options, will promote the utilization of natural support systems, will facilitate the development of a sense of wellness and self-worth, and will work with a treatment team to promote the goals of the person in services in accordance with BestCare’s policies and best practices, as well as the State and Federal regulations for the prevention and treatment of substance use disorders.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Works closely with other staff as a member of a treatment team to provide healthy staff-to-staff and staff-to-client relationships;
  • Provides respectful and compassionate treatment is provided to all clients who request services and acts as a role model to clients to inspire hope and share life experiences as appropriate to the recovery process;
  • Telephones contacts, which includes talking with clients who need support and to remind clients who are scheduled for assessments, groups, individual sessions, medication management appointments, and other BestCare services;
  • Identifies recovering person’s abilities, strengths and assets and assist them to recognize and use them;
  • Identifies barriers to full participation and focuses on strategies and resources to overcome them;
  • Provides recovery mentor services at the hospital and manages a case load as assigned;
  • Participates in group recovery sessions as needed;
  • Provides services within the framework of the Intentional Peer Support model;
  • Transports clients to some appointments, when appropriate, if approved by supervisor, including to/from outpatient services at BestCare, to other agencies when they need assistance with accessing benefits, and other
  • Provides referral to various services, when appropriate (i.e. Food Bank, LINC, primary care/medical services, community college, parenting, etc.);
  • Ensures that client documentation in client EHR files is completed timely, complete, reflects clinical best practices, and meets State and BestCare standards;
  • Maintains strong relationships with community partners, developing collaborative relationships whenever possible;
  • Other related duties as assigned by the Program Manager.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs work in alignment with BestCare’s mission, vision, values;
  • Supports the organization’s commitment to fostering a culture of inclusivity, open-mindedness, equity, cultural awareness, compassion, and respect for all individuals;
  • Strives to meet Program/Department goals and supports the organization’s strategic goals;
  • Adheres to the organization’s Code of Conduct, Business Ethics, Employee Handbook, and all other relevant policies, procedures, and other compliance needs;
  • Understands and maintains professionalism and confidentiality per HIPAA, 42 CFR, and Oregon Statutes;
  • Attends required program/staff meetings and completes assigned training timely and satisfactorily;
  • Ensures that any required certifications and/or licenses are kept current and renewed timely;
  • Works independently as well as participates as a positive, collaborative team member.
  • Performs other organizational duties as needed.


REQUIRED COMPETENCIES: Must have demonstrated competency or ability to attain competency for each of the following within a reasonable period:

  • Must have strong understanding of person-centered services using a recovery-oriented focus;
  • Must have good understanding trauma-informed care and the Intentional Peer Support model;
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively engage clients, provide compassionate, supportive care, and to build and maintain respectful, trusting, empathetic, and collaborative mutual relationships with clients and family members;
  • Proficiency in MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook), EHR platform, databases, virtual meeting platforms, internet, and ability to learn new or updated software;
  • Ability to maintain strict confidence as required by HIPAA, 42 CFR, and Oregon Statutes;
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills;
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written);
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through;
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines;
  • Critical thinking skills;
  • Ability to build and maintain positive relationships;
  • Ability to function well and use good judgment in a high-paced and at times stressful environment;
  • Ability to manage conflict resolution and anger/fear/hostility/violence of others appropriately and effectively;
  • Ability to work effectively and respectfully in a diverse, multi-cultural environment;
  • Ability to work independently as well as participating as a positive, collaborative team member.

3. Ensure that games are supplied with adequate and operable equipment.

title: Purchasing Agent
description:
Federal Contracts Company was founded in 2003 by Clark and Tricia Ricke to be the solution for manufacturers of heavy equipment and federal government agencies that seek to buy or rent that equipment. We are focused on keeping government procurement easy for our partners. We believe that if we take care of our team, they will take care of our customers and partner vendors.

Our Mission:
Federal Contracts Company is dedicated to producing quality contracts between manufacturers and the federal government, creating trusting relationships while being fair and profitable. We succeed by thorough follow-up, marketing, and producing lasting business partners.

We are looking for a Full-time Purchasing Agent to support our rapidly growing company!

Employment Status: Full-time, permanent, on-site

Schedule: M-F, 8am-5pm

Salary: Starting at $65,000/year, commensurate with experience

Position Summary:
The Purchasing Agent is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and coordinating the procurement of heavy equipment, machinery, parts, and related products for government and commercial customers. This position works closely with manufacturers, vendors, customers, and internal teams to obtain competitive pricing, meet contract and customer requirements, coordinate timely delivery, and maintain strong, lasting business relationships.

Key Responsibilities:
o Sources and procures heavy equipment, machinery, parts, and related products from manufacturers, distributors, and other qualified vendors.
o Reviews customer and contract requirements to identify appropriate products, specifications, pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery
requirements.
o Reviews and evaluates vendor quotations and purchasing terms to ensure pricing and procurement requirements are accurate and competitive;
assists with vendor pricing and quotation requests as needed.
o Develops and maintains strong, professional relationships with manufacturers, vendors, government customers, and other business partners.
o Processes purchase orders for both Sales and Rental operations, ensuring accuracy, required documentation, and timely submission to applicable
vendors.
o Manages Rental Purchase Order activity, including new awards, extensions, supplemental orders, fuel charges, damage charges, cancellations, and
related adjustments.
o Coordinates and maintains Proof of Delivery documentation for rental orders, including obtaining, recording, tracking, and maintaining required
supporting documentation.
o Coordinates Certificate of Insurance (COI) requests by reviewing requests, communicating required coverage or updates to the company's insurance
agent, and distributing updated certificates as needed.
o Coordinates purchase orders and procurement activities from initial quotation through delivery, including order confirmation, lead-time monitoring,
shipping, and resolution of discrepancies.
o Works closely with sales, rentals, operations, and management to communicate equipment availability, pricing, delivery schedules, and other
procurement considerations.
o Maintains accurate purchasing records, vendor information, quotations, purchase orders, and related documentation.
o Reviews purchasing documentation for accuracy and completeness and ensures assigned procurement activities and documentation comply with
applicable contract requirements and company procedures.
o Monitors market conditions, manufacturer pricing, equipment availability, supply-chain issues, and other trends that may affect procurement
decisions and customer commitments.
o Assists with government contracting and procurement activities, including documentation and vendor coordination associated with Federal
Government purchases.
o Communicates proactively with customers and vendors regarding order status, changes, delays, substitutions, and other issues that may affect
delivery or customer satisfaction.
o Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
o Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field (preferred).
o 4+ years of purchasing, procurement, equipment, machinery, sales, or related experience; experience with heavy equipment is preferred.
o Prior experience with government contracts preferred.
o Strong organizational and time management skills.
o Ability to prioritize competing customer and sales requirements, recognize time-sensitive issues, and escalate matters appropriately.
o Meticulous attention to detail to ensure data is entered accurately.
o Ability to multi-task when necessary.
o Great oral and written communication skills.
o Excellent customer service skills.
o Microsoft Office Skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
o Knowledge of state and federal laws that apply to the duties of this position.
o Ability to identify problems and recommend solutions within the scope of the position.
o Ability to read, understand, and follow oral and written instructions.
o Ability to maintain strict customer and corporate confidentiality.


We offer an excellent benefits package including medical/dental/vision coverage, PTO, 401k, annual bonus potential, and more!

Must follow all company Non-DOT Drug and Alcohol Testing Program Requirements. We are a Drug Free Workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Packaging Specialist
description:

Wherever logistics can make the biggest difference to a patient‘s life, you‘ll find us first. We aim to be the world‘s foremost group of life sciences logistics experts and we are committed to constantly pushing ourselves and the market towards new solutions for the benefit of patients. Life Couriers offers customized supply chain solutions by integrating specialized logistics services, providing a seamless customer experience. At Life Couriers, our culture is guided by our C.A.R.E. values:

  • Customer Excellence – We provide customers with a patient-focused experience, ensuring every delivery supports critical moments in patient care.
  • Accountability – We own our actions, conduct, and performance. We learn from our mistakes and are dedicated solution finders, driving the business forward with a patient-first quality emphasis.
  • Respect – Our employees are the heart of our success. We are approachable, open, and honest with each other and work collaboratively to achieve shared goals.
  • Enthusiasm – We promote a culture of engagement in what we do. We work hard but also value teamwork, knowing it will drive our future growth and help deliver outstanding patient-focused logistics solutions.

As a Packaging Specialist, crucial responsibilities include repackaging prescription drugs per FDA guidelines and utilizing material-processing requirements for packaging, warehousing, and transportation operations. They are also tasked with developing and approving packaging component specifications, conducting performance tests on package designs, and ensuring components meet quality standards.


Responsibilities:

  • Monitor the packaging email inbox and Transportation Management System for all daily order requests ensuring all go out when required.

  • Organize, track, and store incoming inventory.
  • Ensure that returned packages are reported for inventory purposes and are refurbished and stored properly.
  • Ensure that each shipment that departs the warehouse is complete and staged before the daily pick-up.
  • Perform quarterly Preventive Maintenance on our equipment to ensure they are working as intended.
  • Assemble and stage thermal packaging solutions for clinical trial and life science shipments, ensuring packaging is complete, properly labeled, and ready for operational use.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation related to packaging preparation, conditioning activities, inventory management, and quality control requirements
  • Inspect, refurbish, clean, and return packaging materials to inventory while ensuring all packaging components remain compliant and fit for reuse

$20.00–$23.00 per hour, with starting pay based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

title: I/DD Supervisor
description:
Under the supervision of the Program Manager, the Intellectual/Developmental Disabilities Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day supervision and operation of the IDD team.


QUALIFICATIONS:

Must meet OAR requirements for a CDDP supervisor:

Must have knowledge of the public service system for developmental disabilities services in Oregon and at least one of the following:

(i) Five years of experience with staff supervision.

(ii) Five years of experience in technical or professional level staff work related to developmental disabilities services.

· A bachelor’s degree or equivalent coursework in a field related to management or public administration, or a field related to developmental disabilities services may be substituted for up to three years of required experience.

· Knowledge of the public system for Developmental Disability Services in Oregon is required. Must be familiar with Oregon Administrative Rules governing services to person with intellectual/developmental disabilities. Must have a working knowledge of the public service system for intellectually or developmentally disabled adults and children in Oregon.

· Experience working with developmentally disabled individuals and cultural awareness is required.

· Must have demonstrated skills in developing cooperative and collaborative efforts with providers, families, advocates, and persons with developmental disabilities. Must have interpersonal skills necessary to assist and advocate for program participants in group and individual settings.

· Some weekly travel and specialized trainings out of area is required. A valid driver’s license is required.

· Qualified candidate must have excellent writing and computer skills.

· Satisfactory criminal history check conducted through the Oregon Department of Human Services.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

1. Support the Program Manager in daily supervision and oversight of the Jefferson County CDDP. Ensure access to and authorization of services to individuals determined eligible for I/DD services. Ensure adherence to Oregon Administrative Rules for each service element and the CDDP.

2. Provide oversight, training, and guidance to Services Coordinators. Provide direct services coordination for I/DD program participants and families, to meet program needs, as well as coordination with partner agencies. Review documentation to ensure compliance with ODDS standards and OARs.

3. Completes timely clinical documentation of services provided, reports, correspondence, and behavioral data to address the needs of a variety of agencies, including the Office of Developmental Disabilities Services (ODDS), Oregon Department of Humans Services, BestCare Treatment Services, and as required, by all applicable Oregon Administrative Rules and Oregon Revised Statutes.

4. Ensure staff is educated regarding policy and procedure changes by reviewing information from ODDS.

5. Understand eXPRS payment system sufficiently to troubleshoot issues including provider enrollment and status, eligibility, CPAs, POC, qualified encounter claims, and provider billing.

6. Ensure staff attendance at ODDS-mandated training. Maintain training documentation for required certification and ODDS QA Team reviews.

7. Work with Program Manager to ensure written policies and procedures are up to date regarding operation and management of the program as new information is provided by ODDS.

8. Respond to referrals, and ensure timely completion of intakes, requests for determination, eligibility determinations, and entry into I/DD services.

9. Ensure timely and accurate completion of Oregon Needs Assessments (ONA).

10. Ensure appropriate residential placement of individuals through the Designated Referral Coordinator system, as requested by individuals and guardians.

11. Complete training and ensure mandatory abuse reporting for adults and children.

12. Conducts all work consistent with an appropriate professional code of ethics.

13. Acts independently in the community and promotes a positive image of Jefferson County, the Intellectual/Developmental Disabilities Program, and BestCare Treatment Services.

14. Protects confidentiality and client rights of all program participants of BestCare Treatment Services at all times according to policy and procedure.

15. Regular attendance is an essential function of this position.

16. Serve as liaison between the agency and community or other County personnel; provide high-level technical information and referral expertise and service relating to the program; make presentations to community groups and provide program training to staff, volunteers, etc.

17. Performs other duties as assigned that support the overall objective of the position.

The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Consultant will provide timely reviews of patient medical records to ensure accurate and complete documentation to reflect the patient’s severity and complexity of illness. We offer an excellent salary, full benefits package including 401(k) with company match, medical, dental, vision, life, short/long term disability insurance, and PTO policy.

Sitting, talking, hearing and near vision are required over 90% of the time. Feeling is required over 90% of the time and reaching is required about 50% of the time. The ability to travel to field sites may be required up to 15% of the time.

WORKING CONDITIONS WHILE PERFORMING ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Over 90% of the time is spent indoors, with protection from weather conditions. Exposure to noise levels that may be distracting or uncomfortable is present only in unusual situations.

As a Managing Consultant, MarTech, you will own client engagements end-to-end, combining strategic consulting, technical leadership, relationship management, and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with senior marketing and growth stakeholders while remaining close enough to the technology to design solutions and challenge technical decisions. Acting as a player-coach, you’ll shape customer data and marketing technology strategies while directing engineers and implementation partners. You’ll identify opportunities for growth, connect recommendations to measurable business outcomes, and ensure solutions are delivered effectively. The role offers exposure to diverse industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America. It is ideal for an experienced consultant who enjoys moving between executive conversations, strategic problem-solving, and hands-on technical work.

Accountabilities

  • Own client engagements from initial discovery through strategy, solution design, delivery, renewal, and expansion, acting as the primary relationship owner.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and serve as the senior point of contact when clients need strategic guidance or escalation.
  • Run a consistent client cadence, including biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Maintain at least three months of planned work across each account while proactively monitoring budgets, utilization, pacing, and potential overages.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting recommendations to measurable metrics and business outcomes.
  • Develop growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients and demonstrate the commercial value of progressing toward greater levels of marketing and data maturity.
  • Design customer data and MarTech architectures spanning customer data platforms, analytics, lifecycle messaging, warehouses, and integrations.
  • Perform strategic hands-on work where needed, including taxonomy design, measurement planning, attribution modeling, segmentation logic, and quality assurance of critical implementations.
  • Direct engineers and contract developers, review their work, and ensure technical delivery meets the agreed client objectives before reaching the customer.
  • Delegate implementation work appropriately while remaining sufficiently technical to challenge estimates, identify weak solutions, and make informed architectural decisions.
  • Support pre-sales through discovery, opportunity identification, scoping, proposal development, and live presentations.
  • Build proposals covering scope, phasing, effort, investment, and business case, ensuring estimates are commercially viable and delivery expectations are realistic.
  • Partner with Sales through qualification and closing, then transition opportunities into successful delivery where appropriate.
  • Document, estimate, and secure written confirmation for all scope changes before additional work begins.
  • Drive account expansion and contribute to commercial growth across the client portfolio.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 4 years directly owning client relationships.
    • Fully fluent English, as this is the primary working language.
    • Strong understanding of the complete marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost and why.
    • Deep understanding of modern marketing technology, including advertising platforms, customer data platforms, marketing engagement tools, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Strong advisory-level expertise across MarTech systems, with the ability to recommend appropriate technologies, assess how different components connect, understand operational trade-offs, and identify when an existing technology stack can be used more effectively.
    • Ability to critically evaluate funnel reports, cohort analyses, attribution models, and other marketing analytics to challenge assumptions and connect findings to business outcomes.
    • Demonstrated track record of retaining and growing client accounts, with measurable commercial results that can be clearly explained.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, scoping, proposal development, and delivery against the solutions sold.
    • Experience with GDPR and consent management as an integral part of client engagements.
    • Strong technical depth in at least three of the following MarTech areas, with working familiarity across the others: customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, and GA4; lifecycle and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, and Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and dbt; tag management including Google Tag Manager and server-side GTM; CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot; and consent management tools such as OneTrust, Cookiebot, and Didomi.
    • Ability to combine executive-level consulting skills with practical technical knowledge and hands-on experience.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive problems through to resolution.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to balance strategy, delivery, commercial priorities, and technical challenges within the same engagement.
    • Professional working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a plus.
    • Experience managing engagements across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working with both European and North American clients is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Annual compensation of $70,000–$125,000 USD, depending on experience and location.
      • Additional bonus or commission linked to client account growth.
      • Full-time contractor engagement with direct international contracting terms.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
      • National holidays off.
      • Highly transparent working environment.
      • Significant autonomy and room to develop and implement your own ideas.
      • Opportunity to work across diverse industries, business models, and technology stacks rather than being limited to a single client environment.
      • Exposure to both European and North American markets from one role.
      • Opportunity to work with evolving customer data architectures, including warehouse-native approaches, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL.
      • Ability to combine the full commercial and delivery lifecycle of an account within a single senior role.
