title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Platform based in United States .

This role focuses on building the cloud infrastructure, internal platforms, and developer capabilities that power reliable production services.
You will work across AWS, Kubernetes, distributed systems, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, observability, and internal developer tooling.
The position combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, enabling product engineers to build, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot services more effectively.
You will identify systemic gaps and recurring engineering challenges, then turn them into scalable and reusable platform solutions.
Your work will directly influence reliability, performance, availability, maintainability, and developer productivity across production systems.
You will collaborate closely with product engineering and other technical stakeholders while leading initiatives from problem definition through adoption.
The role also includes mentoring engineers and participating in on-call and incident response within a highly collaborative engineering environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, build, and operate AWS-based cloud infrastructure and internal platform services.
  • Create reusable platform capabilities that improve how engineers develop, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot services.
  • Work across AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, observability, and distributed systems.
  • Partner with product engineering teams to identify recurring needs and translate them into scalable platform solutions.
  • Analyze interactions between systems, identify technical risks and inefficiencies, and drive improvements.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, availability, and maintainability of production infrastructure and services.
  • Establish and promote operational practices around SLOs, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness.
  • Instrument, debug, and improve services and infrastructure, including TypeScript-based services.
  • Lead complex technical initiatives from initial problem definition through implementation, delivery, and adoption.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and progress clearly to engineering stakeholders.
  • Mentor engineers and promote practices for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response activities.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or infrastructure engineering.
    • Deep hands-on experience with AWS in production environments.
    • Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and system design.
    • Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, shared services, or similar engineering enablement capabilities.
    • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code; Terraform experience is a plus.
    • Strong programming and debugging skills, particularly in production environments; TypeScript experience is a plus.
    • Experience with CI/CD systems and automated deployment workflows.
    • Strong understanding of observability practices, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and SLOs.
    • Ability to reason across complex systems and understand dependencies and interactions between multiple components.
    • Experience leading technical initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams.
    • Ability to participate in remote video interviews with the camera on, with reasonable accommodations available when required.
    • Candidates must reside in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada, as hiring for this position is currently limited to these provinces.

      • Benefits:

      • Estimated annual cash salary of CAD 123,750–165,000.
      • Eligibility for incentive stock options, subject to applicable plan terms.
      • Medical insurance.
      • Dental insurance.
      • Life, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D), and disability insurance.
      • Natural Disaster Support Program.
      • Wellness apps and resources.
      • Paid parental leave.

      • One-time work-from-home office setup stipend.
      • Retirement plan.
      • Financial planning resources.
      • Learning and development budget.
      • Remote work arrangement within eligible Canadian provinces.

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) based in Canada.

This role sits at the intersection of enterprise technology, solution architecture, and strategic sales, helping customers design reliable and scalable systems.
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, guiding organizations through complex architecture decisions and technology modernization initiatives.
Working closely with sales teams, you will lead technical discovery, demonstrations, proof-of-value activities, presentations, sizing, and solution documentation.
The role covers customers ranging from innovative startups to large enterprise organizations, providing exposure to diverse technical challenges and industries.
You will help shape multi-threaded account strategies while translating complex technical capabilities into clear business value for both technical and executive audiences.
The position also offers opportunities to work with cloud platforms, distributed systems, databases, Kubernetes, AI/ML, and modern application architectures.
You will contribute to customer success while mentoring peers and continuously developing your expertise across evolving technologies and solution patterns.

Accountabilities:

  • Design scalable, highly available, and performant applications, systems, and infrastructure for complex software environments.
  • Advise customers on architecture patterns, optimization strategies, data platforms, and modern application design.
  • Analyze existing application architectures and recommend improvements that address scalability, reliability, performance, and business requirements.
  • Partner with sales teams on account planning, opportunity qualification, prioritization, pipeline generation, and technical strategy.
  • Own the technical aspects of sales opportunities, including discovery, demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, presentations, sizing, and documentation.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with technical stakeholders, business leaders, and executive decision-makers.
  • Develop multi-threaded account strategies and coordinate internal and ecosystem resources around shared customer objectives.
  • Generate demand through technical initiatives, industry events, account-based activities, and other customer engagement opportunities.
  • Help customers modernize legacy systems and adopt scalable, efficient technology architectures.
  • Foster customer champions and support long-term satisfaction and successful technology adoption.
  • Gather field feedback and collaborate with product teams to identify opportunities for product and process improvements.
  • Mentor other solutions consulting professionals and contribute to technical knowledge sharing.
  • Stay current with cloud technologies, distributed systems, databases, AI/ML, security, and emerging architecture patterns.
  • Travel up to 25% to support customer and business engagements.

    • Requirements:

    • 8–11 years of relevant experience in customer-facing technology roles, ideally including 5–7 years in pre-sales within enterprise software.
    • At least 3 years of professional experience with modern scripting or programming languages such as Python, Node.js, SQL, C/C++, Java, or C#.
    • Proven experience designing scalable and highly available distributed systems in cloud and/or on-premises environments.
    • Demonstrated ability to assess complex application architectures and provide practical recommendations for modernization and optimization.
    • Strong understanding of enterprise software architecture, cloud technologies, data platforms, and application development.
    • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and business concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
    • Ability to collaborate strategically with sales teams and influence account direction through technical expertise and customer insight.
    • Strong relationship-building and consultative skills, with the ability to establish credibility with customers and internal stakeholders.
    • Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities and work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
    • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%.
    • Experience with database technologies and/or applications deployed on major cloud providers is an advantage.
    • Experience with data engineering, AI/ML projects, legacy modernization, or modern scalable technology stacks is preferred.
    • Familiarity with sales methodologies or frameworks such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message is a plus.
    • Database or cloud provider certifications are advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Base salary range of CAD 130,000–180,000 annually for eligible candidates based in Canada.
      • Equity opportunities.
      • Employee stock purchase program.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • 20 weeks of fully paid gender-neutral parental leave.
      • Fertility and adoption assistance.
      • RRSP with employer matching.
      • Mental health counseling.
      • Backup child and elder care.
      • Health, dental, and vision benefits.
      • Professional development and opportunities to deepen expertise across cloud, data, AI/ML, and modern architecture technologies.
      • Accessibility accommodations available throughout the recruitment and interview process.

title: Residential Aide - Safe Havens - PRN / VA Safe Havens
company: Montgomery County Coalition for the Homeless
description:
General Description: The Residential Aide is responsible for direct services to residents of the Safe Haven Program, ensuring that daily scheduled activities are carried out, and assists in meeting the basis needs of the residents. The Residential Aide should, in his/her relationship with clients and other staff, model healthy, supportive behavior and good coping skills. The Residential Aide will be required to transport clients to appointments when necessary.


THIS POSITION IS A PRN ROLE FOR OUR JOB FAIR ON October 5TH FROM 12:00 PM - 4:00 PM.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a safe, supportive environment in which residents are treated with respect and courtesy in line with trauma informed care;
  • Carrying out specific shift duties as assigned by the House Manager;
  • Monitoring the house for safety utilizing the onsite camera system and walking inspections throughout entire shift.
  • Daily cleaning activities and chores, both inside and outside the house, to ensure all areas of the site are maintained in a sanitary, well-organized, and pleasant condition.
  • Monitoring residents’ behaviors to ensure they are pro-social and abide by the house rules and policies.
  • Assisting the residents in working toward the mastering the skills necessary to live independently;
  • Ensuring that residents have all their basic supplies and needs such as toiletries, laundry detergent, including replenishing and stocking supplies;
  • Providing transportation for residents to appointments, shopping, and other destinations, as necessary;
  • Conducting daily checks of residents’ rooms and the general areas of the home for safety hazards and cleanliness, and offering encouragement, modeling, and training when needed in housekeeping skills;
  • Supervising meal preparation of residents, offering training, modeling, and assistance when needed, while fostering the individual’s development of his or her own skills and confidence;
  • Offering training, assistance, and modeling with daily living skills, to residents (e.g., personal hygiene, nutrition, laundry, use of public transportation, and socialization skills);
  • Providing a “listening” ear for residents and facilitating conflict resolution;
  • Providing emergency intervention in response to crises situations and following protocol to address emergencies to include contacting the Case Manager, Program Director, and/or calling 911 when applicable;
  • Responding appropriately to resident medical emergencies and performing crisis intervention when necessary, including, but not limited to, providing emergency first aid and CPR;
  • Monitoring residents’ administration of medication and recording in the Daily Medication Record according to policy; contacting the Case Manager or Program Director regarding serious medication errors, such as an individual taking the wrong medication, or wrong dosage of medication;
  • Documenting disruptive behavior or incidents involving police and/or emergency personnel on an Incident Report Form and submitting this form to the House Manager;
  • Monitoring and reporting to the House Manager/Case Manager noteworthy information about resident behavior or mental status;
  • Maintaining required documentation of nightly census record and of hourly log notes that document all important and relevant incidences and briefing next staff at shift change;
  • Participating in MCCH recreational activities with residents, as assigned by supervisory staff;
  • Attending mandatory scheduled staff meetings and annual MCCH Staff Retreat;
  • Representing MCCH in a positive and professional manner to resident’s families and outside organizations with whom the Residential Aide comes in contact in person or by telephone;
  • Evaluating and addressing minor household maintenance repairs and tasks.
  • Maintaining a clean staff working environment and replenishing office supplies and forms as needed;
  • Serving as the primary contact person for the house during shift; and
  • Other duties, as assigned.

title: Detailer (flat rate ) 840030 (Colorado Springs, CO)
description:
Overview

Flat Rate Detail Shop Position(s) Available.

Are you a team player who is focused on providing exemplary customer service and who performs well in a fast paced work environment?

Looking for the following position:

Detail Specialist 1 - Some experience

Detail Specialist 2 - 2 plus years experience

Maintain the facilities of the store to produce high quality service. Ensure customers are serviced at the highest level of satisfaction through quality service/products, courteous employees and quick response to all customer inquiries and/or complaints establishing conclusions in a timely manner. Driving, detailing, and cleaning vehicles.

Teph Seal Auto Appearance, a privately-held company, operates detail/reconditioning centers in auto dealerships across the United States. Our strong team of dedicated professionals is our most powerful asset, allowing us to develop dynamic detail solutions for a wide variety of auto dealerships. Our culture of challenging the status quo makes each employee a key contributor to our success and a vital part of our thriving entrepreneurial-minded company culture.

Responsibilities

The detailer will use their manual dexterity and bodily coordination to perform an array of tasks, including washing the exterior of vehicles using various cleaning solutions, may also wax and buff vehicles using cloths and buffing machines, vacuum interior of automobiles to remove dirt and debris, clean upholstery and surfaces, use air compressors and cloths to dry surfaces and apply preservation chemicals to surfaces for protection against spots and stains. May be required to use different types of dyes, paints and waxes to protect the leather or fabric of vehicles. May also be required to clean and remove grease on engines or engine compartments. Must be flexible and willing able to carry out additional duties as assigned by management due to operational needs.

Working Conditions:

  • This physically demanding position requires frequent movement; i.e. bending, lifting, reaching, squatting, and getting into and out of various vehicles repeatedly during the work shift.
  • May require completion of work outdoors and under varying climate conditions.
  • Will work with and move numerous vehicles during the course of the working day.
  • Use of safe and OSHA approved waxes and cleaners such as, window cleaner, tar remover, tire shine, etc.
  • Frequent and continual flexing of spine, hands, wrists and fingers.
  • Occasional pushing, pulling, lifting, or carrying of up to 50 lbs.
  • Constantly receiving detailed information through oral communication.
  • Clarity of vision and hearing.
  • Ability to distinguish small imperfections in your work, such as, streaks left on windows, smudges on windows or painted surfaces, areas of missed vacuuming, etc.
  • Ability to quality inspect your work as well as that of other team members.
  • Work with a sense of urgency that demonstrates the value we place on our customers' time.

  • Strict adherence to our uniform and grooming standards.

Compensation: FLAT RATE

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have

  • A valid driver's license and a good driving record.
  • Ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work as part of a team.
  • Ability to read and comprehend instructions

  • Desire to treat each customer’s personal vehicle with great care and respect

  • The willingness to come to work on time and stay on task when on the clock

  • The ability to drive both automatic and manual shift vehicles

  • The availability to work Saturday or Sunday and holidays as deemed necessary to meet production needs
  • Commitment to report to work on time and stay on task during shift

Teph Seal is a Drug-Free Workplace. All employment is contingent on successful completion of drug and background screening.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package and all the tools necessary to be successful. Our offerings include: Medical, Dental, Vision Plans, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off and 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match.

We provide a collaborative work place with growth opportunities for career minded individuals.

title: Head of Data & AI
description:
We make some of the world's hardest materials: synthetic diamond and tungsten carbide. Our products are found anywhere from surgical tools and semiconductors to the machinery that helps build and maintain infrastructure.

Behind that sits a business that runs on data, and increasingly on AI.

As our new Head of Data and AI, you'll lead the next stage of that journey, reporting directly to the Head of IT and Digital Transformation and shaping how data, analytics and AI create value across the organisation.

This is a global role supporting 24/7 manufacturing operations across six factories, so the data and AI you deliver has to work around the clock.

You’ll own our data platform, our analytics and AI products, and the cloud compute that powers them.

Leading a high-performing team of four you'll set the direction for how E6 turns data into better decisions, whether that's optimising manufacturing processes on the shop floor, accelerating innovation in R&D, or improving efficiency across corporate support functions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll shape strategy and still care about how the pipelines run.

  • Own the E6 data and AI strategy end to end, from a single source of truth through to AI products that people actually use day to day.
  • Lead and grow a team of four across data engineering, analytics, and AI, setting priorities and building capability.
  • Run our cloud compute estate globally. You’ll own capacity, cost, performance, and security for the platforms our data and AI workloads depend on, with the resilience that 24/7 manufacturing demands.
  • Deliver governed, real-time data foundations across all six factories: trusted datasets, shared definitions, master data, and quality controls that reporting and AI can rely on.
  • Take AI from pilot to embedded, with clear use cases, measurable value, and guardrails for responsible use.
  • Set and enforce data governance, ethics, and privacy standards in line with our Data Trust and Integrity framework and relevant regulation.
  • Work with senior stakeholders across E6 and De Beers to make the case for investment and show the return.

We’ve mapped this role to the Government Digital and Data (DDaT) Capability Framework so expectations are clear. You’ll bring:

  • Data and AI leadership (expert): a track record of setting data vision and direction, and being the strategic authority people turn to.
  • Data governance and ethics (practitioner): you’ve built the standards, not just followed them.
  • Data engineering and platforms (practitioner): you understand pipelines, APIs, and how to build for scale, and can hold your own with the engineers.
  • Machine learning and applied AI (practitioner): you know where models add value, and where they don’t.
  • Cloud compute (practitioner): hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure (Azure and Databricks), covering cost, capacity, resilience, and security.
  • Stakeholder leadership (expert): you can convince a CFO of the value and explain the same thing to a plant manager.
  • People leadership: you’ve led and developed technical teams, ideally across multiple sites or time zones.

Right to work

All applicants must be able to provide documentation verifying their eligibility to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship is not provided for this role.

title: Program Manager, Marine Facilities (Alaska Railroad)
description:
Job Description

PURPOSE OF POSITION: Primary responsibility is to oversee the capital projects associated with the ARRC waterfront facilities, including the execution of large multi-project programs spanning multiple years and funding sources.

Provides oversight, direction, and coordination of work performed on assigned, high-profile projects, funded by federal and state grants, external capital, or internal capital funds. This includes organizing the work, ensuring a safe working environment, overseeing and directing ARRC employees and contractors working on assigned projects, approving changes to Contracts, and approving completed work. Ensures proper documentation is submitted for third party projects and disburses that information to ARRC personnel, or contractors, as necessary.

Assists department managers in developing plans for assigned projects. A project plan may include: formulating project concepts; developing goals, scopes, schedules, and cost estimates; assessing risks; and determining financing requirements. Analyzes options and identifies opportunities for performance improvements.

Coordinates project plans for assigned projects with appropriate departments within ARRC.

Coordinates with the Supply Management Department to ensure all materials and/or services needed for assigned projects funded by federal and state grants, or internal capital funds, are delivered as required and/or specified in contractual agreements. Reviews and approves invoices for payment.

Manages and directs other Project Managers on specific projects within the program as assigned

Plans, develops and maintains program planning, budgets and grant applications over a minimum 5-year time period.

Coordinates with the grant administration staff to ensure all financing procedures are properly followed to include, but not limited to, reporting requirements. Responsible for completion of assigned projects within approved budgetary amounts.

Provides written and oral updates on assigned projects funded by federal grants to ARRC representatives as well as federal, state, and community groups as required. Organizes meetings such as public hearings as required to accomplish project plan goals and deadlines.

FACTOR 1: Technical and Operational Knowledge

Requires thorough knowledge of engineering and construction principles, practices, and specifications for projects within the program’s discipline project management principles and practices. Requires thorough knowledge of applicable industry codes and regulations; budgeting and cost-control methods; procurement practices and regulations; and spreadsheets (Excel), word processing, email, and scheduling software. Requires knowledge of and experience with architectural, engineering, environmental, NEPA, construction contracts; value engineering; project scheduling; and contractual oversight.

FACTOR 2: Analytical Skills & Impact

Requires familiarity with procurement processes, budgets, cost-control methods, and value engineering to ensure materials and services are delivered as specified and that costs are controlled, monitored, and reported in accordance with ARRC Finance and grant reporting procedures. Must be able to manage, oversee, and direct all phases of assigned projects, including assessing options and identifying opportunities to improve performance and reduce costs. Delivering a high-quality final product and making sound mid-project decisions that support long-term economic feasibility are essential to ARRC. Failure to follow project timelines, architectural, engineering, and environmental review requirements, budgets, ongoing expense controls, and procurement processes could significantly hinder successful project completion and delivery. Strong written communication skills are preferred.


FACTOR 3: Supervision and Control

Manages assigned project work, including oversight and direction of ARRC employees and contractors. Coordinates the resources needed for successful project completion, including workforce needs, contract services, and materials. Responsible for delivering assigned projects within approved budgets.

FACTOR 4: Communication

Communicates with ARRC employees at all organizational levels and across departments to coordinate all phases of assigned projects. Works with contractors to ensure project work is completed as required and in accordance with contractual agreements. Coordinates with federal, state, and local agencies to ensure assigned projects meet applicable regulatory requirements. Provides informational presentations to ARRC officials and interested community groups.

FACTOR 5: Working Conditions

Work location will be in a corporate office environment and at construction sites, which may be located a significant distance from the office for extended periods. The position may involve exposure to harsh weather conditions and noise.

Will be required to drive on an as needed basis.



Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, civil engineering, or discipline related to the specific program is required.

Substitution: Associate’s degree in construction management, civil engineering, or a related discipline, and five additional years of project/construction management experience can substitute for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

Work Experience

Must have ten (10) years of project/construction management experience working with architectural, engineering, environmental, NEPA, value engineering, and construction contracts for marine facilities.

Certification/License Requirements

Must have a valid driver’s license.

Must possess, or have the ability to obtain, a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC®) card. If you do not possess a TWIC card, you must apply to obtain it within 60 days of hire.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience and managerial control with alternative project delivery methods (DB, DBOM, CMGC, etc.)

title: Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer based in Spain.

This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of databases, developer tooling, integrations, and open source.
You’ll help build and maintain drivers, adapters, migration tools, and integrations that make a distributed time-series database easier to use across modern data ecosystems.
Your work will connect database technology with widely used tools and frameworks across analytics, data engineering, observability, and application development.
You’ll collaborate closely with experienced engineers and contribute to projects that are developed transparently in public GitHub repositories.
The position offers broad technical ownership, with opportunities to work across multiple programming languages, protocols, frameworks, and infrastructure environments.
You’ll also engage directly with open source communities and technology partners to improve integrations and solve real-world developer challenges.
It’s a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving existing software, and shipping high-quality technology used by other developers.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain database drivers and adapters, including JDBC and Python/SQLAlchemy integrations.
  • Build and improve connections between the database platform and external tools such as Grafana, Tableau, and Airflow.
  • Develop and maintain internal administrative tooling, including command-line utilities and administration interfaces.
  • Improve PostgreSQL compatibility and strengthen integration capabilities across the wider database ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain migration tools supporting movement between different database systems and storage formats.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including reference architectures, integration examples, and implementation guidance.
  • Collaborate with open source communities and technical partners on joint projects and ecosystem integrations.
  • Work directly with product managers to translate technical needs into clear requirements and feasible solutions.
  • Take ownership of existing codebases, continuously improving their quality, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Debug complex technical issues across different components and systems, taking a full-stack approach where necessary.
  • Ensure software components are thoroughly tested, documented, communicated, packaged, and successfully delivered.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience as a software engineer, with the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from development through delivery.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
    • Good working knowledge of Python and Java, with experience in additional languages such as Rust, C++, Go, Swift, or Zig considered an advantage.
    • Understanding of technical standards, protocols, and APIs, particularly technologies such as HTTP, PostgreSQL Wire Protocol, Python DB API, and JDBC.
    • Experience with Test-Driven Development and a strong commitment to software quality.
    • Knowledge of software versioning, packaging, distribution, and deployment in polyglot software environments.
    • Understanding of how software components are operated and maintained in production environments.
    • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across multiple layers of a system.
    • A self-directed, hands-on mindset and the ability to overcome technical and organizational obstacles to move projects forward.
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, open source contributors, and external technical partners.
    • A genuine interest in open source software and collaborative development practices.
    • Existing open source contributions are a plus, but are not required.
    • Experience with message-bus technologies such as AMQP, Kafka, MQTT, or ZeroMQ and their broker implementations is desirable.
    • Knowledge of or experience with DevOps practices and containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Competitive compensation.
      • Flexible working hours designed to support autonomy and work-life balance.
      • Flexible holiday arrangements.
      • Fitness and wellness-related perks.
      • Education and professional development benefits.

      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on challenging database and ecosystem projects.

      • An open, collaborative, and internationally distributed working environment.
      • Opportunities to take ownership of projects and contribute to the evolution of database technology.

title: Account Director, Client Solutions
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Client Solutions based in Switzerland.

As an Account Director, Client Solutions, you will own a portfolio of strategic client relationships from discovery through delivery, renewal, and expansion. You’ll serve as the senior commercial and strategic point of contact for executive stakeholders, helping clients turn customer data into measurable revenue growth. The role combines consulting, account leadership, commercial ownership, and project direction without requiring you to be the hands-on technical builder. You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. This is a high-ownership opportunity for an experienced client leader who can connect strategy, technology, and commercial outcomes.

Accountabilities

  • Own the executive-level relationship across a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary strategic contact for senior marketing and growth stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain a strong client cadence through biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews covering results, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Keep clients proactively informed about progress, budgets, timelines, risks, and decisions, ensuring there are no unexpected developments.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting each challenge to the relevant customer pain, metric, business impact, and potential solution.
  • Build and defend growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients, using measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle strategies, experimentation roadmaps, and performance readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions and recommendations into clear business implications that executive stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Scope projects and translate client requirements into sufficiently detailed briefs for architects and engineers, while remaining accountable for the quality and business relevance of the final outcome.
  • Lead project execution through sprint cadence, board management, dependencies, risks, timelines, and critical-path oversight rather than performing the technical implementation yourself.
  • Review completed work against agreed client objectives before delivery and ensure commitments are fulfilled to the expected standard.
  • Run pre-sales discovery, qualify opportunities, develop proposals, and present scope, phasing, investment, and business cases directly to prospective clients.
  • Partner with Sales throughout qualification, discovery, and closing before taking ownership of the account during delivery.
  • Price and scope technical work with profitability and delivery feasibility in mind.
  • Own retention and expansion across your portfolio, ensuring scope changes are estimated, documented, and approved before work begins.
  • Maintain a six-month forward roadmap so future engagements can be planned and contracted before existing scopes come to an end.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 5 years owning senior client relationships with direct revenue responsibility.
    • Fully fluent English, combined with professional working proficiency in at least one additional European language such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
    • Strong understanding of the full marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost between stages.
    • Solid understanding of how marketing technology supports modern marketing operations, including advertising, customer data platforms, marketing engagement, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Advisory-level knowledge of modern marketing and customer data technologies, with the ability to assess technology choices, understand trade-offs, evaluate how systems work together, and challenge poor technical recommendations without being responsible for configuration or coding.
    • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and data-driven approaches for improving marketing performance and returns.
    • Demonstrated success retaining and expanding client accounts, ideally supported by measurable commercial results.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, qualification, scoping, proposal development, and presenting solutions to executive buyers.
    • Experience scoping and pricing technical work in a way that balances client value, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
    • Understanding of how European businesses purchase, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent requirements.
    • Advisory command of customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4; lifecycle tools such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, or Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt; tag management; CRM; and consent management platforms.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive issues through to resolution.
    • Excellent strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to balance client value, delivery quality, account health, and profitability.
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, particularly with senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an environment where consulting, delivery, and business development can compete for attention.
    • Experience working with clients across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working across both European and North American client portfolios is a plus.
    • Experience building or helping establish a regional practice is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
      • National holidays off.
      • Highly transparent working environment with clear visibility into business and client objectives.
      • Significant autonomy and room to develop and act on your own ideas.
      • Opportunity to own the full commercial lifecycle of client accounts, from initial discovery through renewal and expansion.
      • Exposure to a broad range of industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America.
      • Opportunity to advise clients on emerging customer data architectures, including warehouse-native approaches, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL.
      • The chance to work across the full customer data and revenue operations ecosystem rather than being tied to a single platform or vendor.

title: Product Analyst / Business Analyst (Home Care Domain Expert)
description:
Product Analyst / Business Analyst (Home Care Domain Expert)

Position Overview

We are looking for a Home based care industry veteran to join our team as a Product Owner/ Business Analyst. In this role, you will bridge the gap between real-world caregiving and software development. We are building the next generation of software for home-based care agencies, and we need your hands-on expertise to ensure our tools work seamlessly for the people who use them every day.

You will use your first-hand knowledge of agency workflows to define product features, write requirements for our development team, and serve as our internal subject matter expert (SME). Prior experience working in home health, personal care, or care coordination is strictly required. Software development or formal project management experience is a nice-to-have.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate Field Experience into Features: Use your knowledge of home care operations to define, document, and prioritize user-friendly software features and requirements for our engineering team.
  • Manage the Product Backlog: Maintain and organize the list of software enhancements, updates, and defect fixes for the development team.
  • Bridge Communication: Work closely with software developers to ensure they understand the daily realities of home health workers, resulting in practical, efficient applications.
  • Create Support Materials: Write clear, accessible User Guides and Implementation Guides to help agencies adopt our software.
  • Support the Sales Team: Act as the product Subject Matter Expert (SME) during pre- and post-sales activities to help potential clients understand the value of our solution.
  • Process Improvement: Collaborate with active business users to understand their current workflows, suggest improvements, and design new software features that solve their pain points.
  • Project Coordination: Oversee the development lifecycle and provide basic project coordination from initial feature design through post-production rollout.

Qualifications

  • Required: Minimum of 2-3 years of professional experience within a Home Health, Personal Care, or Home-Based Care Agency.
  • Required: First-hand experience in roles such as Home Health Aide (HHA), Care Coordinator, Scheduler, Billing Specialist, or multi-department agency operations.
  • Required: Deep, practical understanding of home health business processes, caregiver workflows, and industry challenges.
  • Preferred: Prior experience using Home Health Software/EMR platforms (e.g., AlayaCare, HHAeXchange, Homecare Homebase, KanTime).
  • Nice-to-Have: Previous exposure to software development environments, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Business Analysis, or Project Management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a healthcare, business, or related field is preferred, but equivalent hands-on agency management experience is highly valued.

Pay

  • Based on experience. Beginning at $60,000 annually and increases with skill-level and proven work history

title: Human Resource Administrator
description:
Position Summary

The Human Resources Administrator provides administrative and operational support across a broad range of Human Resources functions. The position works closely with the Human Resources Manager to support employee programs, recruitment and onboarding, compliance, employee relations, benefits, training, reporting, and other HR initiatives.

This role serves as a resource for employees and managers by responding to HR-related questions, maintaining accurate and confidential employee information, and helping ensure HR programs and processes are administered consistently, accurately, and in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Payroll Administration

  • Support the bi-weekly payroll process performed by a TPA, ensuring employee information, earnings, deductions, time records, and other payroll-related data are accurate and complete.
  • Review and maintain employee PTO balances and assist with resolving payroll and timekeeping discrepancies.
  • Generate and review bi-weekly payroll reports and other payroll-related reports as required.
  • Respond to employee and management inquiries regarding payroll, timecards, PTO, deductions, and related matters.
  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation and records in accordance with company procedures.

Benefits and Retirement Plan Administration

  • Assist with the administration of company-sponsored employee benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D, long-term disability, retirement plans, and other applicable benefit programs.
  • Process employee benefit enrollments, changes, and terminations, including applicable COBRA-related updates and documentation.
  • Audit monthly benefit invoices for accuracy and coordinate corrections as necessary.
  • Maintain annual benefit plan and enrollment information within Paycom based on available plan offerings and employee elections.
  • Maintain accurate employee Life & AD&D and Long-Term Disability coverage information, including updates resulting from hires, terminations, salary changes, and other qualifying events.
  • Prepare 401(k) contribution reports, including employee deferrals, loan repayments, employer matching contributions, and other required information.
  • Upload 401(k) contribution files to the retirement plan provider for processing and assist with related compliance reporting as needed.

HR Administration and HRIS

  • Provide general administrative and operational support to the Human Resources department.
  • Assist with the administration of HR policies, procedures, programs, and practices.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, secure, and confidential employee personnel files and HR records.
  • Prepare HR documents, correspondence, reports, forms, and other employee-related materials.
  • Enter, maintain, and audit employee information within the HRIS and other HR systems to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain HR training records, documents, procedures, and manuals.
  • Maintain and update company job descriptions.
  • Complete written employment verifications as requested and in accordance with company procedures.
  • Coordinate and maintain the employee exit interview process and related records.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc HR reports as requested.
  • Perform general administrative duties, including filing, copying, tracking, mailing, maintaining records, and ordering HR-related materials and supplies.

Recruitment and Onboarding

  • Support recruitment activities, including job postings, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, assessments, and coordination of pre-employment requirements.
  • Coordinate requests for background checks, drug screenings, and other applicable pre-employment processes.
  • Prepare offer letters and other employment documentation.
  • Coordinate and conduct new hire onboarding activities, including reviewing company policies and benefit programs and collecting required new hire documentation.
  • Ensure new hire information is accurately and timely entered into applicable HRIS.

Employee Relations, Compliance and HR Programs

  • Assist with employee relations matters and help address routine workplace questions and concerns, escalating matters to the Human Resources Manager when appropriate.
  • Support administration of Workers' Compensation matters in accordance with company Risk Management procedures, including required documentation and follow-up.
  • Support unemployment claims by completing necessary forms and providing requested information.
  • Assist in maintaining HR practices and records consistent with applicable federal, state, and local employment requirements and company policies.
  • Coordinate schedules and maintain records for HR projects, employee meetings, training and development programs, and other HR initiatives.
  • Assist with compensation-related communications and documentation, including merit increases, promotions, incentive payments, profit sharing, and Safe Harbor contributions, as applicable.

Employee Engagement and Company Programs

  • Coordinate employee recognition programs and global recognition award orders.
  • Coordinate Dreamwall presentations, including poster framing and requests for installation.
  • Prepare presentations and supporting materials for All Employee Meetings based on the established meeting agenda.
  • Support other employee engagement, recognition, and company culture initiatives as assigned.

Organizational Support

  • Support initiatives that reinforce SDC's Vision, Mission, and Values.
  • Build effective working relationships across the organization through professional communication, collaboration, respect, integrity, and personal accountability.
  • Demonstrate a high degree of accuracy, attention to detail, organization, confidentiality, and professionalism.
  • Effectively prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities and deadlines in a collaborative work environment.
  • Perform other Human Resources duties, projects, and responsibilities as assigned.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Location: Onsite at a government site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area
Type: Full-time, W-2
Compensation: $80,000–$130,000 annually, depending on experience and assignment
Experience: Approximately 1–5 years of relevant experience; we are hiring at multiple levels

One posting, several possible routes. Via Logic is hiring for multiple openings at different experience levels. Your work may focus on network defenses, security platforms, system hardening, access controls, or integrating security tools across an environment. The broad experience and compensation ranges reflect the different openings; we will explore where your strengths fit best.

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

These openings support CBP work. Applicants must:

  • Be U.S. citizens.
  • Be able to complete the CBP suitability process and receive a favorable determination before starting the assignment. The process includes a background investigation and review of credit history.
  • Meet any additional clearance requirement for the specific opening. Some assignments may require a Secret or Top Secret clearance, and specialized assignments may require SCI eligibility. We will confirm the requirement as we match candidates to openings.

Your Mission

  • Configure, maintain, and improve security controls across systems, applications, or networks.
  • Help implement and troubleshoot tools such as firewalls, intrusion detection, endpoint protection, access controls, or security monitoring platforms, depending on the assignment.
  • Work with system owners to address vulnerabilities, strengthen configurations, and verify that improvements are working as intended.
  • Support incident investigation and remediation when the systems or controls you manage are involved.
  • Integrate security tools and processes with the teams that operate the environment, keeping reliability and mission needs in view.
  • Document configurations, changes, procedures, and recommendations so teammates can build on your work.

What You Bring to the Expedition

  • Approximately 1–5 years of relevant experience in security engineering, network or systems engineering with a security focus, or a related technical field. We will consider the depth of your work alongside your years of experience.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, administering, or improving at least one security technology or control.
  • Familiarity with some of the following: network security, firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, identity and access, system hardening, vulnerability remediation, application security, cloud security, or logging.
  • The ability to diagnose a problem, work with technical partners on a fix, and verify the result.
  • The ability to work onsite in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

Experience in adjacent application, cloud, or network security specialties is welcome. Specific technologies and duties vary by assignment; you do not need to have worked with every control listed here.

Why Explorers Stay

  • Healthcare coverage and paid time off that give you room to take care of life outside work.
  • Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help each other grow.
  • Opportunities to deepen your specialty and explore adjacent areas of cybersecurity as new assignments open up.
  • Meaningful work protecting systems that support a federal mission.

How We Work

title: Scientist II/Senior Scientist, Solid-State Materials
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Scientist II/Senior Scientist on the Vacuum Synthesis team at Lila Sciences, you will advance the design and synthesis of functional inorganic solid-state materials in support of Lila's autonomous science platform. You will design and execute multi-step preparations across diverse chemical systems, turning phase-diagram and crystal-chemistry reasoning into prioritized synthesis pathways and experimental feedback. You will partner with other synthetic materials scientists, characterization scientists, ML researchers, and systems engineers to close the synthesis-characterization-modeling loop and accelerate Lila's path to scientific superintelligence in functional materials.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design and execute synthesis campaigns across multiple chemical systems and structure families, drawing on the breadth of solid-state preparative chemistry (melt routes, flux, vapor transport, soft-chemical, topochemical, single-crystal growth, and unconventional or high-pressure environments as the target phase demands).
  • Translate phase-diagram, crystal-chemistry, and structure-property reasoning into concrete, prioritized synthesis pathways for novel functional inorganic compounds.
  • Access metastable and kinetically trapped phases through appropriate low-temperature and soft-chemical routes.
  • Work with the characterization team to develop routine and specialized structural characterization workflows (powder XRD, phase ID, refinement) for materials identification and quality control.
  • Take synthesized materials through to functional property screening (magnetic, transport, optical, or related) in partnership with the characterization team and use the resulting data to refine target selection and synthesis design.
  • Partner with materials simulation scientists, ML researchers, and systems engineers to integrate synthesis outputs into closed-loop, AI-guided experimental workflows.
  • Develop and document robust protocols for air- and moisture-sensitive precursors, controlled-atmosphere processing, and post-synthetic workup in a highly automated lab environment.
  • Maintain rigorous laboratory records and uphold safety and regulatory standards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • PhD in Solid-State Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related field, with 1–5 years of postdoctoral or industry experience.
  • A documented portfolio of novel inorganic compounds spanning multiple chemical systems.
  • Hands-on proficiency across multiple inorganic synthesis modalities, with comfort selecting the right approach for a given target phase.
  • Demonstrated experience performing materials synthesis campaigns driven by functional property targets (e.g., magnetism, nonlinear optical response, exotic charge transport, or related phenomena).
  • Strong working command of complex multicomponent and multidimensional phase diagrams and the structural-chemistry principles that govern phase formation and stability.
  • Deep proficiency in X-ray diffraction and scattering techniques, including quantitative phase analysis and Rietveld refinement.
  • Fluency working across multimodal characterization (e.g., diffraction, magnetometry, transport, spectroscopy, microscopy) to inform synthesis decisions and iteration.
  • Effective written and verbal communication, with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.

Bonus Points For

  • Demonstrated depth in one or more functional inorganic material classes.
  • Experience with single-crystal growth, particularly metallic flux, with additional methods (vapor transport, Bridgman, floating zone) welcome.
  • Experience with metallurgical processing techniques for densification and sample conditioning (e.g., sintering, hot pressing, spark plasma sintering, arc melting, controlled annealing).
  • Experience with neutron scattering, pair distribution function (PDF), or other local-structure techniques for solving structure and ordering in disordered or metastable phases.
  • Comfort with inert-atmosphere handling (glovebox, Schlenk) and air- or moisture-sensitive chemistries.
  • Exposure to high-pressure or otherwise unconventional preparative environments.
  • Familiarity with thin-film or vacuum-based deposition techniques and how they fit alongside bulk synthesis.
  • Proficiency in Python or similar tools for data analysis and workflow automation.
  • Exposure to automated, high-throughput, or autonomous laboratory environments.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$126,000—$198,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

title: Operations Data Analyst
description:
• Help our business make more informed, data driven decisions

  • Turn data into actionable insights that influence operational performance and strategic priorities

  • Flexible hybrid working, an attractive salary, annual bonus and insurance benefits

Partners Life is one of New Zealand’s largest life and health insurance companies. As part of the Daiichi Life Group, a leading global insurance provider, we are writing our next chapter of growth and opportunity.

We know the industry needs bold thinkers and passionate people to help reshape the future of insurance, and that is exactly who we are looking for. We are committed to doing things differently, lifting industry standards, challenging the status quo, and delivering real value through innovation and personalised advice.

If you are looking to join a company that’s redefining the insurance landscape and backed by the strength of a global group, Partners Life is the place to grow your career and make a real impact.

About the opportunity

We are on a journey of growth and transformation, and we are looking for an experienced Operations Data Analyst to join our newly established Service Enablement team within Operations. You will shape how we use data to understand performance, identify opportunities, and make better decisions across our operational value streams.

You will work closely with operational leaders, Value Leads, customer-facing teams, and specialist partners to develop meaningful measures, reporting, dashboards, and analytical insights.

Additionally, you will play an important role in building a stronger data led culture across Operations by translating complex information into clear recommendations, helping stakeholders understand what is happening, why it is happening, and where to focus next.

As our Operations Data Analyst, you will:

  • Partner with leaders and teams to design, develop and continuously improve operational, customer and value stream measures and provide trusted analytical advice

  • Create dashboards, reports and analytical views and translate them into clear recommendations and compelling data stories that support decision-making

  • Analyse trends, root causes, performance drivers, risks and improvement opportunities across operational processes and customer journeys

  • Establish performance baselines, track benefits and support post-implementation analysis of change initiatives

  • Promote strong data quality, governance standards and reporting consistency for operations, operating within the enterprise governance and data and reporting frameworks.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities and helping prioritise improvement activity

  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by validating operational data, reporting outputs and business requirements for planned changes

  • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, evidence-based decision-making and operational excellence

About you

You are naturally curious, analytical and commercially minded. You enjoy exploring complex data, identifying patterns and trends, and helping others make sense of data.

You are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders and know how to adapt your communication style to different audiences. Besides your data analytical skills, you can also translate complex information into simple, practical recommendations that people can understand and act on.

Attributes that help you succeed in this role:

  • Previous experience in insurance or financial services is desirable but not essential

  • Proven experience in data analytics and developing dashboards, reports and visualisations using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, Tableau or similar

  • Understanding of KPI design, performance measurement and benefits tracking

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills

  • An understanding of data governance, reporting standards and data quality principles

  • A continuous improvement mindset and a passion for helping organisations make better decisions

What we offer

At Partners Life, we believe our people are our greatest asset and are proud to invest in their growth, wellbeing and success. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits, with eligibility varying by benefit and employment type:

  • Comprehensive training and ongoing support

  • Genuine learning and development opportunities

  • Participation in our discretionary bonus scheme after 12 months’ service (permanent employees only)

  • Life insurance and income protection cover at our cost, plus discounted medical insurance (permanent employees only)

  • Birthday leave (where eligible)

  • Long service leave (permanent employees only)

  • Parental leave salary top-up, reduced hours options and secondary parental leave (permanent employees only)

  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements (where eligible)

  • A modern office with stunning views in the heart of Takapuna

Apply now!

If this sounds like the opportunity you’ve been waiting for, APPLY online with your CV and cover letter (optional) highlighting your relevant skills and experience.

To be eligible to apply for this role, you must have the legal right to work in New Zealand.

We are not engaging recruitment agencies for this role.

title: Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer based in Germany.

This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of databases, developer tooling, integrations, and open source.
You’ll help build and maintain drivers, adapters, migration tools, and integrations that make a distributed time-series database easier to use across modern data ecosystems.
Your work will connect database technology with widely used tools and frameworks across analytics, data engineering, observability, and application development.
You’ll collaborate closely with experienced engineers and contribute to projects that are developed transparently in public GitHub repositories.
The position offers broad technical ownership, with opportunities to work across multiple programming languages, protocols, frameworks, and infrastructure environments.
You’ll also engage directly with open source communities and technology partners to improve integrations and solve real-world developer challenges.
It’s a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving existing software, and shipping high-quality technology used by other developers.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain database drivers and adapters, including JDBC and Python/SQLAlchemy integrations.
  • Build and improve connections between the database platform and external tools such as Grafana, Tableau, and Airflow.
  • Develop and maintain internal administrative tooling, including command-line utilities and administration interfaces.
  • Improve PostgreSQL compatibility and strengthen integration capabilities across the wider database ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain migration tools supporting movement between different database systems and storage formats.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including reference architectures, integration examples, and implementation guidance.
  • Collaborate with open source communities and technical partners on joint projects and ecosystem integrations.
  • Work directly with product managers to translate technical needs into clear requirements and feasible solutions.
  • Take ownership of existing codebases, continuously improving their quality, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Debug complex technical issues across different components and systems, taking a full-stack approach where necessary.
  • Ensure software components are thoroughly tested, documented, communicated, packaged, and successfully delivered.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience as a software engineer, with the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from development through delivery.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
    • Good working knowledge of Python and Java, with experience in additional languages such as Rust, C++, Go, Swift, or Zig considered an advantage.
    • Understanding of technical standards, protocols, and APIs, particularly technologies such as HTTP, PostgreSQL Wire Protocol, Python DB API, and JDBC.
    • Experience with Test-Driven Development and a strong commitment to software quality.
    • Knowledge of software versioning, packaging, distribution, and deployment in polyglot software environments.
    • Understanding of how software components are operated and maintained in production environments.
    • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across multiple layers of a system.
    • A self-directed, hands-on mindset and the ability to overcome technical and organizational obstacles to move projects forward.
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, open source contributors, and external technical partners.
    • A genuine interest in open source software and collaborative development practices.
    • Existing open source contributions are a plus, but are not required.
    • Experience with message-bus technologies such as AMQP, Kafka, MQTT, or ZeroMQ and their broker implementations is desirable.
    • Knowledge of or experience with DevOps practices and containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Competitive compensation.
      • Flexible working hours designed to support autonomy and work-life balance.
      • Flexible holiday arrangements.
      • Fitness and wellness-related perks.
      • Education and professional development benefits.
      • Participation in an Employee Stock Options Plan.
      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on challenging database and ecosystem projects.
      • Exposure to a broad open source technology ecosystem and opportunities to collaborate with external technical communities.
      • An open, collaborative, and internationally distributed working environment.
      • Opportunities to take ownership of projects and contribute to the evolution of database technology.
      • A diverse and inclusive workplace that values different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Command Center & Loss Prevention Supervisor - Winter 26-27
description:
The Command Center & Loss Prevention Supervisor partners with the Mountain Sales & Schools management team to safeguard revenue and system integrity across Mountain Sales operations. This role monitors real-time gate scan activity, investigates irregular scan behavior and potential pass fraud, and coordinates with Lift Operations, IT, and frontline teams to resolve access issues. The Supervisor supports and coaches’ staff while serving as the central point of contact for incident intake, escalation, and reporting. This position reports to the Mountain Sales Director of Operations with dual reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales & Reservations.

  • The budgeted salary range for this position is $60,416 - $70,416 . Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience, all our salaried roles are eligible for bonus.
  • Applications for this position will be considered on a rolling basis.

Essential Job Functions / Key Job Responsibilities

  • Provide supervision and support to agents within the Mountain Sales & Schools team to ensure consistent delivery of exceptional guest service and achievement of goals
  • Model and uphold exemplary customer service standards to foster a guest-focused and sales-driven team culture
  • Manage employee workflow and create effective team schedules that optimize guest service coverage and sales opportunities
  • Develop and maintain reporting processes, dashboards, and documentation to support operational visibility and risk mitigation
  • Gain working knowledge of all Mountain Sales systems including access gates, self-service kiosks, reservation platforms, and training tools to support seamless guest transactions and sales flow
  • Monitor real-time gate scan data across all mountains to identify irregular activity, system errors, and potential misuse; escalate and resolve issues in coordination with Mountain Sales & Schools, Lift Operations, IT
  • Conduct investigations into potential fraud, unauthorized pass use, and irregular scan behavior, documenting findings and presenting to leadership
  • Analyze team performance metrics to identify sales trends and guest feedback, providing actionable insights to management and training teams
  • Address and resolve guest issues promptly and professionally while communicating outcomes to relevant parties to ensure guest loyalty and retention
  • Develop strong working relationships with key personnel to enhance interdepartmental communication and collaboration that benefits guest experience and operational success
  • Demonstrate flexibility to work across multiple locations as business needs require to maintain consistent guest service and sales support
  • Other duties as assigned

Education & Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, or related field preferred
  • Minimum of three years of professional experience required; mountain operations, sales, or related ski industry experience preferred
  • Minimum of one year of experience in a supervisory or lead role preferred
  • Minimum of one year experience using RTP, gate systems, or access systems required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong computer proficiency including typing skills and ability to navigate multiple computer systems required to support efficient monitoring and investigation
  • Familiarity with Resort Technology Partners (RTP) software a plus for smooth ticketing operations and investigation
  • Money handling experience with US currency required ensuring accuracy and trust in guest transactions required
  • Basic understanding of point-of-sale (POS) systems required to facilitate quick and accurate processing

  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills required to resolve guest issues promptly and maintain sales accuracy
  • Familiarity with loss prevention, auditing, fraud detection, or investigative processes a plus to support proactive identification and resolution of irregular activity
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment to sustain excellent guest service and sales flow
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team required to deliver consistent guest experiences and meet sales goals
  • Ability to handle guest inquiries and resolve issues with professionalism and tact preferred to ensure guest satisfaction and loyalty
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing operational needs and guest demands preferred to maintain seamless sales and service delivery

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Ability to be on your feet, kneel and bend for extended periods of time
  • Regularly work in adverse conditions and requiring the use of protective apparel/equipment to prevent exposure to the elements as well as an office environment and may be required to walk on slippery and uneven surfaces

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Germany.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a product area end-to-end, from identifying customer problems through discovery, prioritization, delivery, and measurement. You’ll shape the roadmap independently, using direct customer insights and evidence to determine what matters most. Working closely with Engineering and Design, you’ll turn product vision into high-quality experiences and measurable business outcomes. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to operate in an ambitious, fast-paced B2B environment. You’ll help define a 12–18 month product vision while exploring what an AI-first finance experience should look like. Success will require a strong customer focus, strategic thinking, proactive communication, and a genuine sense of ownership.

Accountabilities

  • Own the product roadmap for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, iteration, and measurable outcomes.
  • Define, manage, and track OKRs with your product squad, communicating progress and outcomes clearly.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design on discovery, technical scoping, prioritization, trade-offs, and delivery.
  • Conduct direct conversations with customers and customer-facing teams to identify meaningful problems and build evidence-based product priorities rather than simply inheriting an existing backlog.
  • Identify dependencies across adjacent product areas and proactively address potential risks before they impact delivery.
  • Represent customer needs in cross-functional discussions, ensuring product decisions and trade-offs remain grounded in user value.
  • Develop and communicate a 12–18 month product vision, with a particular focus on creating an AI-first user experience.

    • Requirements

    • 4+ years of experience in product management, including at least 2 years owning a customer-facing product area end-to-end.
    • At least 2 years of experience working in a B2B product environment.
    • Demonstrated success conceptualizing, developing, launching, and scaling products in a fast-paced setting.
    • Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, evidence-light problem spaces and define solutions from scratch rather than relying on a pre-scoped backlog.
    • Strong experience collaborating directly with Engineering on technical decisions, trade-offs, and dependency management.
    • Fluent English, as this is the primary working language; German is a plus.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take complex problems from ambiguity through to shipped and measurable outcomes.
    • Evidence-led approach to decision-making, with the ability to critically assess whether available data genuinely answers the question at hand.
    • Proactive communication style, particularly when identifying risks, dependencies, or potential delivery challenges.
    • Strategic mindset with the ability to maintain a multi-quarter vision rather than focusing exclusively on immediate priorities.
    • Collaborative approach, balancing the needs of the wider product organization with the priorities of your own product area.
    • Strong customer empathy and a genuine interest in understanding user needs and turning them into impactful product experiences.

      • Benefits

      • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.

      • High level of ownership and autonomy within a growing fintech environment.
