title: Software Engineer
description:
Arbiter offers a complete suite of SaaS tools that allows athletic directors, assigners, coordinators, and officials to easily manage all aspects of their responsibilities. Our Software Engineers are responsible for software development in a fast-paced agile environment. They are responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of our complex, high-performance web applications, APIs, large scale databases, and other technologies. Because this position plays a role in mentoring other developers and QA engineers as well as communicating with other employees throughout the company, excellent communication skills are a must.


AI-First Development

Arbiter is adopting an AI-first approach to engineering. This means AI agentic tools are the default way our engineers work, not just an occasional accelerator for writing code. In practice this looks like:

  • Using AI tools across the full development lifecycle: technical planning, backlog/item refinement, architecture and design, implementation, unit and integration testing, and code review.
  • Refining the context and instructions given to AI tools — clear requirements, constraints, and codebase context — so they produce more accurate, higher-quality results.
  • Remaining fully accountable for anything produced with AI assistance: reviewing and validating AI-generated output for correctness, security, and adherence to team standards with the same rigor as hand-written code.
  • Continuously learning new AI tools and techniques and sharing effective practices with the rest of the team.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and test code across our SaaS solution, primarily working in C#, SQL, and React, along with API-based applications.
  • Apply AI agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) across the development lifecycle — technical planning, item refinement, architecture, coding, testing, debugging, and code review — while validating output for quality, security, and adherence to team standards.
  • Document project objectives and measures for success.
  • Understand customer business requirements and application objectives, and raise open questions with developers, QA engineers, and product managers as needed.
  • Design, build, and maintain comprehensive test coverage — unit tests, integration tests, and test plans/cases — across our hardware and software platforms.
  • Review requirements with other developers and QA engineers for completeness and accuracy.
  • Mentor and pair program with junior Developers and QA Engineers on a regular basis.
  • Design software and technology architectures according to industry standard best practices, including effective cache and session management strategies.
  • Participate in team planning, estimation, status, and retrospective meetings.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 2-5 years' professional experience developing web applications, primarily using C#, SQL, and React (or comparable object-oriented, relational database, and front-end technologies).
  • Experience with ASP.NET (MVC or Core), Microsoft Azure, and other modern web frameworks is a plus; comfort using AI tooling to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar languages or frameworks is valued as much as depth in any one stack.
  • Experience using AI agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) is a strong plus, especially across planning, development, and testing; willingness and aptitude to adopt AI-first workflows is expected of all engineers.
  • Significant experience developing REST APIs.
  • Detail-oriented and reliable — equally effective collaborating on a team or working independently with minimal direction.
  • Experience in agile software development best practices (specifically Scrum).
  • Experience conducting Requirements Reviews with engineers and other stakeholders such as project managers and/or product owners.
  • Experience with root cause analysis of defects in a complex Enterprise N-Tiered environment.
  • Cellphone or personal device to receive MFA (multi-factor authentication) texts or calls.
  • Have an internet connection that’s adequate for their job, a minimum of 10Mbps down.

title: Internal Auditor - Wendover
description:
Reporting to the Manager of Internal Audit, the Internal Auditor is responsible for the effective planning and execution of compliance, financial, and operational audits and special projects at various locations. This person interacts with mid-to-senior level management to discuss and resolve potentially contentious issues and recommends improved business practices.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

· Manage internal audit activities, including the effective planning and execution of compliance, financial, and operational audits of business operations at Maverick properties.

· Assist in designing/direct the execution of short and long-term strategies that provide objective assurance on the adequacy of internal controls to senior management, independent accountants, regulators in multiple jurisdictions.

· Manage the annual and ongoing operating unit risk assessment process for the assigned region through collaboration with management at all levels, and develop the annual audit plan for approval by senior management.

· Prioritize and implement strategies to assure the effective and timely completion of the approved audit plan and ad hoc risk-based initiatives, including internal audit activities related to the review and evaluation of compliance with regulatory, IT, company and generally expected internal controls, and operational effectiveness for the assigned region, communicating audit results verbally and in writing to management, and regulators.

· Integrate acquired entities into the company's internal audit function for the assigned region.

· Lead potentially contentious discussions with General Managers, Finance leadership (corporate or property), and to communicate findings, resolve obstacles, and recommend changes to business practices.

· Manage the performance of special investigations, fraud, or wrongdoing investigations, identify related mitigating internal controls, and communicate findings and improved business practices to management.

· Identify and proliferate best practices related to regulatory, financial, IT, and generally expected internal controls across the enterprise.

· Develop audit activity updates regularly for senior management.

· Serve as enterprise-wide consulting expert for internal control design/evaluation initiatives.

· Manage or participate in department initiatives designed to improve departmental operational effectiveness.

· Assist in the identification of a successful strategy for periodic quality assurance reviews for the internal audit function, and execute the review process accordingly as required by regulatory and professional standards to achieve and maintain department certification for external reliance upon audit results.

· Research and develop practical solutions and business improvements, highlighting value-added activities.

· Assist in the annual and ongoing risk assessment process, recommend real-time changes as appropriate.

· Assess the risk associated with potential compliance program failure and apply appropriate resources and communicating the high risk issues to management.

· Provide regulatory interpretations and apply accounting, auditing, and regulatory requirements in the casino and corporate environments.

· Lead, manage, or perform special project activities, and provide consulting and advisory services to clients.

· Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to formulate appropriate business improvement recommendations verbally and in writing to various levels of management.

· Liaise with management, regulators, and independent accountants to assure objectives are met.

title: Claim Specialist - Property Field Inspection
description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.


Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential


Responsibilities

Join our team as a Property Field Inspection Claim Specialist and showcase your expertise in handling accident and weather-related claims for homeowners, commercial properties, and large losses.

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled professional to contribute to our dynamic team. State Farm is on the cutting edge with the use of technology to support claim employees in developing enhanced skillsets to support and protect our policyholders. Not Human or Digital. Human + Digital, working together. You will be the first point of contact to meet with our insureds, explain coverage, estimate damages, and help them through the claims process while providing Remarkable service.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct on-site inspections and assessments of property damages for both residential and commercial claims
  • Collaborate with policyholders, insurance agents, and other involved parties to gather information and resolve claims efficiently
  • May occasionally require interacting with parties who express strong emotions or concerns about ongoing inspections or claim resolutions
  • Provide exceptional customer service throughout the claims process, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally
  • Gather necessary evidence, document findings, and prepare detailed reports to support the claims handling process
  • Investigate and adjust both personal and commercial property claims with exposures up to $500,000
  • Evaluate coverage and policy terms to determine the validity of claims and ensure compliance with local regulations
  • Negotiate and settle claims within the authorized limits, considering policy provisions, industry standards, and company guidelines

Where you'll work: This position is located in Pennsburg, PA. Competitive candidates should reside within one of the listed zip codes and will service this same territory: 18011 18031 18041 18054 18056 18062 18070 18073 18076 18087 18092 18106 18195 18964 18969 19438 19440 19503 19504 19505 19510 19512 19522 19530 19536 19539 19547 19562

This is a Remote-Field position in which you will work from home and utilize a mobile office/vehicle for in-person appointments. Although the primary work location is in the field, with a commutable distance from home, there will be opportunities for virtual work to be completed at home. Additionally, there may be occasions where you will be required to travel outside your assigned area to assist in other territories.

Hours of operation are continually evaluated and may change based on business need. Successful candidates are able and willing to work flexible schedules and may be asked to work overtime and/or irregular hours.


Qualifications

Competitive candidates must demonstrate:

  • Ability to investigate problems, evaluate information, and make well-supported decisions
  • Ability to interpret detailed policies, guidelines, or technical information and apply them accurately to real-world situations
  • Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar concepts, processes, and terminology and apply that knowledge accurately in practical situations
  • Ability to effectively interact with policyholders, agents, and other stakeholders to move claims forward efficiently
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to handle difficult/emotional conversations with a customer-minded focus
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Proficiency in using mobile/desktop tools to document and support claims both in the field and remotely
  • Physical agility to allow for: walking; bending, reaching, kneeling, squatting, stooping, frequent lifting, carrying, unfolding, and climbing a ladder; ability to utilizing appropriate equipment in accordance with safety guidelines to traverse roofs at various heights and pitches for inspection of both residential and commercial structures; ability to crawl in tight spaces to gather information needed during the adjustment of a claim.
  • May be required to complete Rope and Harness Safety Training
  • A valid driver's license is required

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field such as Risk Management, Insurance, Business, Construction Management or a similar discipline
  • Customer service experience (e.g., assisting customers, handling inquiries/concerns professionally, communicating clearly and empathetically), demonstrating transferable skills that support client interactions in a Claims environment
  • Understanding of property insurance concepts, including coverage fundamentals and general claim handling practices
  • Baseline knowledge of residential and commercial building construction and building components/materials
    Familiarity with water mitigation principles and inspection processes
  • Working knowledge of Xactimate and XactContents

Additional Details:

  • Employees must successfully complete all required training, including applicable proficiency, licensing exam(s), Motor Vehicle Recrd (MVR) checks, and background checks required of various state(s).
  • State Farm recently implemented new pre-employment assessments. Candidates that have previously taken an assessment may be asked to participate in additional testing.

Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

  • Potential starting salary range: $69,398.62 - $99,000.00 Annually
    • Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience
    • High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience
  • Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary


At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!

  • Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus.
  • Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
  • Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
  • Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!
  • Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
  • Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
  • Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.

Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

title: Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ecosystem Database Engineer based in United Kingdom.

This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of databases, developer tooling, integrations, and open source.
You’ll help build and maintain drivers, adapters, migration tools, and integrations that make a distributed time-series database easier to use across modern data ecosystems.
Your work will connect database technology with widely used tools and frameworks across analytics, data engineering, observability, and application development.
You’ll collaborate closely with experienced engineers and contribute to projects that are developed transparently in public GitHub repositories.
The position offers broad technical ownership, with opportunities to work across multiple programming languages, protocols, frameworks, and infrastructure environments.
You’ll also engage directly with open source communities and technology partners to improve integrations and solve real-world developer challenges.
It’s a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving existing software, and shipping high-quality technology used by other developers.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain database drivers and adapters, including JDBC and Python/SQLAlchemy integrations.
  • Build and improve connections between the database platform and external tools such as Grafana, Tableau, and Airflow.
  • Develop and maintain internal administrative tooling, including command-line utilities and administration interfaces.
  • Improve PostgreSQL compatibility and strengthen integration capabilities across the wider database ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain migration tools supporting movement between different database systems and storage formats.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including reference architectures, integration examples, and implementation guidance.
  • Collaborate with open source communities and technical partners on joint projects and ecosystem integrations.
  • Work directly with product managers to translate technical needs into clear requirements and feasible solutions.
  • Take ownership of existing codebases, continuously improving their quality, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Debug complex technical issues across different components and systems, taking a full-stack approach where necessary.
  • Ensure software components are thoroughly tested, documented, communicated, packaged, and successfully delivered.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience as a software engineer, with the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from development through delivery.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
    • Good working knowledge of Python and Java, with experience in additional languages such as Rust, C++, Go, Swift, or Zig considered an advantage.
    • Understanding of technical standards, protocols, and APIs, particularly technologies such as HTTP, PostgreSQL Wire Protocol, Python DB API, and JDBC.
    • Experience with Test-Driven Development and a strong commitment to software quality.
    • Knowledge of software versioning, packaging, distribution, and deployment in polyglot software environments.
    • Understanding of how software components are operated and maintained in production environments.
    • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across multiple layers of a system.
    • A self-directed, hands-on mindset and the ability to overcome technical and organizational obstacles to move projects forward.
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, open source contributors, and external technical partners.
    • A genuine interest in open source software and collaborative development practices.
    • Existing open source contributions are a plus, but are not required.
    • Experience with message-bus technologies such as AMQP, Kafka, MQTT, or ZeroMQ and their broker implementations is desirable.
    • Knowledge of or experience with DevOps practices and containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Competitive compensation.
      • Flexible working hours designed to support autonomy and work-life balance.
      • Flexible holiday arrangements.
      • Fitness and wellness-related perks.
      • Education and professional development benefits.
      • Participation in an Employee Stock Options Plan.
      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on challenging database and ecosystem projects.
      • Exposure to a broad open source technology ecosystem and opportunities to collaborate with external technical communities.
      • An open, collaborative, and internationally distributed working environment.
      • Opportunities to take ownership of projects and contribute to the evolution of database technology.
      • A diverse and inclusive workplace that values different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure based in United States .

This is a Staff-level infrastructure engineering role focused on building the platform foundations that enable engineering teams to move faster and operate more reliably.
You’ll combine hands-on software engineering with technical leadership, shaping self-service infrastructure, cloud platforms, deployment systems, and operational tooling.
A major focus will be replacing expert-driven provisioning and operational workflows with paved roads that provide clear ownership, safe defaults, strong guardrails, and measurable adoption.
You’ll help evolve multi-region, cross-account infrastructure and Kubernetes foundations while improving reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency.
The role also includes developing AI-assisted operational workflows that reduce toil while keeping production changes safe, auditable, and human-reviewed.
You’ll influence architecture across teams through RFCs, design reviews, technical standards, and pragmatic engineering decisions.
Working in a small, growing team, you’ll have substantial ownership and the opportunity to drive infrastructure investments through real production adoption.

Accountabilities:

  • Turn ambiguous infrastructure challenges into clear technical proposals and drive them through RFCs, architecture reviews, and cross-team alignment.
  • Design and build self-service platform capabilities and APIs, primarily in Go, covering onboarding, provisioning, deployment, observability defaults, and day-2 operations.
  • Establish reliable delivery standards using Terraform, GitOps with Argo CD, progressive delivery, automated testing, and continuous deployment practices.
  • Evolve multi-tenant EKS infrastructure to improve reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop and improve ingress and traffic-routing capabilities, including Envoy Gateway and multi-region, cross-account connectivity.
  • Strengthen SLOs, alerting, incident response, and operational follow-up through Grafana Cloud and improved observability practices.
  • Measure success through outcomes for consuming engineering teams, including faster provisioning and deployment, greater self-service, and improved operational reliability.
  • Develop AI-assisted operational workflows such as alert enrichment, incident context gathering, runbook-assisted diagnosis, remediation recommendations, and onboarding assistants.
  • Maintain appropriate human oversight for AI-assisted operational actions, with an emphasis on safety, auditability, and responsible automation.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation after onboarding and shadowing, while helping improve the overall health of on-call through better alerts, runbooks, automation, and blameless postmortems.
  • Lead strategic platform initiatives from initial design through production adoption and establish durable technical patterns across engineering teams.

    • Requirements:

    • 8+ years of professional, hands-on, full-time software engineering experience in backend, infrastructure, or platform engineering.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • Strong software engineering expertise in Go or a comparable programming language, including system design, testing, debugging, code review, and long-term maintainability.
    • Proven experience designing, delivering, and operating cloud services or infrastructure platforms in production.
    • Deep expertise in at least one area such as Kubernetes, networking, cloud platforms, reliability engineering, or developer platforms.
    • Strong Linux, networking, and production operations fundamentals.
    • Experience setting technical direction and leading initiatives that require alignment across multiple engineering teams.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in remote environments and through RFCs, design documents, and incident writeups.
    • Experience with EKS, ingress, CNI, or service-mesh technologies is valuable.
    • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, CI/CD, progressive delivery, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, and canary deployments is a plus.
    • Experience leading large-scale migrations, platform adoption programs, or cross-team infrastructure initiatives is beneficial.
    • Strong systems judgment, curiosity, pragmatic decision-making, and the ability to develop deep expertise while navigating adjacent technical domains.
    • Willingness to participate in an operational on-call rotation and contribute to improving its effectiveness.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote-first work arrangement.
      • Flexible scheduling and autonomy in managing your working hours.
      • Generous paid time off, quarterly wellness days, and an end-of-year wellness break.
      • Home-office support to help create an effective remote workspace.
      • Technology stipend equivalent to US$100 net per month.
      • Annual learning and development stipend covering conferences, courses, certifications, and continued professional learning.
      • 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
      • Equity participation for full-time employees.
      • Medical, retirement, and paid-holiday benefits, with details varying by country.

title: Shipping Coordinator
description:
Are you a serious worker, who prefers an analytical job, and are comfortable with taking the lead? Do you consider yourself adept at working independently and do you prefer the existence of a process to drive strong outcomes? Would people describe you as highly reliable? Are you known for your ability to execute with a high degree of expediency and accuracy? If so, we are looking for you!


Fenix Group SPC in Minnetonka, MN is seeking to hire a full-time Shipping Coordinator to help us manage our shipping schedule and ensure we are meeting customer delivery deadlines.


We offer our Shipping Coordinator a competitive wage, as well as an excellent benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, a health savings account (HSA) with company match, as well as a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off & holidays, and a safe work environment.


Get To Know Us

At Fenix Group, our mission is to transform, enhance, and protect surfaces. We manufacture specialty paints and coatings for a variety of OEM and contractor markets across our three nationwide locations. Just like how the Phoenix rebirths out of the ashes larger and more powerful each time, we are undergoing a transformation to improve our processes and procedures, implement automation and technology, and create efficiencies throughout our operations. As a small company with approximately 150 employees, we are committed to our core values of reliable, can-do, curious, team player, and passionate.


A Day in the Life of the Shipping Coordinator

You will spend your day completing a variety of tasks including scheduling shipments and managing the outbound shipping schedule; working with carriers and internal team members to understand the urgency of freight, resolving issues, and ensuring top tier service; seeking out rate quotes with shipping vendors and logistics companies; maintaining and updating shipping records and paperwork; collaborating with the customer service team to ensure coordination of special shipments and rush orders; contacting common carriers and scheduling return freight, ensuring it meets customer requirements; documenting and handling the claims process for product damaged during shipping; and notifying customers when will call orders are ready to be picked up.


What You’ll Need to be Successful at Fenix Group SPC

At a minimum, you'll need:

  • A High School Diploma or GED
  • To be at least 18 years of age
  • Experience working in a logistics and/or shipping environment
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to work with vendors online including using their custom shipping software

What also catches our attention:

  • A passionate & positive “can do” attitude, willingness to learn, to teach, and to be a change agent within the company
  • An ability to work within a team environment and help the team become better


Work Schedule

This is a full-time position with a schedule of Monday through Friday 8:30am-5:00pm with a half hour lunch, plus two paid breaks daily.

title: Stærk i metal
description:
Stærk i metal

Liste monteres med skruemaskine

Dygtige smede og håndværkere inden for metal

Vi har fortsat forrygende travlt og har brug for flere dygtige smede og håndværkere, der er vant til at arbejde med metal og kan svejse, skære i gevind osv. – ja, dygtige metal fagfolk.

Det er vigtigt, du har fokus på at skabe kvalitet ned til mindste detalje og kan lide at arbejde med finish og det færdige produkt. Du skal have hænderne skruet godt på.

Selvstændighed og initiativ

Du skal kunne håndtere omstillinger i løbet af dagen, da alle vores døre er specialdesignede. Du er samtidig kendetegnet ved:

  • har en høj arbejdsmoral og er pålidelig
  • kan arbejde og tænke selvstændigt
  • har gode samarbejdsevner
  • har ordenssans
  • udviser selvstændighed og initiativ, da både tillid og ansvar gives i stor målestok

Gode forhold og et godt arbejdsmiljø

Udover en god løn har Door System et godt arbejdsmiljø og er kendt for en uformel omgangstone, hvor beslutningerne bliver truffet i tæt dialog, og alle ansatte har stor indflydelse på planlægningen af sin egen arbejdsdag.

Johnny Brønd

Du er altid velkommen til at kontakte produktionschef Johnny Brønd.

Send os din ansøgning

For yderligere oplysninger om jobbet kan du kontakte produktionschef Johnny Brønd på telefon 42 14 52 11. Vi ser frem til at modtage din skriftlige ansøgning på mail til jb@doorsystem.dk eller pr. brev til Door System A/S, Agerskovvej 16, 8362 Hørning.

Samtaler udføres løbende og tiltrædelse ønskes så hurtigt som muligt. Din data behandles i henhold til gældende retningslinjer i forhold til GDPR.

Ny renrumsport har skrå kanter

Vores renrumsdøre og -porte lever op til medicinalindustriens høje krav til materialer, hygiejne og driftssikkerhed.

Bliv en del af et stærkt team

Door System har specialiseret sig i dørløsninger i højeste kvalitet til fødevareindustrien, medicinalindustrien og detailhandlen, og leverer til de største danske virksomheder.

”Vi har en stærk produktion i Hørning med dygtige folk, der leverer høj kvalitet hver dag med stor fleksibilitet – det sætter kunderne pris på, og det er derfor, de bliver ved med at købe hos os. Vi vil samtidig også godt prale lidt af at have en fantastisk holdånd i virksomheden, så man bliver en del af et virkeligt stærkt fællesskab”, fortæller produktionschef Johnny Brønd.

Se mere om Door System, herunder også om vores initiativer inden for bæredygtighed.

The Tony Group stands out as one of the premier automotive dealerships in the State of Hawaiʻi. Nestled in the heart of Waipiʻo, we take pride in our legacy as a family-owned and operated business since 1977. With locations across the state, Tony Group is committed to delivering exceptional service and building lasting relationships with our guests and community.

The Vehicle Detailing and Reconditioning position is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the appearance and condition of dealership vehicles through interior and exterior detailing, reconditioning, paint correction, and protective coating services. title: Managing Consultant, MarTech
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Managing Consultant, MarTech based in Ireland.

As a Managing Consultant, MarTech, you will own client engagements end-to-end, combining strategic consulting, technical leadership, relationship management, and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with senior marketing and growth stakeholders while remaining close enough to the technology to design solutions and challenge technical decisions. Acting as a player-coach, you’ll shape customer data and marketing technology strategies while directing engineers and implementation partners. You’ll identify opportunities for growth, connect recommendations to measurable business outcomes, and ensure solutions are delivered effectively. The role offers exposure to diverse industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America. It is ideal for an experienced consultant who enjoys moving between executive conversations, strategic problem-solving, and hands-on technical work.

Accountabilities

  • Own client engagements from initial discovery through strategy, solution design, delivery, renewal, and expansion, acting as the primary relationship owner.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and serve as the senior point of contact when clients need strategic guidance or escalation.
  • Run a consistent client cadence, including biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Maintain at least three months of planned work across each account while proactively monitoring budgets, utilization, pacing, and potential overages.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting recommendations to measurable metrics and business outcomes.
  • Develop growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients and demonstrate the commercial value of progressing toward greater levels of marketing and data maturity.
  • Design customer data and MarTech architectures spanning customer data platforms, analytics, lifecycle messaging, warehouses, and integrations.
  • Perform strategic hands-on work where needed, including taxonomy design, measurement planning, attribution modeling, segmentation logic, and quality assurance of critical implementations.
  • Direct engineers and contract developers, review their work, and ensure technical delivery meets the agreed client objectives before reaching the customer.
  • Delegate implementation work appropriately while remaining sufficiently technical to challenge estimates, identify weak solutions, and make informed architectural decisions.
  • Support pre-sales through discovery, opportunity identification, scoping, proposal development, and live presentations.
  • Build proposals covering scope, phasing, effort, investment, and business case, ensuring estimates are commercially viable and delivery expectations are realistic.
  • Partner with Sales through qualification and closing, then transition opportunities into successful delivery where appropriate.
  • Document, estimate, and secure written confirmation for all scope changes before additional work begins.
  • Drive account expansion and contribute to commercial growth across the client portfolio.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 4 years directly owning client relationships.
    • Fully fluent English, as this is the primary working language.
    • Strong understanding of the complete marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost and why.
    • Deep understanding of modern marketing technology, including advertising platforms, customer data platforms, marketing engagement tools, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Strong advisory-level expertise across MarTech systems, with the ability to recommend appropriate technologies, assess how different components connect, understand operational trade-offs, and identify when an existing technology stack can be used more effectively.
    • Ability to critically evaluate funnel reports, cohort analyses, attribution models, and other marketing analytics to challenge assumptions and connect findings to business outcomes.
    • Demonstrated track record of retaining and growing client accounts, with measurable commercial results that can be clearly explained.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, scoping, proposal development, and delivery against the solutions sold.
    • Experience with GDPR and consent management as an integral part of client engagements.
    • Strong technical depth in at least three of the following MarTech areas, with working familiarity across the others: customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, and GA4; lifecycle and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, and Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and dbt; tag management including Google Tag Manager and server-side GTM; CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot; and consent management tools such as OneTrust, Cookiebot, and Didomi.
    • Ability to combine executive-level consulting skills with practical technical knowledge and hands-on experience.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive problems through to resolution.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to balance strategy, delivery, commercial priorities, and technical challenges within the same engagement.
    • Professional working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a plus.
    • Experience managing engagements across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working with both European and North American clients is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Annual compensation of $70,000–$125,000 USD, depending on experience and location.
      • Additional bonus or commission linked to client account growth.
      • Full-time contractor engagement with direct international contracting terms.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
      • National holidays off.
      • Highly transparent working environment.
      • Significant autonomy and room to develop and implement your own ideas.
      • Opportunity to work across diverse industries, business models, and technology stacks rather than being limited to a single client environment.
      • Exposure to both European and North American markets from one role.
      • Opportunity to work with evolving customer data architectures, including warehouse-native approaches, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL.
      • Ability to combine the full commercial and delivery lifecycle of an account within a single senior role.

title: Bilingual English and Spanish Member Loyalty Representative (R14281)
description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

Oportun is currently seeking qualified candidates with customer service, cashier, sales, or hospitality experience to work Full-Time. At Oportun, we consider our customers to be our members, and the primary focus of our Member Loyalty Representatives is to create and generate a rewarding and unique member service experience.

Our Member Loyalty Representatives are passionate about listening, helping, and connecting with people at all touchpoints, such as in our stores and in the communities around our stores through personal outreach activities. As a key member of our team, you will make the mission of Oportun come to life by educating our members and communities about our inclusive, affordable financial services that empower them to build a better future.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • Welcome members with a warm greeting and provide quality member service.
  • Seamlessly process all transactions, while following company policies & procedures and protecting our members’ information.
  • Work as a team or independently, including time alone in the store without direct supervision or with coworkers, while exceeding daily goals in our lending and servicing activities.
  • Enjoy informing and educating potential members about Oportun’s services by engaging in outreach efforts more than 50% of the time at Oportun locations, partner locations and/or community events. Activities include:
    • Building relationships with local businesses (e.g., mechanic shops, dental offices, furniture stores) and speaking with local business owners and their employees about how Oportun’s services can help their customers.
    • Conducting outreach efforts at local flea markets, community events, and at our Lending As A Service (LAAS) partner locations to increase awareness, capture leads, and assist with starting applications;
    • Actively engaging with people at and around Oportun’s retail locations, encouraging store visits, and assisting with applications.
    • Supporting community outreach and marketing events, by passing out flyers and educating the local community about Oportun and its products and services;
    • and Using iPads or assisting potential members with scanning QR codes during outreach efforts to start new applications.
  • Light housekeeping to keep the work area and store location inviting and presentable to all who visit, including daily collection of trash, sweeping, mopping, and window cleaning as needed.
  • Use a computer intermittently (approx. 3-6 hours per day) for administrative tasks and for servicing members.
  • Stand while assisting members; sitting is allowed during non-member-facing tasks.

title: Production Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Position Summary:


The Production Quality Assurance Specialist performs quality-control activities across all production farms. This role completes required regulatory testing, inspections, audits, and animal welfare observations; documents and reviews production records; and helps ensure operations meet regulatory requirements and animal welfare standards. The specialist partners with Farm Managers to address any deviations or discrepancies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain the Production FDA SE Program and AI Monitoring Program, including testing, record review, and record keeping.
  • Conduct animal welfare observations during flock events and report concerns to the supervisor.
  • Complete and maintain Animal Welfare Incident Reports and Corrective Action Reports; support root-cause problem solving and verify corrective actions.
  • Partner with the QA Manager to ensure processes and products meet regulatory requirements, customer specifications, and third-party audit standards.
  • Perform monthly farm inspections and monitoring checks (for example, environmental monitoring).
  • Inspect and calibrate monitoring equipment, as assigned.
  • Keep accurate, complete, and timely records.
  • Perform other duties as assigned, with appropriate training.

Qualifications:

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Able to follow direction and detailed instructions.
  • Adaptable and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Dependable, self-motivated, and safety focused.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Able to review results, identify issues, and provide clear feedback to leaders.
  • Continuous improvement mindset; able to recommend and support process changes.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
  • Food manufacturing experience preferred.
  • Quality assurance or quality control experience preferred.

Resumen del Puesto:

El Especialista en Aseguramiento de la Calidad de Producción realiza actividades de control de calidad en todas las granjas de producción. Este puesto lleva a cabo las pruebas regulatorias requeridas, inspecciones, auditorías y observaciones de bienestar animal; documenta y revisa los registros de producción; y ayuda a garantizar que las operaciones cumplan con los requisitos regulatorios y los estándares de bienestar animal. El especialista colabora con los Gerentes de Granja para abordar cualquier desviación o discrepancia.


Responsabilidades Clave:

  • Mantener el Programa FDA SE de Producción y el Programa de Monitoreo de IA, incluyendo pruebas, revisión de registros y mantenimiento de registros.
  • Realizar observaciones de bienestar animal durante los eventos de las parvadas y reportar cualquier inquietud al supervisor.
  • Completar y mantener los Informes de Incidentes de Bienestar Animal y los Informes de Acciones Correctivas; apoyar la resolución de problemas mediante el análisis de la causa raíz y verificar las acciones correctivas.
  • Colaborar con el Gerente de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (QA) para garantizar que los procesos y productos cumplan con los requisitos regulatorios, las especificaciones de los clientes y los estándares de auditorías de terceros.
  • Realizar inspecciones mensuales de las granjas y verificaciones de monitoreo (por ejemplo, monitoreo ambiental).
  • Inspeccionar y calibrar los equipos de monitoreo, según se le asigne.
  • Mantener registros precisos, completos y oportunos.
  • Realizar otras tareas asignadas, con la capacitación adecuada.

Calificaciones:

  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y como parte de un equipo.
  • Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y procedimientos detallados.
  • Adaptabilidad y capacidad para trabajar en un entorno de ritmo acelerado.
  • Ser una persona confiable, automotivada y enfocada en la seguridad.
  • Sólidas habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
  • Capacidad para revisar resultados, identificar problemas y proporcionar retroalimentación clara a los líderes.
  • Mentalidad de mejora continua; capacidad para recomendar y apoyar cambios en los procesos.
  • Bilingüe (inglés/español) preferido.
  • Gran atención al detalle y precisión en la documentación.
  • Se prefiere experiencia en manufactura de alimentos.
  • Se prefiere experiencia en aseguramiento de la calidad o control de calidad.

As a member of the Shipping and Receiving team, you will join a diverse, dynamic group of highly motivated individuals who bring a wide range of talents, skills, and backgrounds. The Shipping Coordinator plays an important role in ensuring our products are delivered safely, efficiently, and on time while providing excellent service to our customers.


This posting is for a new position within the organization.


The regular work schedule is Monday to Thursday 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., and Friday 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. This position is compensated based on a 42-hour work week.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package including a Health Spending Account
  • RRSP Program
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Employee and Family Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Company events and employee activities
  • Family-friendly, team-oriented environment
  • Opportunities for learning, development, and career growth

  • Organize and coordinate trucking requirements for Steelway and ExSteel products from our Springwater and Progress Drive facilities
  • Schedule deliveries using company-owned trucks and external carriers
  • Coordinate loads, loading schedules, and shipping priorities with the Shipping and Receiving Manager
  • Work directly with customers to coordinate delivery schedules and requirements
  • Ensure shipments are scheduled and dispatched on time to support excellent customer service
  • Source and arrange external freight while considering cost, reliability, timing, and service
  • Maintain relationships with transportation providers and support competitive freight pricing
  • Assign loading sequences to support safe and efficient loading and off-loading at customer locations
  • Communicate loading requirements and priorities to truck loaders and the Shipping and Receiving team

  • Maintain accurate shipping information and complete required data entry within company systems

  • Provide backup support to the Shipping and Receiving Manager as required
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to shipping, scheduling, freight costs, and transportation processes

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Post-secondary education in logistics, supply chain, business, or a related field is considered an asset
  • Previous experience in shipping, freight, transportation, logistics, or a manufacturing environment is an asset
  • Experience coordinating carriers, deliveries, and freight is preferred
  • Strong organizational, scheduling, and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly to changing schedules and requirements

title: Program Manager
description:
The Program Manager is a position that requires the employee to function independently, showing considerable amounts of initiative, judgment, and leadership with a commitment to the mission of the agency and furthering that mission in the community. The Program Manager is also responsible for the quality of the services provided, for maintaining strong relationships in the community, and serves as a good financial steward for the agency to support the fiscal health of the program(s). The Program Manager reports directly to the Program Director and directly supervises staff in the assigned program/services.


QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

• Education and/or work experience as follows:

- A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and three (3) years of paid, full-time SUD experience with at least one year in a successful administrative/supervisory capacity; or

- Assoc. degree in relevant field + four (4) years of paid, full-time SUD experience with at least 1 year in a successful administrative/supervisory capacity; or

- HSD (or equivalent) plus five (5) years of paid, full-time SUD experience in the field of substance use disorders and withdrawal management, with at least one year in a successful administrative, supervisory capacity

• For individuals recovering from a substance-use disorder, must have maintained continuous abstinence/sobriety for the previous two (2) years.


LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:

• CADC-II required for SUD programs, QMHA-II for MH programs

• Must maintain a valid Oregon Driver License or ability to obtain one upon hire and be insurable under the organization’s auto liability coverage policy (minimum 21 years of age and with no Type A violations in the past 3 years, or three (3) or more Type B violations) and must have a reliable vehicle with adequate insurance to travel as needed.


PREFERRED:

• Bachelor’s degree in relevant field + 3 years of paid, full-time SUD/MH/BH experience with at least one year in a paid administrative/supervisory capacity

• Bilingual in English/Spanish a plus


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

1. Provides direct, day-to-day supervision and performance management of the assigned Program staff to include interviewing and hiring, coaching and performance management in accordance with BestCare policies and procedures and all State and Federal employment laws;

2. Ensures that respectful and compassionate treatment is provided to all clients who enter the programs;

3. Ensures that proper policies and procedures that protect the health, safety, and confidentiality of clients are developed and implemented;

4. Works closely with the Program Director to identify opportunities to provide innovative and high-quality services to the community;

5. Ensures that the clinical practices of the program meet best practice standards for the field, including ensuring that clinical supervision is occurring at or above the minimum requirements of the Oregon Administrative Rules;

6. Actively improves the quality of the program through participation in the Quality Management process; participates in the Quality Management Committee as well as the internal Safety Committee;

7. Provides or makes available on-going training for staff and ensures that clinical staff maintain and/or obtain state certification required for their positions;

8. Works closely with other staff as a member of a treatment team, ensuring healthy, supportive, and highly collaborative staff-to-staff and staff-to-client relationships;

10. Ensures that documentation in client files is timely, complete, reflects clinical best practices, and meets State and BestCare standards;

11. Maintains strong relationships with community partners, developing collaborative relationships whenever possible;

12. Tracks expenses and revenues are managed effectively, and ensuring that resources for the program are used efficiently to further the mission of the agency;

13. Ensures productivity of clinical staff in line with production or capacity goals for the department

14. Works collaboratively with the front office staff and their immediate supervisor to ensure that proper and efficient administrative and clerical practices are followed;

15. Other related duties as assigned.

title: Family Navigator- Family Supports
description:
Overview

Starting Rate: $26.75-$27.25

The Family Navigator II, with the DDS funded, Dese Moms Network, provides support to families of individuals living with intellectual/developmental disabilities and/or autism living at home in the community.

Family Navigators are responsible for developing and implementing person-centered goals. They partner with individuals and their caregivers to support information and referral, service navigation, social and recreational activities, family training, facilitating mentoring programs, life skills acquisition, and/or the administration of flexible funding. Navigators actively work with individuals and their caregivers in their homes and their local communities.

Who We Are

At Advocates, we provide comprehensive services for people facing developmental, mental health, or other life challenges.

We’re a nonprofit, mission-driven organization with a person-centered approach, empowering the individuals we support to make choices, build independence, and live full, meaningful lives. Our work is rooted in respect, compassion, and inclusion, and we envision a world where individual differences are appreciated and celebrated.

At Advocates, we value the ideas, experiences, and contributions of employees and are committed to fostering a supportive, welcoming culture where everyone can grow and thrive.

Minimum Education Required

High School Diploma/GED

Responsibilities

  • Work with families to develop and implement a Family Support Plan and Expenditure Plans in response to identified needs including, but not limited to, independent living skills, educational/vocational, social recreation behavioral, and all clinical needs.
  • Assist in developing and implementing an adult mentoring program for individuals living with disabilities and/or their caregivers.
  • Knowledgeable of community resources to support individual and/or caregiver needs.
  • Assist families in navigating public assistance systems for benefits and other resources available to families.
  • Organize and staff social and recreational events and programs for families.
  • Provide training to families on public benefits and entitlements; understanding basic educational rights and the Individual Education Plan (IEP); transition from high school; guardianship and other options; planning for the future; sibling workshops; and other relevant such as treatment modalities as identified by Center staff, families, and individuals, and DDS area office.
  • Provide skills training and support to individuals in areas including Activities of Daily Living (ADL), independence, behavioral treatment plans, community integration activities, pre-vocational skills, communication, socialization, health care and safety skills.
  • Provide support and services to those family members as identified by DDS Service Coordinator and Advocates Program Director/Supervisor.
  • Maintain productive internal and external communication with staff, management, collateral contacts, and family members.
  • Remain current and knowledgeable in the field of intellectual/developmental disabilities and stay informed about the needs of the families/caregivers and individuals served.
  • Assist with the organization of activities and facilitate activities as needed.
  • Attend trainings as assigned; maintain necessary certifications (CPR, First Aid, Safety Care)
  • Attend and actively participate in supervision and staff meetings.

Qualifications

  • BA/BS in social services or associate’s degree or High School Diploma and at least 2 years’ experience working in community human services or lived experience navigating complex community health and human services for individuals living with Intellectual/Developmental Disability or Autism.
  • 2 years of community human service experience working with individuals and their families living with an Intellectual/Developmental Disabilities or Autism

Advocates is committed to cultivating a diverse and welcoming community where everyone feels respected and valued. Advocates fosters a culture of inclusion that celebrates and promotes diversity along multiple dimensions, including race, ethnicity, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, partnered status, age, national origin, socioeconomic status, religion, ability, culture, and experience.

title: Technical Program Manager - GRS Technology
description:
Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead technology delivery for one or more multi-year technology programs. This is a program leadership role for the AI era: you will translate strategy into executable plans, orchestrate large cross-domain delivery, manage program governance and risk, and serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across overall program leadership, Technology, Data, shared services, and other functional groups.

The TPM role is an unbiased leader focused on the technical execution of the program. You will not simply manage the program status — you will modernize how programs are managed across technology teams, embedding AI assistants, automation, and data-driven decision-making into governance, reporting, and delivery operations. You will operate as a direct partner for business program leadership & technology leaders, influence decisions at all levels, and help institutionalize consistent, AI-enabled program delivery practices across the organization.

This role has a hybrid work arrangement (2 days per week onsite) in one of our tech hubs: Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Columbus, OH; Indianapolis, IN; or Plano, TX.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Delivery & Delivery Management

  • Drive and monitor end-to-end program technical execution: develop and maintain multi-year, multi-domain delivery plans that sequence technical work, integrations, and program increments.
  • Serve as technology program manager: provide consistent, accurate, and timely program status, decisions, and delivery logistics to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Run delivery operations: coordinate cutovers, command-center execution, hypercare, and handoffs to BAU/operations.

Governance, Risk & Dependency Management

  • Establish and run program governance (SteerCo, decision logs, RACI/RASCI matrices, stage gates) and ensure timely escalation and clear accountability for decisions OR support program governance and visibility in programs with an overall program leader from outside the technology organization.
  • Own technology program risks: identify, quantify, and mitigate risks; maintain a RAID register; escalate proactively when delivery, timeline, or budget is threatened — before problems are realized, not after.
  • Continuously map and manage dependencies across teams, domains, and portfolios; detect, communicate, and drive resolution of slips before they impact downstream commitments.
  • Apply AI-powered analytics to program data to surface leading risk indicators, predict schedule variances, and enable earlier, better-informed interventions.

AI Proficiency & Delivery Modernization

  • Champion AI-enabled delivery: design, deploy, and continuously improve AI assistants and agents that automate program reporting, status synthesis, meeting summarization, RAID upkeep, and stakeholder communications.
  • Demonstrate working AI fluency: understand generative AI concepts (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, Model Context Protocol) well enough to evaluate use cases, shape responsible adoption, and engage credibly with engineering teams building AI solutions.
  • Guide teams through the AI-augmented SDLC: understand how AI coding assistants, spec-driven development, and automated testing change delivery cadence, estimation, quality signals, and team composition.
  • Apply responsible-AI judgment: ensure AI usage within the program aligns with enterprise standards for security, data privacy, explainability, and ethics.
  • Model and mentor AI adoption: share reusable AI assets (assistants, prompts, playbooks) with the TPM community and coach teams and peers on effective, safe use of AI in daily delivery work.

Financials, Metrics & Reporting

  • Track program tech financials (burn vs. plan), surface corrective actions, and report forecast vs. actuals.
  • Define, collect, and report program delivery KPIs (leading and lagging), Agile/DevOps maturity metrics, team health, and quality indicators — increasingly through automated, AI-assisted dashboards rather than manual compilation.
  • Tie program reporting to business outcomes (reliability, customer experience, value realized), not just activity and milestones.

Stakeholder Management & Influence

  • Build and maintain stakeholder management plans for technical execution; communicate trade-offs clearly; eliminate friction that impedes delivery.
  • Present confidently to senior leadership, distilling complex technical and program information into clear insights that enable data-driven decisions.
  • Partner closely with Overall Program Leads (OPLs), Product Management, Tech Leads, Architects, DevOps, Data, Security, Finance, and Procurement to ensure alignment and timely decisions.

Community & Continuous Improvement

  • Engage with the enterprise TPM community to share best practices, contribute reusable playbooks and AI assets, and drive cross-program improvements.
  • Play an active role in shaping how the delivery function evolves in the world of AI — piloting new ways of working and scaling what works.
  • Operate independently: lead complex program workstreams with limited direction while escalating appropriately.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years' experience delivering software solutions in an agile environment; experience leading large, complex, multi-year programs.
  • Deep knowledge of Agile scaling practices and the ability to mobilize multiple agile teams across domains toward a shared mission.
  • Strong technical fluency — able to engage credibly on architecture, integrations, cloud platforms, data/AI pipelines, and NFRs.
  • Demonstrated AI proficiency: hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., AI assistants, agents, copilots) to improve program execution, plus a working understanding of AI concepts sufficient to evaluate use cases and guide adoption.
  • Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and SPM/portfolio tools; comfortable defining and enforcing tooling and automation standards.
  • Demonstrated strength in governance, risk management, dependency mapping, and financial reporting (burn vs. plan).
  • Data-driven decision-making: able to define metrics, interpret analytics, and use AI-generated insights while applying sound human judgment.
  • Exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and consensus-building skills with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Highly developed interpersonal skills and executive presence; proven ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Proven ability to operate with limited guidance and manage ambiguity in fast-evolving environments.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (or equivalent experience).

Preferred

  • Experience in property & casualty insurance or other regulated industries, including familiarity with responsible-AI, compliance, and data-governance considerations.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML or data-platform programs, or embedding AI into the SDLC (AI-assisted development, testing, or operations).
  • Background in DevOps, release orchestration, or technical delivery leadership.
  • Relevant certifications: PMP, SAFe POPM/SPC, or equivalent; AI credentials such as Google Generative AI Leader, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / AWS AI Practitioner, or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. title: Pastry Production
description:
Pastry Production Job Description

The Firehouse Restaurant

Position: Pastry Production Department: Culinary Reports to: Executive Chef or designee

Classification: Hourly, nonexempt

Position Summary

The Pastry Production employee prepares, finishes, and plates desserts and other pastry items for restaurant service and special events. This role follows approved recipes, production plans, presentation standards, and food safety procedures to deliver consistent quality and meet service deadlines. Work priorities are set by the Executive Chef or designated kitchen leader.

Essential Functions

Prepare pastry components, desserts, baked goods, sauces, garnishes, and other assigned items according to approved recipes, specifications, and daily production needs.

Measure ingredients accurately; follow batch sizes, portion standards, yields, and approved presentation and plating guides.

Complete daily prep lists and event production assignments on schedule; communicate shortages, delays, quality issues, and needed supplies promptly to the kitchen leader.

Plate and finish desserts during service and prepare quantities for banquets and special events, coordinating timing with the culinary and events teams.

Check finished products for taste, appearance, consistency, temperature, and portion accuracy; correct or escalate items that do not meet standards.

Label, date, store, and rotate ingredients and finished products; monitor freshness, waste, and proper use of inventory.

Clean and sanitize workstations, equipment, tools, and storage areas; follow food handling, allergen, personal hygiene, and workplace safety procedures.

Follow opening and closing procedures, including equipment care, storage, and handoff of incomplete production.

Assist with other kitchen production or service tasks within training and operational needs, as assigned.

title: Account Director, Client Solutions
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Client Solutions based in Spain.

As an Account Director, Client Solutions, you will own a portfolio of strategic client relationships from discovery through delivery, renewal, and expansion. You’ll serve as the senior commercial and strategic point of contact for executive stakeholders, helping clients turn customer data into measurable revenue growth. The role combines consulting, account leadership, commercial ownership, and project direction without requiring you to be the hands-on technical builder. You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. This is a high-ownership opportunity for an experienced client leader who can connect strategy, technology, and commercial outcomes.

Accountabilities

  • Own the executive-level relationship across a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary strategic contact for senior marketing and growth stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain a strong client cadence through biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews covering results, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Keep clients proactively informed about progress, budgets, timelines, risks, and decisions, ensuring there are no unexpected developments.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting each challenge to the relevant customer pain, metric, business impact, and potential solution.
  • Build and defend growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients, using measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle strategies, experimentation roadmaps, and performance readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions and recommendations into clear business implications that executive stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Scope projects and translate client requirements into sufficiently detailed briefs for architects and engineers, while remaining accountable for the quality and business relevance of the final outcome.
  • Lead project execution through sprint cadence, board management, dependencies, risks, timelines, and critical-path oversight rather than performing the technical implementation yourself.
  • Review completed work against agreed client objectives before delivery and ensure commitments are fulfilled to the expected standard.
  • Run pre-sales discovery, qualify opportunities, develop proposals, and present scope, phasing, investment, and business cases directly to prospective clients.
  • Partner with Sales throughout qualification, discovery, and closing before taking ownership of the account during delivery.
  • Price and scope technical work with profitability and delivery feasibility in mind.
  • Own retention and expansion across your portfolio, ensuring scope changes are estimated, documented, and approved before work begins.
  • Maintain a six-month forward roadmap so future engagements can be planned and contracted before existing scopes come to an end.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 5 years owning senior client relationships with direct revenue responsibility.
    • Fully fluent English, combined with professional working proficiency in at least one additional European language such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
    • Strong understanding of the full marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost between stages.
    • Solid understanding of how marketing technology supports modern marketing operations, including advertising, customer data platforms, marketing engagement, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Advisory-level knowledge of modern marketing and customer data technologies, with the ability to assess technology choices, understand trade-offs, evaluate how systems work together, and challenge poor technical recommendations without being responsible for configuration or coding.
    • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and data-driven approaches for improving marketing performance and returns.
    • Demonstrated success retaining and expanding client accounts, ideally supported by measurable commercial results.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, qualification, scoping, proposal development, and presenting solutions to executive buyers.
    • Experience scoping and pricing technical work in a way that balances client value, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
    • Understanding of how European businesses purchase, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent requirements.
    • Advisory command of customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4; lifecycle tools such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, or Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt; tag management; CRM; and consent management platforms.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive issues through to resolution.
    • Excellent strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to balance client value, delivery quality, account health, and profitability.
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, particularly with senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an environment where consulting, delivery, and business development can compete for attention.
    • Experience working with clients across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working across both European and North American client portfolios is a plus.
    • Experience building or helping establish a regional practice is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
