title: Specialistläkare Neurorehabilitering, Umeå
company: Region Västerbotten, Neuro huvud och halscentrum
description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Neuro- huvud- halscentrum (NHHC) bedriver högspecialiserad sjukvård  samt för forskning, utbildning och utveckling inom sjukdomar, skador och trauman inom området huvud, hals och öron.

De rehabiliteringsmedicinska verksamheterna vid NHHC i Umeå ingår i en region- och länsövergripande verksamhet som består av olika delar:

Hjärn- och ryggmärgsskaderehabilitering som både har en vårdavdelning samt mottagning, bedömer och rehabiliterar i första hand traumatiska skador. Vi har även ett spasticitetsteam för bedömning och behandling av patienter med besvärande spasticitet.

Neuro- och strokerehab bedömer och bedriver rehabilitering för patienter med kronisk och progressiv neurologisk sjukdom samt strokerehabilitering både i dagvård och i femdygnsvård.

Våra rehabiliteringsverksamheter bedriver gemensamt kvalitetsarbete.

Hjärn- och ryggmärgsskaderehabiliteringen bedriver nationell högspecialiserad vård för spinalskador. Vi fokuserar på att bedöma, behandla och rehabilitera personer med förvärvade funktionshinder, skador, neurologiska sjukdomar samt långvariga/svåra smärttillstånd. Patientens egna behov och målsättningar står alltid i centrum. Funktion, förmåga, aktivitet och delaktighet i olika livsområden är vägledande begrepp i dagligt arbete.

Inom rehabiliteringsverksamheterna arbetar vi multidisciplinärt och teambaserat. Vi tar väl hand om nya medarbetare och du får gedigen introduktion. Här har du flera kollegor med mångårig erfarenhet som delar med sig av kunskap och utvecklar varandra. Vår slutenvård omfattar primär rehabilitering av nyskadade patienter och vi har även tillgång till sk övervakningsplatser. Under vårdtiden hinner du lära känna patienten och bli en viktig aktör i deras rehabiliteringsresa. Vi har även platser för femdygnsrehabilitering för patienter med mindre medicinska behov samt veckobedömningar. Vi tillämpar ett bio-psyko-socialt synsätt, dvs ser hela människan i sin livssituation och dennes individuella mål.

3 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som specialistläkare hos oss bidrar du med kunskap och engagemang som får människor att känna sig trygga.

Nu har du möjlighet att vara med och forma vår verksamhet med fokus på samlad och effektiv specialistrehabilitering samt Nationell högspecialiserad vård för ryggmärgsskadade.

Som specialistläkare inom våra verksamheter arbetar du i nära samarbete med övriga medlemmar i det multidisciplinära teamet. Utöver den högspecialiserade vården deltar du i och har övergripande medicinskt ansvar för bedömning, vård, behandling och rehabilitering av vuxna patienter med neurologisk sjukdom och stroke. Arbetet sker såväl i öppen- som slutenvård.

Här deltar du aktivt i verksamhetens kvalitets- och utvecklingsarbete. Du arbetar bland annat med utveckling av samarbete med externa aktörer, både nationellt och regionalt. Förutom patientnära arbete deltar du i undervisning och handledning av läkarstudenter och ST-läkare.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är specialistläkare i rehabiliteringsmedicin. Det viktigaste för oss är att du har ett intresse av att arbeta med förvärvade ryggmärgsskador, hjärnskador samt neurologisk rehabilitering. Intresse och erfarenhet av forskning och undervisning är meriterande, men inget krav. 

Eftersom vi arbetar i team med många yrkeskategorier är det viktigt att du har god samarbetsförmåga. Språkkunskaper krävs som motsvarar svenska C1 enligt GERS (Gemensam europeisk referensram för språk).

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Tillträde när sakkunniggranskning är klar.

Vi kontrollerar din legitimation och specialistbevis som läkare mot socialstyrelsen så du behöver inte skicka in dessa bevis.

Om dina meriter inte är sakkunniggranskade sedan tidigare, ska det ske före tillträde i enlighet med Förordning (1998:1518) om behörighet till vissa anställningar inom hälso- och sjukvården m.m.

Därför ska följande dokumentation bifogas din ansökan:

1) Vetenskapliga meriter (om tillämpligt)

a. Intyg om akademisk grad, exempelvis medicine doktor eller docent

b. Fullständig publikationslista

2) Pedagogiska meriter (om tillämpligt)

a. Intyg/dokumentation om undervisningserfarenhet

b. Intyg om handledarkurs (grund- eller specialistutbildning)

3) Kliniska och övriga meriter (om tillämpligt)

a. Intyg om sub-specialisering

b. Intyg/dokumentation om ledningsuppdrag och/eller verksamhetsutveckling

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan

https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
Position Summary


Avum is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to develop, maintain, and execute automated testing solutions supporting Department of Defense programs. This hands-on role combines software development and quality assurance to improve test coverage, identify defects, and support reliable software releases.


The ideal candidate has experience with object-oriented programming, the Page Object Model, data-driven testing, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. The SDET will work closely with developers, analysts, and QA team members to maintain automation frameworks, troubleshoot test failures, and ensure applications meet functional, performance, and quality requirements.



Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain reusable automated test frameworks and test suites for complex federal applications.
  • Create data-driven automated tests using external data sources such as JSON, CSV, Excel, or databases.
  • Use the Page Object Model and object-oriented programming principles to separate test logic from user interface elements, reduce code duplication, and improve maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain automated functional, regression, smoke, integration, performance, and load tests.
  • Support the integration and execution of automated tests within CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Monitor automated test results, investigate failures, identify root causes, and work with developers to resolve defects.
  • Update automated tests as application features, user interfaces, and business requirements change.
  • Analyze application workflows and business rules to identify reusable testing patterns and opportunities to increase automation coverage.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and follow established coding and automation standards.
  • Collaborate with developers, analysts, and manual QA team members to identify testing needs and close coverage gaps.
  • Stay current on testing tools, libraries, and automation practices and provide recommendations when appropriate.
  • Maintain test plans, automation documentation, execution results, defect records, and testing metrics in support of contract and compliance requirements.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, release planning, and other team activities


Compensation


The salary range for this position is $100,000-$120,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, certifications, and geographic location. Avum offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical (Cigna), dental and vision (Principal), 401(k), PTO, education reimbursement, and certification reimbursement.

title: Student Experience Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Student Experience Associate based in Australia.

As a Student Experience Associate, you’ll play a central role in supporting Mandarin-speaking students and families throughout their academic journey. You’ll build trusted relationships with students and parents, acting as a consistent point of contact and providing timely, personalised support. The role combines student service, problem-solving, communication, and administration within a fully remote international environment. You’ll help students overcome challenges while identifying ways to improve their overall experience and outcomes. You’ll also contribute to onboarding, orientation, and support processes tailored to families in the Chinese market. Working cross-functionally with academic, product, sales, and admissions teams, you’ll help create scalable solutions that make student support more effective.

  • Provide high-quality, responsive support to Mandarin-speaking students and parents, helping create positive academic outcomes and a strong overall experience.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with students and families, serving as their primary point of contact throughout the year.
  • Provide personalised solutions based on each student’s goals, academic performance, circumstances, and potential barriers to success.
  • Communicate effectively through channels including WhatsApp, email, and Zoom calls, ensuring queries are handled promptly and professionally.
  • Conduct regular check-ins with students and parents to understand their needs, identify concerns, and provide proactive support.
  • Manage administrative processes including subject changes, withdrawals, re-enrolments, and updates across relevant administrative and educational systems.

Job Description

Senior Software Engineer

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours/week)
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Senior Software Engineers to support an AI training project by creating reinforcement learning environments that evaluate AI models on complex software engineering tasks using Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.

You will design reproducible environments, deterministic verification, and reference solutions for tasks such as bug fixing, feature implementation, codebase refactoring, and performance optimization. No prior AI experience is required.

  • Create reinforcement learning environments for software engineering tasks.
  • Design tasks involving bug fixing, feature development, refactoring, and performance optimization.
  • Build deterministic verification systems and golden reference solutions.
  • Evaluate AI agents' ability to reason through complex codebases and use MCP tools effectively.
  • Develop realistic, reproducible software engineering scenarios.
  • Ensure tasks accurately measure coding ability, problem-solving, and tool usage.
  • Document solutions and provide clear technical feedback.
Required Skills
  • Strong proficiency in Python 3, Java, Rust, C++, or TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms and data structures.
  • Experience with bug fixing and debugging complex software issues.
  • Proven experience in feature implementation and codebase refactoring.
  • Strong knowledge of performance optimization and tuning.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Strong attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with large-scale or distributed codebases.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML systems is a plus but not required.
  • Experience with rigorous code reviews and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience working effectively in remote or cross-functional teams.

  1. Submit an application and screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview (~30 minutes).
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.

Compensation is output-based, with payment provided per task that meets project specifications. Minimum weekly submission requirements may apply.

Availability

Selected experts should be prepared to begin their first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Global Outcomes Research Lead
description:
Make your mark for patients

PIM Outcomes Research Lead

We are looking for a strategic, collaborative and scientifically driven PIM Outcomes Research Lead to join our PIM ISEG Operations team. This role can be based at our Global Headquarters in Brussels (Belgium), our Monheim office (Germany), or our Slough office (United Kingdom). In this highly visible position, you will help shape how evidence is generated, translated into impact, and leveraged to support healthcare decision-making across markets.

About the role

As PIM Outcomes Research Lead, you will play a critical role in advancing evidence generation across our Patient Impact organization. Working at the intersection of science, strategy, and execution, you will enable country and regional teams to develop and deliver evidence generation initiatives that support healthcare decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the organization, helping teams navigate complex scientific, operational, and strategic challenges while ensuring evidence generation activities remain compliant, impactful, and aligned with business priorities.

Who you'll work with

You will form a close partnership within your team with the PIM ISEG Leads focusing on the key Therapeutic Areas (TAs) and collaborate closely with regional and local evidence generation teams, ISEG Heads, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Health Economics, Real-World Evidence specialists, governance bodies, and external research partners.

What you'll do

• Partner with country and regional teams to shape evidence generation strategies that address critical healthcare decision-making needs and create meaningful value for patients, healthcare systems, and UCB.

• Provide strategic guidance on outcomes research, real-world evidence, epidemiology, and broader evidence generation initiatives, ensuring studies are scientifically robust, operationally feasible, and fit for purpose.

• Translate complex business, medical, and stakeholder requirements into actionable evidence plans, helping teams define clear objectives, study concepts, intended audiences, and evidence utilization strategies.

• Guide teams through complex evidence generation challenges by assessing risks, evaluating trade-offs, and recommending execution approaches that balance scientific rigor, compliance requirements, timelines, and business impact.

• Act as a trusted advisor across a highly matrixed global environment, influencing stakeholders and driving alignment without formal people management responsibility.

• Connect local teams with internal subject matter experts and external research partners to ensure the right expertise, capabilities, and resources are available throughout the evidence generation lifecycle.

• Drive high-quality execution by promoting adherence to governance requirements, quality standards, and compliant evidence generation practices across supported activities.

• Strengthen organizational capability by coaching teams, sharing best practices, fostering innovation, and continuously improving evidence generation approaches to maximize impact and decision relevance.

Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

• Master's degree in Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics, Outcomes Research, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biostatistics, or a related scientific discipline. An advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD or equivalent) is considered an advantage.

• Extensive experience in Outcomes Research, Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR), Real-World Evidence, Epidemiology, Market Access Evidence Generation, or a related function within the biopharmaceutical industry.

• Strong expertise in evidence generation methodologies and a demonstrated ability to advise on study design, execution strategies, and evidence planning in a global environment.

• Deep understanding of how evidence supports healthcare decision-making, value demonstration, reimbursement, patient access, and broader market access objectives.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex cross-functional initiatives within a matrix organization.

• Experience managing scientific, operational, or strategic trade-offs while maintaining a focus on quality, compliance, and business impact.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear recommendations.

• Experience collaborating with external research organizations, consultancies, academic institutions, and other evidence generation partners.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively across countries, functions, and cultures in a global organization.

• Commitment to continuous improvement and a passion for generating high-quality evidence that improves outcomes for patients.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
About the Team

Customer Experience Specialist take pride in delivering premier customer service and a world class experience to thousands of customers every day. This is a critical frontline role that touches every operation at Opendoor and supports customers during the most meaningful financial decision of their lifetime. As an Experience Advocate your day will consist of navigating phones and written communications through multiple platforms, as well as collaborating with internal stakeholders to improve the customer experience. You’ll have a front-row seat to view the complexity of our mission and help us build industry-defining solutions while developing real estate mastery along the way.

Role Responsibilities

  • Be the face and voice of Opendoor handling the sophisticated needs of our customers with integrity, empathy, and efficiency.
  • Guide customers to understand all aspects of the Opendoor home-buying and home-selling process by responding quickly to questions and unresolved issues.
  • Respond to incoming calls from customers, agents, neighbors, vendors, and partners wanting to learn about Opendoor. This includes assistance with home information, transactions, buying and selling programs, feedback, and partnerships.
  • Own tough customer interactions that require de-escalation, gathering detailed information, and developing pathways for communication.
  • Act as a liaison between customers and internal partners to resolve customer issues.
  • Navigate internal and external knowledge resources to assist in your discernment, find solutions and deliver accurate information.
  • Continuously develop your real estate and Opendoor knowledge by participating in training and discussions.
  • Cultivate a positive environment through engagement and peer interactions while maintaining a growth mindset.
  • Work closely with internal teams (sales, agents, pricing, home operations) and external partners (title/escrow, lenders) to deliver a perfect experience to customers.
  • Deeply understand our customer's needs and share insights with our product teams to improve the customer experience and develop new programs that set Opendoor apart.
  • Meet team performance goals consistently (adherence, productivity, and CSAT)
  • Remain flexible to work schedules that will include weeknight or weekend coverage

Skills Needed

  • Mission-driven. You believe in our mission to empower everyone with the freedom to move and can’t stop thinking about how we can improve upon our outstanding customer experience.
  • Hungry. You have the horsepower and whatever-it-takes attitude to give your customers a delightful experience working outside of normal business hours including weekends.
  • True empaths. What gets you out of bed each morning is connecting with and helping people from all walks of life. You naturally put the needs of others before your own and derive energy from helping people.
  • All about the team. You grow by empowering others and taking the time to cultivate growth in your teammates. Before anyone asks, you’re always there to lend extra capacity when the team gets overextended.
  • Skilled communicators + active listeners. You have limitless perseverance and enjoy the challenge of explaining a complex concept multiple times in different ways until a customer truly gets it. This can happen throughout a 45-minute phone call or 10 text messages and you don’t bat an eye.
  • Solution-oriented. Everyone notices problems, do you have a bias towards action? When a current policy is crafting customer friction or you’re certain a new tool could make our customer interactions more efficient, this gets you excited. You scope the problem, capture supporting evidence, and propose a solution.
  • Coachable. You have an appetite for feedback and receive it with passion, seeking out opportunities to become a better operator.
  • Adaptive and flexible operators. You work well in ambiguity, feel comfortable context-shifting, and adapt quickly to changing processes and tools.

Bonus points if:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Experience in a fast paced, high volume call environment
  • Experience or knowledge in real estate
  • Efficient in simultaneously navigating multiple systems

Requirements:

  • Must be in office for all scheduled working days that fall on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday. Weekend work is remote.
    • *Wednesdays are optional but not required
  • Schedule: Friday-Tuesday. Shifts are 11:00AM-8:00PM or 1:00PM-10:00PM MST.
  • Location: This role is based in Tempe in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Compensation:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. Base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The U.S. pay for this position is $25 hourly. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on your qualifications, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific hourly range for the job location during the hiring process. We also offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, 12 paid holidays per year, medical/dental/vision insurance, basic life insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees.

title: Quality Intern - Summer 2027
description:
• Location: Plymouth, Michigan

  • Pay: $28.00 per hour

  • Program start: Tuesday, May 25, 2027, with limited flexibility for academic calendars

  • Duration: 10 weeks, with the possibility of extending up to two additional weeks based on business needs and intern availability

  • Schedule: Full time, 40 hours per week, on site

Help Build Quality into Every Part

As a Quality Intern at MacLean-Fogg, you will connect what you are learning in the classroom with the products and processes behind a manufacturing business. You will work with quality professionals, engineers, and production teams to understand requirements, investigate problems, and help make products and processes more consistent.

You will take ownership of a meaningful project with guidance from an experienced team. Depending on your assignment, you might analyze defect trends, investigate a recurring issue, improve an inspection method, or make quality information easier to use. At the end of the program, you will present your work, findings, and recommendations to facility leadership.

One application connects you with the Quality internship assignments available at this manufacturing facility. Tell us which areas interest you. We will consider your interests, coursework, and experience alongside available projects and business needs.

Quality Areas You Could Explore

Assignments vary by manufacturing facility and may include:

  • Quality Engineering and Problem-Solving: Investigate defects, help identify causes, and support actions that prevent problems from recurring.

  • Measurement, Inspection, and Testing: Learn how teams check product requirements, use measurement tools, and document reliable results.

  • Quality Data and Process Improvement: Analyze trends in defects, scrap, or rework and help teams evaluate opportunities for improvement.

  • Quality Systems and Documentation: Help improve inspection instructions, records, and processes that support consistent work and traceability.

  • Supplier and Customer Quality: Support the review of quality concerns, organize evidence, and help teams track follow-up actions.

You do not need prior experience in these areas. Not every assignment is available at every location.

What You Will Do

  • Learn the products, processes, and quality requirements relevant to your assignment.

  • Gather and organize measurements, observations, and other evidence to understand a problem.

  • Use spreadsheets or other tools to identify patterns and communicate findings.

  • Work with team members to investigate causes and evaluate potential improvements.

  • Support testing or verification of changes under the guidance of qualified team members.

  • Document your work accurately, ask questions when results are unclear, and raise concerns promptly.

  • Follow safety procedures, required training, and instructions for working in manufacturing and laboratory areas.

  • Share project progress, seek feedback, and present your results and recommendations.

What You Bring

  • Enrollment in a bachelor's or master's degree program in engineering, engineering technology, quality technology, materials science, statistics, or a closely related technical field.

  • Interest in manufacturing, product quality, measurement, or process improvement.

  • A thoughtful approach to solving problems and checking your work.

  • Willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and work with people in different roles.

  • Ability to organize information and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • Availability for a full-time, on-site summer internship. Limited start-date flexibility may be available for academic calendars.

All college class levels are welcome. Previous internship experience is not required. Coursework, labs, projects, volunteering, student activities, and other jobs can demonstrate your potential.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • A cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

  • Coursework or projects involving statistics, measurement, manufacturing, materials, or process improvement.

  • Experience using Excel or another tool to organize and analyze data.

  • Exposure to drawings, measurement tools, inspection methods, or structured problem-solving.

What You Will Gain

  • Ownership of a project with a clear business purpose and defined deliverable.

  • Coaching and feedback from experienced team members.

  • Practical experience working with manufacturing data, products, and processes.

  • Opportunities to collaborate across functions and present your work to leadership.

  • A closer look at potential career paths in Quality and manufacturing.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

The physical demands below represent those required to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Sit at a workstation and use a computer for extended periods.

  • Move throughout manufacturing areas to observe equipment, processes, and production activities.

  • Occasionally lift and carry tools, samples, or parts weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, and reach when observing equipment or components.

  • Review drawings, gauges, measurement equipment, and other visual information.

  • Wear required personal protective equipment, which may include safety glasses, hearing protection, and safety footwear.

  • Work in office and manufacturing environments where noise, temperature variation, and airborne particulates may be present.

What to Expect After Applying

Our hiring process includes an application, Criteria assessments, application and assessment review, a recruiter screen, and a 45-minute interview with the hiring team. Candidates selected for an offer receive a conditional offer followed by required pre-employment screening before hire.

This position requires a pre-employment drug screen after a conditional offer. A criminal background check may also be required, depending on the role. Screening and employment decisions are administered consistent with applicable law.

About MacLean-Fogg

MacLean-Fogg is a fourth-generation, family-owned American manufacturing company headquartered in Mundelein, Illinois. Founded in 1925, we design and manufacture engineered components and solutions for automotive and industrial markets.

Our portfolio includes MacLean-Fogg Component Solutions, OMCO, Mallard Manufacturing, and Threadstrong. Across our companies, we share a commitment to Safety, Integrity, People, Excellence, and Stewardship while investing in our people, manufacturing capabilities, customers, and communities.

Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodations

MacLean-Fogg and its affiliated companies are equal opportunity employers. We provide equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply, complete an assessment, or participate in the hiring process, contact careers@macleanfogg.com.

company: Montgomery County Coalition for the Homeless
description:
General Description: The Case Coordinator is a seasonal role which works with overflow clients that require an individual with housing first and trauma informed care knowledge. This position requires a skilled worker in motivational interviewing and ability to meet clients where they are and move them quickly into permanent housing.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Maintain an active caseload of overflow clients who need housing-focused individualized case management.
  • Assess overflow client’s needs and appropriate services and assist in implementing service plans.

title: Senior Manual QA (Front SEO)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manual QA (Front SEO) based in Netherlands.

You’ll join a growing QA team and play a key role in ensuring the quality, stability, and search performance of web products.
The role combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on frontend and technical SEO-related functionality.
You’ll work across the full software testing lifecycle, from analyzing requirements and preparing test documentation to validating releases and supporting features in production.
Your work will directly contribute to reliable, high-quality digital experiences and help teams identify and resolve issues efficiently.
You’ll collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and other departments in a fast-moving, technology-focused environment.
There’s also room to influence testing practices, improve processes, and contribute to the evolution of QA methodologies.
The position is fully remote and offers opportunities for continuous learning, professional growth, and meaningful technical ownership.

Accountabilities

  • Analyze technical requirements and participate in discussions around upcoming tasks and features.
  • Create and maintain test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and functional descriptions.
  • Support the delivery of code to test environments and production by validating releases and identifying potential issues.
  • Perform functional, regression, and acceptance testing of web products.
  • Analyze test execution results and maintain existing test suites to ensure they remain relevant and effective.
  • Test frontend functionality with particular attention to technical SEO factors and search-engine accessibility.
  • Conduct product and feature demos when required.
  • Collaborate with other departments by providing testing insights and helping investigate problematic situations.
  • Track and support features and defects throughout the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, testing approaches, and overall product quality.
  • Work closely with development and product teams to ensure issues are clearly documented, prioritized, and resolved.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in a Manual QA or Software Testing role.
    • Strong understanding of client-server architecture for web applications.
    • Good knowledge of HTML and CSS and practical experience testing websites.
    • Experience applying test design techniques to create effective and comprehensive test coverage.
    • Strong ability to create and maintain test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and functional specifications.
    • Hands-on experience with Git, Jenkins, and GitLab.
    • Experience using browser Developer Tools for debugging, inspection, and testing.
    • Understanding of technical SEO concepts such as indexing, crawling, microdata/schema.org, HTTP status codes, headers, and the impact of rendering on search-engine indexing is a strong advantage.

title: Autism Evaluator - LCSW - Contract/1099
description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As an Autism Evaluator at Blackbird Health, you will play a central role in giving families clarity and long-term support by combining neurodevelopmental diagnostic evaluations (specifically autism spectrum assessments) with ongoing, evidence-based psychotherapy.

Working alongside an interdisciplinary care team, you will help kids, adolescents, young adults and families gain diagnostic clarity and transition seamlessly into effective, whole-child care. This role offers flexible customization to align your direct care hours between testing and therapy based on clinician strengths, business needs, and patient demand.

What Makes You, You

  • Clinically Skilled Evaluator: Skilled (or eager to grow) in neurodevelopmental diagnostic tools (ADOS-2, ASRS, CARS-2) with an aptitude for synthesizing complex data into clear, actionable formulations.
  • Therapeutically Grounded: Passionate about delivering high-quality, evidence-based psychotherapy to children, adolescents, and young adults.
  • Developmentally & Neurodiverse-Informed: Skilled at meeting individuals where they are across developmental stages and neurodiverse profiles.
  • Interdisciplinary Collaborator: Thrives in a team-based model, working alongside psychiatric nurse practitioners, executive function coaches, and speech/language therapists.
  • Organized & Agile: Comfortable managing a dynamic schedule that balances autism evaluations, report writing, feedback appointments, and ongoing therapy sessions.
  • Family-Centered Communicator: Able to convey diagnostic findings and complex clinical feedback to families with deep empathy, clarity, and care.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Autism Evaluations & Diagnostics

  • Conduct Assessments: Perform neurodevelopmental diagnostic evaluations, focusing on autism spectrum evaluations (ADOS-2, ASRS, CARS-2).
  • Synthesize & Formulate: Analyze, interpret, and synthesize assessment data into clear, clinically sound diagnostic conclusions.
  • Deliver Family Feedback: Provide clear, compassionate feedback to clients and families following evaluations, outlining recommendations and care pathways.
  • Manage Evaluation Timelines: Complete progress notes within 24 hours of service and oversee report-writing, feedback appointments, and schedule adjustments.
  • Care Team Alignment: Communicate evaluation findings directly to the broader interdisciplinary team and participate in weekly clinical consultations.

Psychotherapy & Clinical Care

  • Deliver Evidence-Based Care: Provide direct psychotherapy to a tailored caseload of pediatric and young adult clients.
  • Conduct Diagnostic Intakes: Perform biopsychosocial assessments for incoming therapy clients to establish individualized treatment plans.
  • Drive Integrated Outcomes: Partner with multidisciplinary providers to establish and maintain comprehensive, integrated treatment plans.
  • Maintain High Documentation Standards: Track patient progress continuously and complete accurate, timely clinical documentation.

Schedule & Work Model

  • Onsite Commitment: Minimum of 2 days per week onsite at the assigned clinic location (primarily dedicated to direct patient care and evaluation appointments). Remaining responsibilities may be completed remotely.
  • After-School Coverage: To support school-aged children and families, a schedule that includes weekday hours after 3 PM or weekends is preferred.
  • Role Customization: Productivity and split between autism evaluations and therapy sessions are customized per clinician and documented upon hire.

The Basics You’ll Need

  • Active, independent LCSW license in Pennsylvania.
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience delivering clinical care to children, adolescents, and families.
  • Exceptional clinical writing and diagnostic documentation skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience conducting autism spectrum or neurodevelopmental diagnostic evaluations.
  • Familiarity or formal training in standardized diagnostic tools (ADOS-2, ASRS, CARS).
  • Background in integrated or collaborative pediatric mental health settings.

Why Blackbird is Unique

  • Hybrid Variety: Enjoy a balanced mix of testing and ongoing therapy without the burnout of mono-focused caseloads.
  • Integrated Support: Work within a full ecosystem of PMHNPs, therapists, and specialty coaches.
  • Administrative & Credentialing Support: We handle billing, credentialing, and scheduling logistics so you can focus on clinical care.
  • Paid Consultation & Training: Dedicated time for multidisciplinary team consults and ongoing diagnostic skill development.
Salary Range
$80—$95 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

title: Team Lead, Paint
description:

Our unwavering commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction has position us as an industry leader. Job Summary: The Paint Department Team Leader is responsible for leading and supporting the Paint Department team while helping ensure production goals, quality standards, and safety expectations are met. This role works closely with management to communicate goals and deadlines, support team members, assist with training and hiring, and help maintain an efficient and organized department.   • Monitor team member work for quality, safety, productivity, and compliance with company guidelines.

  • Assist management with hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members.
  • Answer team member questions and help address work-related concerns or problems.
  • Conduct team meetings to communicate best practices, safety expectations, and ongoing department goals.
  • Manage department inventory and supplies, maintain accurate records, and communicate ordering needs to management.
  • Maintain daily reports and communicate department performance, production needs, and concerns to management.
  • Help maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment at all times.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



Docusign is looking for an amazing Lead Software Engineer to join our development team in Bengaluru. This position will be part of a team working on an architectural shift that will allow us to scale to meet the next 10x of growth. We need back end engineers to build next generation software and services that make up the agreement cloud. Who can work with Product Managers to build and ship customer scenarios that are used by 100s of enterprises. This position will demand critical thinking skills, ability to quickly understand existing systems and the ability to work in agile, fast paced environments. The ability to take smart and educated risks is essential to the success of this position.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering.

Responsibility

  • Be open minded, forward thinking, and passionate about great software

  • Think about how to solve problems in scale and build fault tolerant systems

  • Develop testable, high-quality, and ship-ready code with ample test coverage

  • Work with Product Management and other developers to understand and translate engineering requirements into design requirements and provide estimates

  • Work as part of a cross-site development team to drive design, implementation, testing and development and release of products


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Informatics or equivalent

  • 5+ years development experience building large scale distributed systems

  • Experience working with C#, .Net Core, SQL Database and Designing Large scale distributed systems

Preferred

  • Experience building/consuming RESTful web-services

  • Experience with microservice architecture

  • Experience shipping highly available, scalable service on Azure

  • Experiences with the entire software development lifecycle, including version control (git) build process, testing, and code release

  • Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-moving environment

  • Agile and Test-driven development methodologies

  • Ability and desire to move across technology stacks

  • Passion for working on a highly available site

  • A passion to learn new software technologies


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Component Operator
description:
About Evans Group:

Evans, an electronic components company, is a trusted partner in the military, aerospace, industrial, and commercial markets, with over a century of combined experience as a reliable problem-solver. Being part of the Evans Group portfolio has enabled Evans to continue developing cutting-edge capacitor technology alongside other world-class technology companies that represent the future of mission-critical electronics.

Evans, with sites in East Providence, RI, Sanford, ME, and Phoenix, AZ, manufactures high-energy-density capacitors for demanding, mission-critical applications. We have the most power-dense capacitor technology in the industry and are routinely specified for defense, aerospace, and energy exploration applications where high reliability and SWaP (space, weight, and power) savings are critical design considerations.


Component Operator, East Providence, RI

Reporting to the Production Supervisor, the Component Operator will be responsible for running a mechanical press to process raw materials into sub-components.

Expected Hours: Full-time Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the manufacturing of capacitor components.
  • Safely operate production machinery and equipment including press machines according to established procedures.
  • Read and follow drawings, blueprints, specifications, etc.
  • Load materials and ensure proper alignment and positioning prior to machining.
  • Adjust parameters to meet product specifications.
  • Perform in-process quality checks, including but not limited to measuring thickness, weight, and surface quality.
  • Handle fragile materials with care to avoid contamination or damage.
  • Clean and maintain machinery and work area to comply with cleanliness and safety standards.
  • Identify and report equipment malfunctions or material inconsistencies to supervisors, Quality or Engineering.
  • Work closely with Production Supervisor, technicians, operators, Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure work is completed to quality standards, following written procedures, and prioritized based on customer demand.
  • Use basic computer skills to navigate and input data into production systems to track progress, document results, and communicate effectively with the team.
  • Operate measurement devices such as calipers and gauges to measure products and ensure they meet company standards.
  • Maintain a safe working environment by following company and industry procedures and standards.
  • Additional duties as assigned

title: Industrial Painter
description:
Company Overview: Whirlwind Steel is a premier metal building manufacturer specializing in the design, fabrication, and delivery of top-quality metal structures. Our unwavering commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction has positioned us as an industry leader. This has allowed us to become creators and distributors of buildings and products that people use to live, learn, worship, work, and play.


Job Summary:

The Industrial Painter is responsible for preparing metal surfaces and applying primer and finish coatings to manufactured steel products and equipment. This position plays an important role in the final appearance, durability, and quality of our products.

The ideal candidate takes pride in their work, pays close attention to surface preparation and coating application, and follows established safety and quality procedures.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Prepare steel and other surfaces for coating by removing dirt, oil, grease, rust, and other contaminants.
  • Use appropriate cleaning products and surface-preparation methods to ensure coatings properly adhere to the material.
  • Prepare, measure, and blend paints, primers, and other coating materials according to required specifications.
  • Set up and inspect spray equipment, including hoses, spray guns, nozzles, and related components.
  • Adjust spray equipment settings to achieve appropriate coverage, pressure, and spray patterns.
  • Apply primer and finish coatings evenly while maintaining consistent coverage and appearance.
  • Inspect completed work for coverage, finish quality, and other coating defects and address issues as needed.
  • Remove corrosion and surface imperfections using grinders, wire brushes, steel wool, and other hand or power tools.
  • Safely move and position materials using overhead cranes and monorail paint hoists.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, and the work area in a clean and orderly condition.
  • Follow all company safety procedures, PPE requirements, and applicable workplace practices.
  • Work cooperatively with other production team members to meet quality and production expectations.

title: Campus Security Officer
description:
The MBKU Campus Safety & Security Department is dedicated to ensuring the University community’s right to a safe environment through exemplary and professional service. Officers are responsible for protecting MBKU buildings, grounds, assets, employees, students and visitors against criminal activity, accidents, fires and natural disasters. This may be accomplished by foot patrol of campus, walkways, parking lots, administrative and academic buildings as well as other satellite locations.

  • Work Shift: Saturdays and Sundays 6:00 AM - 2:00 PM
  • Location: Fullerton, California

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide security to premises and MBKU personnel by patrolling all buildings to ensure that the campus is safe and secure
  • Maintain high visibility while conducting patrol check(s)
  • Inspect all exterior and interior doors to ensure that they are secured and lights off after hours
  • Provide lock/unlock services for University community
  • Check in authorized vendors, visitors, and guest
  • Patrol and inspect property to protect it from theft, vandalism, or other criminal activities
  • Escort any loiterers or unauthorized visitors off campus
  • Document shift activity in daily activity report (DAR)
  • Patrol all parking lots for any violations and issue warnings or citations if necessary
  • Effectively and appropriately respond to any emergency situations
  • Monitor Closed Circuit TV (CCTV) cameras
  • Operate access control system
  • Accept additional duties and/or responsibilities as assigned or modified by your supervisor or the Director of Campus Safety & Security

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Be of good moral character, with no felony convictions or misdemeanor convictions
  • Able to communicate effectively orally and in writing
  • Be able to think quickly and critically
  • Be mindful of customer service and public service
  • Exercise good judgment in potentially dangerous situations
  • Conduct oneself with Integrity, Professionalism, and be Dependable
  • Work well independently, with others, and with little to no supervision
  • Maintain emotional control under high stress situations
  • Be proficient in the use of Microsoft Word
  • Successfully secure a Security Guard Card, Pepper Spray Permit, and Baton Permit issued by the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS).
  • Be able to meet deadlines with severe time constraints

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED)
  • Six months of related experience and/or training

title: Director, DP MSAT
description:
Each of us cares about someone who will need medicines. That’s why our vision is to repeatedly beat the odds to deliver breakthrough medicines to patients who need them. We pursue truth and scientific rigour and have the courage to work at the edge of the unknown.

We're looking for a Director, Drug Product (DP) MSAT to define and lead our Manufacturing Sciences and Technology strategy for biological drug products. In this role, you'll serve as the senior technical authority for contract drug product and fill-finish manufacturing, setting the strategic and technical direction for external manufacturing partners across new product introductions, technology transfers, process performance, and complex issue resolution. You'll carry final accountability for batch documentation approval, technical report authorship, sampling plan design, and equipment and process qualification, while holding CDMOs and vendors to rigorous technical and delivery standards. You'll also bridge internal development, procurement, and regulatory functions, shaping raw material and equipment requirements and contributing directly to regulatory filings and agency responses. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, leading through influence, and helping a growing biologics program take shape, we'd love to hear from you.

How you might spend your days

  • Serving as the senior subject matter expert for DP/fill-finish manufacturing processes and technologies, guiding external manufacturing, new product introductions, technology transfers, and the resolution of complex process issues across the biopharmaceutical DP portfolio .
  • Directing technology transfer of drug product manufacturing processes to external manufacturing facilities, from strategy through execution
  • Owning final review and approval of CDMO cGMP batch documentation (master batch records, component specifications, protocols, material specifications, etc.) required to support cGMP production
  • Driving process performance improvement in close collaboration with internal and external teams, setting the technical direction for how performance is measured and advanced
  • Authoring and approving DP technical reports (process characterization, /protocols, and validations) in support of cGMP activities and licensure
  • Directing the development of sampling plans for cGMP batches related to process characterization, process qualification, lot release, stability, and related activities.
  • Leading equipment selection, qualification, and start-up activities, and ensuring manufacturing partners operate with robust, well-established procedures
  • Providing senior oversight of CDMO investigations, root cause determination, and CAPA identification and implementation for manufacturing deviations
  • Partnering with DP development and procurement teams to define technical requirements associated with raw materials, components, equipment, and services, and holding external vendors accountable to delivery timelines
  • Contributing to the drafting of regulatory filings and providing expert response to regulatory information requests

We’d love to hear from you if

  • You have 15+ years of industry experience in DP development and manufacturing of monoclonal and/or bispecific antibodies, and a bachelor's degree in science or engineering discipline; device and combination product experience a plus
  • You have outstanding command of the scientific and technical principles underlying drug products and aseptic fill-finish operations for vial and prefilled syringe presentations
  • You have deep knowledge of GMP requirements, pharmaceutical manufacturing regulations, and validation and qualification principles, and apply sound judgment in ambiguous or high-stakes situations
  • You have significant experience in pre-formulation and formulation methods supporting t pre-clinical and clinical programs
  • You have a track record leading technology transfer and scaling monoclonal antibody processes; experience with late stage development of biologics and licensure is a plus
  • You have proven experience managing and partnering with CMOs/CDMOs, including holding external partners accountable to technical, quality, and timeline commitments
  • You are passionate about building capabilities from the ground up, and thrive on establishing new functions that accomplish important goals
  • You are a creative, forward-looking thinker who anticipates issues before they arise and sets others up to do the same
  • You bring strong operational and risk management acumen, and drive data-based decision making across teams

What we offer

AbCellera’s hiring range for this role is CAD $200,000 - $250,000 annually, commensurate with your education and job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer equity, annual bonus dependent on team and company performance, and a 6% (non-match) RRSP contribution.

You will have a CAD $1,500 annual Active Lifestyle Allowance, annual vacation, professional development opportunities, and comprehensive health benefits. Scientific and technical mentorship is a priority. And you’ll find a strong sense of community and connections across AbCellera through our work, clubs, and socials.

About AbCellera

Creating medicines is the most important work we can do.

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, and oncology. We have built a platform for advancing antibody drug programs from target to clinic, and we are using it to build our internal pipeline.

Today, our pipeline includes two drug candidates in clinical development, two preclinical development candidates (DCs) in Investigational New Drug (IND)-enabling activities, and more than 20 active discovery programs across multiple modalities and indications.

We believe that when tenacious people share a vision and work together, they can truly have a positive impact. That’s why we hire for character and intelligence, not just for CVs or experience.

We look for people with drive and energy. People we trust. People who need to know their days are being well spent. That their work really matters. In the end, our success will be measured by the impact of our medicines.

title: Directional Drill Locator
description:
A Directional Drill Locator (also known as an HDD Locator) is a specialized professional responsible for guiding a drilling crew through underground terrain to install infrastructure while avoiding existing utilities. In this position, you will be the "eyes" of the drilling operation. You will use advanced electronic equipment to track the position, depth, and direction of the drill head in real-time, communicating vital steering data to the drill operator. Your primary goal is to ensure the bore path follows the engineered plan while preventing "strikes" to buried gas, electric, water, or telecommunications lines.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Drill Head Tracking: Operate specialized HDD locating systems (e.g., Subsite, Falcon, or Vermeer) to monitor the drill head's location, angle, and temperature during active boring.
  • Utility Identification: Use electromagnetic (EM) locators and ground-penetrating radar (GPR) to identify and mark existing underground utilities before drilling begins.
  • Real-Time Communication: Provide constant verbal or hand-signal guidance to the drill operator to adjust the bore path and avoid obstacles.
  • Site Preparation: Read and interpret utility maps, blueprints, and "811" tickets; conduct site inspections to identify potential hazards like soil changes or congested infrastructure.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate bore logs and project records, including depth readings and as-built sketches for the completed installation.
  • Support Operations: Assist the crew with mixing drilling fluids ("mud"), setting up the drill rig, and "daylighting" (potholing) to visually confirm the location of critical utility crossings.

title: Principal Backend Architect / Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Backend Architect / Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure) based in Brazil.

This is a senior, hands-on architecture role focused on shaping the backend foundation of multiple products and guiding the evolution of a large-scale platform. You will define server-side architecture while leading the incremental transformation of a monolith into well-bounded services. The role combines deep C#/.NET and Azure expertise with event-driven architecture, API design, data access, and DevOps practices. You will establish engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, and robust service contracts. You will also champion the practical use of agentic AI tools in everyday software development and help raise the technical capabilities of the wider team. Working closely with architects and engineers, you will influence technical decisions while continuing to design, code, review, and build solutions yourself.

Accountabilities:

  • Define backend architecture across products and lead the incremental decomposition and migration of the monolith into well-bounded services using safe, reversible engineering approaches.
  • Establish and enforce backend engineering standards, shared libraries, service templates, API contracts, versioning practices, and backward compatibility principles.
  • Design and guide event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, including delivery guarantees, retries, idempotency, failure handling, and poison-message management.
  • Partner closely with the Data Architect on transactional boundaries, data-access models, query performance, and integrations with customers and external partners.
  • Lead by example in the daily use of agentic AI development tools and help elevate the team's technical practices and capabilities.
  • Create Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), conduct reviews of critical pull requests, mentor engineers, contribute to incident response, and participate in quarterly technical planning.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of backend development or software engineering experience, including several years in formal architecture or technical leadership roles.
    • Deep expertise in C#/.NET with strong hands-on experience working with Azure, particularly Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Data Factory.
    • Practical experience with PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, and Snowflake, as well as CI/CD and DevOps practices.
    • Demonstrated experience incrementally migrating or decomposing monolithic applications, favoring safe and reversible steps over large-scale rewrites.
    • Strong understanding of asynchronous messaging, event-driven systems, idempotency, dead-lettering, and robust API design.
    • Daily, hands-on experience with agentic AI development tools, such as Claude, Claude Code, or similar technologies.
    • Experience building with AI, including agents, reusable skills, MCP servers, and evaluation workflows.
    • Strong hands-on engineering mindset: this is not a pure management or theoretical architecture position, and you should remain actively involved in coding and solution development.
    • Strong technical communication, problem-solving, mentoring, and collaboration skills.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working arrangement.
      • Remote opportunity within the LatAm region, with the role presented for candidates based in Brazil.
      • Opportunity to shape backend architecture across multiple products and influence major platform evolution.
      • Hands-on work with modern cloud, event-driven architecture, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
      • Technical leadership and mentorship opportunities within a collaborative engineering environment.
      • Exposure to large-scale architectural modernization, data platforms, APIs, and distributed systems.

description:

You’ll join a growing QA team and play a key role in ensuring the quality, stability, and search performance of web products.
The role combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on frontend and technical SEO-related functionality.
You’ll work across the full software testing lifecycle, from analyzing requirements and preparing test documentation to validating releases and supporting features in production.
Your work will directly contribute to reliable, high-quality digital experiences and help teams identify and resolve issues efficiently.
You’ll collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and other departments in a fast-moving, technology-focused environment.

  • Create and maintain test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and functional descriptions.
  • Support the delivery of code to test environments and production by validating releases and identifying potential issues.
  • Perform functional, regression, and acceptance testing of web products.
  • Analyze test execution results and maintain existing test suites to ensure they remain relevant and effective.
  • Test frontend functionality with particular attention to technical SEO factors and search-engine accessibility.
  • Conduct product and feature demos when required.
  • Collaborate with other departments by providing testing insights and helping investigate problematic situations.
  • Track and support features and defects throughout the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, testing approaches, and overall product quality.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in a Manual QA or Software Testing role.
    • Strong understanding of client-server architecture for web applications.
    • Good knowledge of HTML and CSS and practical experience testing websites.
    • Experience applying test design techniques to create effective and comprehensive test coverage.
    • Strong ability to create and maintain test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and functional specifications.
    • Hands-on experience with Git, Jenkins, and GitLab.
    • Experience using browser Developer Tools for debugging, inspection, and testing.

    • Experience with monitoring and error-tracking tools such as Grafana and Sentry is desirable.
    • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Proactive mindset, ownership of tasks, and a strong focus on delivering measurable results.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work with the flexibility to work from a location that suits you.

      • Medical insurance with access to leading healthcare providers.
      • Coverage for psychological support through the Pleso platform.

      • Team-building activities, workshops, corporate events, and other company-wide initiatives.

      • Performance reviews, career development planning, mentoring programs, and other opportunities for professional growth.
      • A collaborative environment focused on knowledge sharing, open communication, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work on technology products and contribute to modern QA and testing practices.

This role owns the ERP platform and the ecosystem of systems and tools connected to it, with a strong focus on operational reliability and scalability. You will take ownership of Odoo, its modules, integrations, data model, permissions, versions, upgrades, and functional debt. Working alongside another Product Manager focused on strategic ERP initiatives, you will lead the platform and day-to-day operational demand. A key part of the role is designing the integration layer between core financial systems and the ERP. You will also improve how events, reconciliations, reporting, and operational workflows are handled across connected systems. The role offers significant ownership and influence over the evolution of a critical financial technology platform.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the ERP platform and its broader ecosystem, including the data model, modules, versions, permissions, upgrades, and functional debt.
  • Evaluate incoming business and operational requests and determine whether they should be addressed through native ERP capabilities or custom modules, maintaining clear rationale for those decisions.
  • Design and maintain the integration layer between core systems such as the ledger, payments, and collections platforms and the ERP.
  • Define reliable processes for mapping system events to accounting entries, including idempotency, event reprocessing, and reconciliation when events are duplicated or received incorrectly.
  • Take ownership of connected satellite systems and tools, including integrations, operational reporting, manual data loads, and reconciliation workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to replace spreadsheet-based or manual operational processes with more reliable, scalable platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Manager responsible for strategic ERP initiatives, ensuring the platform can support new products, business expansion, and evolving accounting requirements.
  • Balance operational needs, technical constraints, platform stability, and long-term maintainability when prioritizing and delivering improvements.

    • Requirements:

    • Experience working with Odoo or comparable ERP platforms is highly relevant.
    • Understanding of financial and accounting system integrations, including ledgers, payments, accounts receivable/payable, collections, reconciliations, and operational reporting.
    • Ability to work with technical teams on event-driven integrations, data mapping, idempotency, reprocessing, and reconciliation workflows.
    • Strong product judgment and ability to distinguish when native platform capabilities are preferable to custom development.
    • Experience managing operational product demand while balancing short-term business needs with long-term platform scalability and maintainability.
    • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex systems and dependencies.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across Product, Engineering, Finance, and operational stakeholders.
    • Comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of a critical platform and making decisions that have long-term technical and operational implications.

      • Benefits:

      • Significant ownership over platform strategy, integrations, operational workflows, and continuous improvement.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Als Data Engineer bij Cegeka Consulting help je organisaties om data beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar te maken. Je bouwt dataplatformen en datapipelines op Azure, Databricks en Microsoft Fabric. Daarmee leg je de basis voor betrouwbare rapportages, slimmere processen en AI-toepassingen. Je focus ligt op techniek, met oog voor wat de klant ermee wil bereiken. Je vertaalt klantvragen naar passende oplossingen en zorgt dat deze ook in productie veilig, schaalbaar en beheersbaar blijven. Als Data Engineer werk je aan uiteenlopende opdrachten bij klanten in verschillende sectoren. Binnen ons Data & AI Competence Center leer je van vakgenoten en bouw je mee aan onze gezamenlijke expertise. Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van moderne dataplatformen en datamodellen.
  • Ontwikkelen van ETL- en ELT-processen voor het ontsluiten en verwerken van data.
  • Realiseren van schaalbare datapipelines, met aandacht voor testen, monitoring en onderhoudbaarheid.
  • Integreren van databronnen uit complexe IT-landschappen.
  • Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en meenemen van data lineage, toegangsbeheer en governance in de technische inrichting.
  • Samenwerken met architecten, data engineers, AI- en MLOps-specialisten en business stakeholders.
  • Adviseren van klanten over dataoplossingen en technische keuzes, met oog voor prestaties, kosten en beheer.
  • Bijdragen aan het Data & AI Competence Center door praktijkervaring te delen en herbruikbare code, notebooks en technische oplossingen te ontwikkelen.
  • Locatie: Groningen, Veenendaal en Zoetermeer.
  • Vakgebied: Consultancy, Data.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol.
  • Praktische ervaring met SQL en Python.
  • Kennis van datamodellering en ETL- en ELT-processen.
  • Ervaring met dataoplossingen op Azure.
  • Ervaring met Databricks en/of Microsoft Fabric.
  • Oog voor kwaliteit en onderhoudbaarheid, interesse in automatisering en het vermogen om technische keuzes begrijpelijk toe te lichten.
  • Mooi meegenomen: Azure Data Factory, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Git, CI/CD, data governance, datakwaliteit en data lineage.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

  • Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en technische kennis bieden we een bruto salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 6.500, vakantiegeld en een mobiliteits- of leasebudget van € 830 bruto per maand.
  • 26 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen.
  • Je krijgt een laptop en telefoon en kunt deelnemen aan uitjes die onze personeelsvereniging organiseert.
  • Je wordt onderdeel van ons nieuwe Data & AI Competence Center, met een focus op Microsoft-technologie en Databricks.
