title: State and Local Affairs Lead, West
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a State and Local Affairs Lead to engage with state and local governments in the Western United States, advancing AI policy, legislation, and regulation that supports Anthropic's mission of ensuring that the world safely makes the transition through transformative AI.

In this role, you will report to Anthropic's Head of Western State and Local Affairs and coordinate with our Policy leadership, Communications, and Legal teams. You will own Anthropic's relationships and legislative and regulatory work across many Western states, including a support role in California —engagement with state legislatures, governors' offices, attorneys general, state agencies, and local governments. You will travel regularly across the region.

Successful candidates will demonstrate a track record of political strategy and execution—with specific examples of how you have contributed to complex policy campaigns, built durable relationships with elected officials and community leaders, supported legislative and regulatory outcomes, and executed with accountability and focus in fast-moving environments.

Anthropic is equal parts research lab, policy think-tank, and technology startup. We care deeply about safe development of AI systems, and build partnership with governments through proactive, opinionated, substantive policy conversations. We recognize that our approach to AI policy is distinctive—grounded in honest assessment of technological trajectories and authentic concern for safe scaling—and we need a regional lead who can bring that positioning to life at the state and local level.

This role offers an opportunity to be part of building a high-impact state affairs operation at a critical moment for AI policy. You will be responsible for executing on strategic priorities across your region, building relationships with government stakeholders, and contributing to the broader state affairs function.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as Anthropic's lead for state and local government affairs across many Western states, working in close coordination with the Head of Western States and other Regional State and Local Affairs Leads

  • Build and maintain relationships with state legislators, legislative staff, governors' offices, attorneys general, and state agency leaders across your region

  • Engage directly with local officials whose decisions affect Anthropic's work—mayors, city councils, county commissions, and economic development boards

  • Track state and local legislation and regulatory proceedings affecting AI and the technology sector, provide analysis and intelligence to inform company strategy, and represent Anthropic's positions

  • Build durable partnerships with local and regional organizations, including chambers of commerce, economic development groups, labor organizations, universities, and school districts

  • Represent Anthropic at legislative hearings, regional events, and public forums, including with audiences who are skeptical of AI

  • Work with the Communications team to develop clear, accurate messaging for regional policy campaigns

  • Translate Anthropic's technical research and policy positions into engagement strategies tailored to Western state political environments

  • Manage the outside advisors and registered lobbyists who support Anthropic's work in your region

  • Coordinate with Anthropic's policy, communications, legal, and executive teams to ensure that regional activity aligns with company-wide positioning

Minimum qualifications

  • Align with our mission and embrace the imperative of policy impact and change

  • Have experience in state and local government affairs, political strategy, or legislative roles, with demonstrated success contributing to legislative and regulatory outcomes

  • Have existing relationships with state and local leaders in the West, including legislators, governors' offices, attorneys general, or county and municipal officials

  • Understand how state legislatures and executive branches work—committee processes, legislative and regulatory procedures, and how to move policy forward—and understand where local authority begins and ends

  • Have a track record of executing on strategic objectives and delivering measurable outcomes in government affairs roles

  • Are prepared to travel regularly across the region

Preferred qualifications

  • Have 8+ years of experience in state and local government affairs, political strategy, or legislative roles

  • Have experience building partnerships with external organizations including chambers of commerce, economic development groups, labor organizations, and universities

  • Have exposure to technology policy or emerging technology regulation; you understand the unique challenges of navigating policy for rapidly evolving technologies

  • Demonstrate understanding of how to build coalitions and identify aligned constituencies to advance shared objectives

  • Can manage multiple priorities and stakeholder relationships across different states and adapt to different political environments

  • Can work well under time pressure and manage competing demands

  • Can translate complex technical topics into clear, accessible language for policymakers and residents alike

  • Have experience working with communications teams to develop effective messaging for policy campaigns

  • Are comfortable being honest about tradeoffs, including in rooms where people disagree with us

  • Are drawn to working with an organization that approaches AI policy with intensity and intellectual honesty

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$230,000—$265,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Software Developer (Pre-ID Relo)
description:
Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. Within Workforce Solutions, our Human Capital Management charter builds the products that help small and mid-market businesses hire, pay, and support their people. These are the systems customers depend on to run payroll correctly, keep their teams compliant, and handle the everyday work of managing a workforce without friction.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our HCM engineering team in Toronto. You will own the design and delivery of full stack features across our HCM surfaces, working from customer problem through architecture, implementation, launch, and long-term operation. The work spans a modern React front end and cloud-native backend services, and it sits on top of business logic that has to be exactly right: calculation and eligibility rules, multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements, and integrations across the workforce stack.

This role is explicitly AI-first, in two directions. You will build AI-powered and agentic capabilities into the product, applying LLMs, retrieval, and automation to remove manual work from experiences that are still slow and form-heavy today. You will also work AI-first in how you build: using AI tooling throughout your own development loop for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, code review, debugging, and documentation, and helping the team raise its collective bar on what good AI-assisted engineering looks like. We are not looking for someone who has read about this. We are looking for someone who already works this way and can pull others along.

As a senior engineer you are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will take ambiguous problems, decompose them, drive alignment on an approach, and deliver without needing the plan handed to you. You will also be a force multiplier: mentoring engineers, setting standards through your own code and reviews, and improving how the team works.


Responsibilities

Build and deliver

  • Design, build, test, and operate full stack features end to end, spanning React front end and cloud-native backend services
  • Own delivery of significant pieces of the roadmap with limited direction, from technical design through production launch and iteration
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and hold that standard in the code you review
  • Break large, ambiguous problems into sequenced, shippable increments and communicate progress and risk clearly
  • Take features all the way through: instrumentation, monitoring, rollout, experimentation, and follow-through on what the data shows

AI-first engineering

  • Build AI-powered and agentic product capabilities, including LLM-backed workflows, retrieval, structured extraction, and automation of tasks that are manual today
  • Establish sound patterns for working with non-deterministic systems: prompt and context design, evaluation and regression testing, guardrails, fallback behavior, cost and latency management, and observability
  • Use AI tooling fluently across your own development workflow and raise the team's practice through concrete examples, shared patterns, and internal tooling
  • Apply sound judgment about where AI genuinely improves an experience versus where deterministic logic is the right answer, particularly in compliance-sensitive paths
  • Uphold Intuit standards for responsible AI, data privacy, and appropriate handling of sensitive employee and business data

Technical leadership and influence

  • Contribute to architectural direction for your area and drive technical decisions to closure with clear reasoning and documented tradeoffs
  • Raise engineering quality across the team through design review, code review, test automation, and CI/CD improvements
  • Mentor engineers on the team, including onboarding, pairing, and growing their technical judgment
  • Identify and drive down technical debt, reliability risk, and operational toil rather than routing them elsewhere
  • Participate in on-call for services you own and improve system health based on what you learn there

Partnership

  • Partner directly with Product Management, Design, Data, and QA to shape scope and turn customer problems into technical plans
  • Work with adjacent HCM and platform teams on clean integration contracts and shared services
  • Collaborate effectively across time zones with engineers and partners in other Intuit sites
  • Stay connected to real customer usage and real customer pain, and let it inform what you build and what you push back on

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production software
  • Strong full stack capability: production experience with a modern JavaScript or TypeScript front end framework, ideally React, plus a modern backend language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, or Node.js
  • Solid grounding in distributed systems, API design, relational and non-relational data modeling, and service-oriented architecture
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Demonstrated practical experience building with AI, such as LLM-backed features, retrieval-augmented systems, agentic workflows, or ML-driven product capabilities, with real production or near-production results
  • Fluent use of AI development tooling in your daily engineering workflow, with specific examples of how it changed your output
  • Track record of owning features end to end with minimal direction and shipping them to real customers
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a clear technical design and explain tradeoffs to non-engineers
  • Experience working in an Agile environment with a bias toward iterative delivery

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in HR technology, payroll, workforce management, fintech, or another domain where correctness is auditable and financially material
  • Experience designing evaluation harnesses, regression suites, or offline and online quality measurement for AI features
  • Experience building rules engines, calculation or ledger-style systems, or complex configurable workflow engines
  • Experience integrating third-party partner APIs or building extensible integration platforms
  • Experience with front end performance, accessibility, and design system contribution at scale
  • Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a technical lead on a project team
  • Familiarity with data privacy and security frameworks relevant to employee data, such as SOC 2, GDPR, PIPEDA, and CCPA
  • Experience modernizing or re-platforming a legacy system while keeping it running

What we look for

  • Ownership. You treat the problem as yours through to the outcome, not just to the merge
  • Judgment. You choose the simplest approach that actually solves the problem, and you can say why
  • Curiosity with rigor. You move fast on new tooling and new AI capability, and you still verify before you trust it
  • Craft. You care about the quality of what you leave behind for the next engineer
  • Clarity. You write and speak precisely, and you make complexity easier for the people around you

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Toronto $132,000 - $178,500

title: Planning Specialist
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Join our team at Scientific Protein Laboratories (SPL), a world leader in biosourced pharmaceuticals, located just outside of Madison, Wisconsin in Waunakee! SPL is an innovative biopharmaceutical leader with unique products and services supporting the pharmaceutical industry globally. For over 40 years, SPL specializes in the development and cGMP compliant manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). SPL has an exciting opportunity to join the team as a Planning Specialist.

Under the guidance of the Head of Planning & S&OP, the Planning Specialist is responsible for Production Planning and Material Control (PMC) activities across the SPL site, ensuring effective execution of production plans, adequate material supply to meet manufacturing demand, and timely identification and escalation of risks.

Responsibilities include:

S&OP Planning & Order Control (S&OP):

  • Coordinate delivery planning for customer sales orders and demand orders, monitor execution throughout
  • the order lifecycle, and collaborate with different departments to ensure successful delivery.
  • Support the development and coordination of the site’s annual and rolling sales, production, and supply forecast plans.
  • Lead coordination of regulatory, quality, and manufacturing activities affecting order fulfillment to ensure delivery and production plan achievement.
  • Support the supervisor in organizing both site-level S&OP meetings and S&OP reviews with Headquarters, preparing meeting materials, and following up on post-meeting action items.
  • Support key customer meetings and ensure timely follow-up of agreed actions.

Production Planning & Process Control (PC):

Based on product routings and order requirements, develop, track, and dynamically adjust production, testing, and release schedules to ensure on-time delivery of each order, and coordinate the resolution of issues throughout the end-to-end delivery process.

  • Develop monthly production plans based on demand orders, inventory status, material availability, maintenance schedules, holidays, and other relevant inputs; provide the corresponding delivery schedule; and promptly address rush orders, order changes, and resource constraints to ensure on-time delivery.
  • Break down monthly plans into weekly production plans and release them to relevant departments for execution; monitor production status and coordinate cross-functional actions promptly when exceptions occur.
  • Develop finished product testing and release plans, monitor execution progress, identify exceptions such as capacity conflicts, material shortages and quality-related activities, analyze root causes, provide risk alerts and coordinate corrective actions.

BOM-based Material Planning & Control (MC):

Based on production plans, ensure material availability to support continuous manufacturing operations. Responsible for accuracy of BOM master data, material requirement planning, purchase requisition generation, and end-to-end tracking through material release.

  • Maintain BOM lists and track actual consumption variances to ensure accurate and controlled data.
  • Calculate annual and monthly BOM-based material requirements and prepare purchase requisition plans with consideration of production plans, inventory, in-transit stock, lead time and safety stock, and perform dynamic updates.
  • Formulate and track the arrival, testing, release progress and availability status of BOM-based materials; identify risks of material shortage, delay or supply disruption, and coordinate with departments to drive resolution.

System Establishment & Process Digitalization:

Under the guidance of supervisor, be responsible for building and improving the S&OP and PMC management system, process optimization and digital transformation, as well as data output for the S&OP module.

  • Assist in sorting out PMC responsibilities and workflows, and draft process documents and operating instructions.
  • Collect workflow and system issues, propose optimization suggestions and track implementation; support digital projects by participating in system testing, training, go-live tracking and data quality improvement.
  • Assist supervisor in driving the implementation of corporate digital system projects including user requirement gathering, solution design, testing and go-live.

Job Requirements and Qualifications:

Required:

  • A High School diploma/GED.
  • 1+ year of experience in production planning, material control, inventory management, BOM maintenance, purchase follow-up, warehouse coordination or manufacturing operation data maintenance.
  • Capable of accurately maintaining planning data and tracking execution variances.

Preferred:

  • Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems, BOM management, inventory analysis, production planning or material control processes.
  • ASCM/APICS, CPIM, CSCP or equivalent supply chain professional certifications.
  • 3+ years of experience in PMC, production scheduling, material requirement planning, testing & release progress tracking, inventory turnover analysis or ERP/MRP system usage within a GMP (pharmaceutical, biomanufacturing, medical device), food or similarly regulated environment.
  • Familiar with GMP requirements related to materials, batch management, product release, change control and data integrity.

WHY JOIN SPL?

Our employees are our success! We recruit motivated people, recognize their contributions, and support their development to reach their full potential.

Perks include: competitive compensation; excellent benefits package - including Medical, Dental and Vision on Day 1; Life and AD&D Insurance, and Short and Long-term Disability; Health and Flexible Saving Account options; Employee Assistance Program, generous vacation; paid Holidays; 401k; advancement opportunities; team-oriented environment; community involvement; company events and more!

SPL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, creed, disability, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and any other status protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

title: Rare Reimbursement Executive, Texas Region (Dallas)
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Rare Reimbursement Executive, Texas Region (Dallas) who is self-aware, patient centric and collaborative to join us in our Market Access and Affordability Team. This is a field-based position that requires up to 50% daily and overnight travel will cover Arkansas, Oklahoma, & the Greater Dallas/Fort Worth area and is designed to support Central Time Zones. TCandidates must reside in the greater Dallas Fort Worth Metroplex.

About the Role
You will ensure that appropriate patients have access to UCB rare disease products and Patient Services. You will also provide ethical commentary on local, regional, and national payer coverage and their pharmacy and medical policies to all engaged sites of care. You will leverage your knowledge in the market access and reimbursement journey encompassing procurement, payer policies and coverage, benefit design, prior authorizations, appeals, exceptions, denials, coding and payer payment guidelines, site of care regulation/requirements, understanding of coding guidelines with demonstrated knowledge of the complex payer environment. You will relay detailed benefit information in order to maximize the Provider and Staff experience including market dynamics, coverage, billing, coding and reimbursement policies for all sites of care involved.

Who you’ll work with
Internally, you will work with stakeholders across Market Access, Sales, the Patient Assistance Program, Marketing and Compliance. Externally, you will work with sites of care, patients and their respective payer, specialty pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a liaison to all engaged sites of care administering UCB rare disease product(s) through a patient’s medical benefit and pharmacy benefit.
  • Provide support to patients and accounts specific to benefit verifications, product procurement processes, reimbursement information, billing, coding, and coverage details.
  • Provide on-demand education, including Lunch and Learns or Dinner presentations, for office staff regarding Reimbursement and support services.
  • Advises all sites of care on payer specific nuances related to utilization management protocols, appeals processes and the year -end re-authorization verification process.
  • Work with all engaged sites of care to inform them on matters related to access and reimbursement of UCB rare disease products.
  • Sole point of contact for all stakeholders should a Medical Claim denial be presented by a provider.
  • Develop strategic coverage, access and reimbursement relationships with their local Medicare Part A/B Contractors and attends Medicare Part A/B Contractor open meetings.
  • Provide coverage updates, policy changes and communications to internal UCB colleagues.
  • Provide strategic coverage and reimbursement, benefit recertification support and marketplace feedback to internal colleagues aligned to their geographies.
  • Monitor, interpret, and communicate local, regional, and national payer policy updates impacting UCB Rare Disease therapies.
  • Provide reimbursement education and ethical commentary regarding medical and pharmacy benefit coverage, benefit design, utilization management requirements, coding practices, reimbursement methodologies, and payer policy changes.
  • Disseminate relevant coverage and policy updates to internal stakeholders and aligned cross-functional teams.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s preferred)
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical or biotech experience required
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of medical and pharmacy benefit reimbursement including benefit investigation required
  • 4+ years Reimbursement/Account Management experience preferred
  • Excellent working knowledge of evolving reimbursement landscape and the practice management environment
  • Neurology or Rare Disease experience preferred

The reasonably anticipated salary range for this position is $ 155,000-203,000 per year. The actual salary offered will take into account related knowledge, skills, experience and location among other factors and may fall outside the expected range.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless explicitly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Provision of self-identification information is entirely voluntary and a decision to provide or not provide such information will not have any effect on your application for employment, your employment with UCB, or otherwise subject you to any adverse treatment.   • Meets all submission timelines of reports/records/documentation as required by state and federal rules, regulations, and laws for healthcare facilities.

  • Assists with the development, implementation and evaluation of the care plans for each resident in accordance with other health care providers and physicians.

  • Empowers and encourage residents to be proactive in their care plans and decisions effecting them and being receptive and sensitive to patient requests.

  • Provides support for residents and family members exhibiting emotional distress.

  • Participates in quarterly care plan conferences for each resident, including family, physician, and care plan team.

  • Actively participates in QAPI (Quality Assurance Process Improvement) program, taking a proactive approach to quality care and services on a continuous basis with engagement of residents, family members and staff.

  • Demonstrates high standards of excellence for meeting resident needs. Communicates effectively, establishes rapport and maintains relationships with residents.

  • Meets requirement of regular attendance to perform job duties.

  • Has fun in creating a positive atmosphere for resident.

  • Follows instructions and completes daily assignments as assigned and is proactive to change.

  • Possesses understanding and compassion for the elderly population.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Operations Planner Wanted for Staffing Agency
description:

We are looking for an engaged and structured Operations Planner to play a central role in the day-to-day operations of our staffing agency.

Your main responsibility will be to ensure that our clients get the right temporary employees, in the right place, at the right time. You will therefore have close contact with both clients and temporary employees and play an important role in ensuring that daily staffing requirements are met.

title: Senior Software Engineer, iCasino
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, iCasino based in Canada.

This is a senior engineering role focused on building and scaling highly reliable online casino technology. You will work on the systems behind casino lobbies, game launches, third-party provider integrations, and real-money wagering flows. The role combines hands-on development, technical architecture, production performance, and end-to-end feature ownership. You will solve complex engineering challenges while ensuring scalability, resilience, and reliability across critical services. Collaboration with engineering teams, leadership, and technology partners is central to the role. You will also mentor other engineers and help shape the technical direction of a sophisticated digital gaming platform.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, scale, and performance-tune GraphQL APIs, low-latency gRPC services, and SQL queries supporting casino lobbies, game launches, and real-money wagering.
  • Design, architect, and deliver new features and third-party game provider integrations from conception through production.
  • Own highly complex technical challenges, develop solution proposals, and present them to leadership and partner teams for review and alignment.
  • Identify production bottlenecks, scalability constraints, and technical risks, then drive improvements that strengthen platform performance and reliability.
  • Establish and refine monitoring and alerting through Datadog for the systems and services under your ownership.
  • Investigate production performance issues, including CPU hotspots and latency regressions in high-throughput services.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and take end-to-end ownership of production release cycles.
  • Mentor engineers across teams through technical specifications, pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate within an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver reliable, scalable products and continuously improve engineering practices.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
    • 2+ years of hands-on experience building applications with Elixir is required.
    • 2+ years of experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas is required.
    • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design.
    • Proven experience working with production systems at scale, including load testing, tracing, performance analysis, and optimization.
    • Experience diagnosing and resolving production performance regressions, particularly CPU and latency issues in high-throughput services.
    • Strong understanding of clean code architecture and software craftsmanship.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing technical specifications, runbooks, and cross-team design documentation.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and MySQL.
    • Experience with Kubernetes and containerized service environments.
    • Comfortable working with terminal-based development tools, Git, GitHub or similar platforms, and modern code editors.
    • Experience with testing frameworks such as ExUnit, RSpec, Jest, pytest, or equivalent.
    • Experience with background job processing technologies such as Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery, or Beanstalk.

title: Food Bev Supervisor ("Supervisor de Alimentos & Bebidas")
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

Supervise and organize the Food & Beverage functions within the outlets of the hotel in order to maintain high standards of food & beverage quality, service, and merchandising to maximize profits. Ensure a positive guest experience, taking ownership of situations and following up on every request.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support and supervise the hotel F&B Outlets while working closely with rest of the F&B leadership team.
  • Maintain consistent communication with vendors and suppliers for timely rollout of seasonal food options.
  • Participate in department monthly/quarterly/annual inventories; prepare and submit inventory reports to accounting in a timely manner.
  • Monitor quality of service and product.
  • Cooperate in menu planning and preparation.
  • Conduct orders of food and beverage supplies.
  • Stay up to date on brand requirements and changes to the restaurant.
  • Ensure attendance at all mandatory meetings.
  • Lead and coach the team towards achieving exceptional guest service and staff satisfaction results.
  • Responsible for maintaining high energy, positive attitude, and professional appearance.
  • Perform any general cleaning tasks using the hotels standard procedures and adhering to safety and health standards.
  • Regularly review and evaluate the degree of customer acceptance of the restaurant and bar. Recommend to management new operating and marketing policies whenever declining or constant sales imply dissatisfaction by the customers, a material change in the make-up of the customer market, or a change in the competitive environment.
  • Continuously evaluate the performance and encourage improvement of the staff members in the food and beverage department.
  • Responsible for maintaining quality of food product and ensuring consistency in food delivery and standards.
  • Arrange, provide, and supervise training of new staff members to include familiarization of property, standard operating procedures, and policies. Cross-train staff members in all positions within their area of responsibility and all types of equipment to perform their duties, in addition to successful implementation and follow-up checklists. Ensure that all staff members are retrained as needed.
  • Serve as a role model to all staff members, adhering closely to policies and procedures, practicing the highest standards of performance. Set the highest possible example in conduct, temperament, punctuality, and standards of work.

SUPPORTIVE FUNCTIONS

In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the manager based upon the particular requirements of the hotel:

  • Assist with any guest inquiry.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries.
  • Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by direct and indirect supervisors.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Environmental conditions are inside, a job is considered inside if staff spends approximately 75 percent or more of the time inside. Temperature is moderate and controlled by hotel environmental systems.
  • Must be able to work in extreme temperatures like freezers (-10°F) and kitchens (+110°F), possible for one (1) hour or more.
  • Must be able to stand and exert well-paced mobility for up to four (4) hours in length.
  • Must be able to exert well-paced ability to maneuver between functions occurring simultaneously.
  • Must be able to exert well-paced ability in limited space and to reach other departments of the hotel on a timely basis.
  • Must be able to lift up to 45 lbs. as needed.
  • Must be able to push and pull carts and equipment weighing up to 250 lbs.
  • Requires grasping, writing, standing, sitting, walking, repetitive motions, bending, climbing, listening, and hearing ability and visual acuity.
  • Hearing, smelling, tasting, and visual ability to observe and distinguish product quality and detect signs of emergency situations.
  • Talking and hearing occur continuously in the process of communicating with other staff, guests, and supervisors.
  • Vision occurs continuously with the most common visual functions being those of near and color vision and depth perception.
  • Must be able to bend, stoop, squat and stretch to fulfill cleaning tasks occasionally.
  • Must have finger dexterity to be able to operate office equipment such as computers, printers, 10-key adding machine, multi-line touch tone phone, filing cabinets, FAX machines, photocopiers, dolly, and other office equipment as needed.
  • Ability to work primarily with fingers to pick, pinch, type and carry out substantial movements (motions) of the wrists and hands as well.

SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language used in the workplace.
  • Requires good communication skills, verbal, written and electronic.
  • Considerable knowledge of complex mathematical calculations and computer programs.
  • Must have excellent leadership capability and customer relations skills.
  • Must be detail oriented with outstanding organizational and communication skills.
  • Must possess intermediate computer skills.
  • Must Possess basic computational skills.
  • Knowledge of computer programs, math skills as well as budgetary analysis capabilities required.
  • Ability to analyze, foresee user needs, and makes judgments to ensure proper tools are provided at property level.
  • Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy and collect accurate information to resolve conflicts.
  • Knowledgeable about basic function of Windows OS, MS Office, PMS, PBX, Key system, and POS.
  • Self-driven and able to work independently; willingness to be hand-on and dig into the details
  • Exceptionally strong in issue resolution and proven analytical skills with a strong attention to detail
  • Thorough knowledge of food products, standard recipes, and proper preparation.
  • Ability to distinguish product quality, taste, texture, and presentation and observe preparation.
  • Ability to conduct meetings, menu briefings and maintain communication lines between line staff and departmental managers.

EDUCATION

  • High school or equivalent education required. Bachelors Degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years experience in Food & Beverage operation required.

LICENSES OR CERTIFICATIONS

  • Must be at least 21 years of age to serve alcohol.
  • Safe Server Alcohol & Food Handlers certification required.

GROOMING

All Staff Members must maintain a neat, clean and well-groomed appearance per Azul Hospitality standards. Refer to the property specific required grooming and uniform standards policy.

ATTENDANCE

Regular attendance in conformance with the standards, which may be established by Azul Hospitality, from time to time, is essential to the successful performance of this position. Staff with irregular attendance / tardiness will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. Upon employment, all staff is required to fully comply with Azul Hospitality rules and regulations for the safe and effective operation of the hotels facilities. Staff members who violate hotel rules and regulations will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, staff members may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. In addition, attendance at all scheduled training sessions and meetings is required. This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that a staff member in this position may be asked to perform from time to time.

title: Electronic Hardware Engineer
description:
Embark on a journey with QDSS at the forefront of technological innovation as we seek talented Engineers to shape the future of cutting-edge projects and contribute to a culture of excellence and creativity. What we do matters.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking an Electronic Hardware Engineer to support development of a next-generation control system for small modular nuclear reactors. This role focuses on PCB design and hardware development, contributing across the full lifecycle from schematic capture and layout through validation and production support.

You’ll work alongside other senior engineers on highly reliable, safety-critical systems, gaining exposure to real-world challenges including signal integrity, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability.

Location: Remote, though onsite/hybrid is preferred in Wilmington, NC.
Clearance: All applicants must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own full lifecycle PCB design and development from concept through production and sustaining support
  • Define design approach, including requirements interpretation, architecture, and component selection
  • Develop schematic capture, PCB layout, routing, and placement using tools such as Altium
  • Establish board-level design considerations including signal integrity, power distribution, EMI, and thermal performance
  • Perform and support board bring-up, debugging, and hardware validation activities
  • Develop and execute integration and system-level testing, documenting results and resolving issues
  • Create manufacturing test procedures and support production readiness, including DFM/DFA considerations
  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware issues across development and production environments
  • Support mechanical integration, including enclosure, packaging, and thermal constraints
  • Provide production and sustaining engineering support, including issue resolution and design updates
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with systems, software, and manufacturing teams to ensure successful delivery
  • Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to define scope, review designs, and assess technical risks

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in electronic hardware / PCB design
  • Proven experience owning full lifecycle PCB development (architecture, schematic capture, layout, validation, and production)
  • Strong experience with component selection and BOM development, including lifecycle and availability considerations
  • Proficiency with PCB design tools (Altium preferred or equivalent ECAD tools)
  • Hands-on experience with board bring-up, debugging, and hardware validation
  • Experience using AutoCAD for drawing wiring diagrams
  • Solid understanding of: Signal integrity, Power integrity, EMI/EMC considerations, Thermal design considerations
  • Experience designing for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA) and working with fabrication/assembly vendors
  • Experience supporting production and sustaining engineering efforts
  • Ability to work across electrical and mechanical interfaces (enclosures, packaging, thermal constraints)
  • Experience in nuclear, aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical/regulated environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in instrumentation & controls (I&C) or control systems hardware
  • Exposure to DFM/DFA or working with manufacturing teams
  • Experience supporting integration or system-level testing
  • Familiarity with design documentation and engineering processes
  • Experience working on complex or multi-board systems

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

  • Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.
  • Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement.
  • A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued.

Benefits Include

  • Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

Pay Ranges
$140,000—$165,000 USD

At Quest Defense Systems and Solutions, we don’t just build technology — we engineer the future. From next-generation aerospace solutions to cutting-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the boundaries of innovation. This is where problem-solvers, innovators, and visionary thinkers come together to shape the future. With over 25 years of aerospace and defense engineering expertise, our commitment to delivering high-quality, transformative solutions sets us apart — not just as an industry leader, but as a driving force for impactful change. Together, we’re not just leading the industry — we’re revolutionizing it.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure based in Canada.

This is a Staff-level infrastructure engineering role focused on building the platform foundations that enable engineering teams to move faster and operate more reliably.
You’ll combine hands-on software engineering with technical leadership, shaping self-service infrastructure, cloud platforms, deployment systems, and operational tooling.
A major focus will be replacing expert-driven provisioning and operational workflows with paved roads that provide clear ownership, safe defaults, strong guardrails, and measurable adoption.

The role also includes developing AI-assisted operational workflows that reduce toil while keeping production changes safe, auditable, and human-reviewed.
You’ll influence architecture across teams through RFCs, design reviews, technical standards, and pragmatic engineering decisions.
Working in a small, growing team, you’ll have substantial ownership and the opportunity to drive infrastructure investments through real production adoption.

  • Design and build self-service platform capabilities and APIs, primarily in Go, covering onboarding, provisioning, deployment, observability defaults, and day-2 operations.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in remote environments and through RFCs, design documents, and incident writeups.
    • Experience with EKS, ingress, CNI, or service-mesh technologies is valuable.
    • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, CI/CD, progressive delivery, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, and canary deployments is a plus.
    • Experience leading large-scale migrations, platform adoption programs, or cross-team infrastructure initiatives is beneficial.

      • Remote-first work arrangement.
      • Flexible scheduling and autonomy in managing your working hours.

description:
• Location: Buffalo, New York

  • Pay: $28.00 per hour

  • Program start: Tuesday, May 25, 2027, with limited flexibility for academic calendars

  • Duration: 10 weeks, with the possibility of extending up to two additional weeks based on business needs and intern availability

  • Schedule: Full time, 40 hours per week, on site

Help Build Quality into Every Part

As a Quality Intern at MacLean-Fogg, you will connect what you are learning in the classroom with the products and processes behind a manufacturing business. You will work with quality professionals, engineers, and production teams to understand requirements, investigate problems, and help make products and processes more consistent.

You will take ownership of a meaningful project with guidance from an experienced team. Depending on your assignment, you might analyze defect trends, investigate a recurring issue, improve an inspection method, or make quality information easier to use. At the end of the program, you will present your work, findings, and recommendations to facility leadership.

One application connects you with the Quality internship assignments available at this manufacturing facility. Tell us which areas interest you. We will consider your interests, coursework, and experience alongside available projects and business needs.

Quality Areas You Could Explore

Assignments vary by manufacturing facility and may include:

  • Quality Engineering and Problem-Solving: Investigate defects, help identify causes, and support actions that prevent problems from recurring.

  • Measurement, Inspection, and Testing: Learn how teams check product requirements, use measurement tools, and document reliable results.

  • Quality Data and Process Improvement: Analyze trends in defects, scrap, or rework and help teams evaluate opportunities for improvement.

  • Quality Systems and Documentation: Help improve inspection instructions, records, and processes that support consistent work and traceability.

  • Supplier and Customer Quality: Support the review of quality concerns, organize evidence, and help teams track follow-up actions.

You do not need prior experience in these areas. Not every assignment is available at every location.

What You Will Do

  • Learn the products, processes, and quality requirements relevant to your assignment.

  • Gather and organize measurements, observations, and other evidence to understand a problem.

  • Use spreadsheets or other tools to identify patterns and communicate findings.

  • Work with team members to investigate causes and evaluate potential improvements.

  • Support testing or verification of changes under the guidance of qualified team members.

  • Document your work accurately, ask questions when results are unclear, and raise concerns promptly.

  • Follow safety procedures, required training, and instructions for working in manufacturing and laboratory areas.

  • Share project progress, seek feedback, and present your results and recommendations.

What You Bring

  • Enrollment in a bachelor's or master's degree program in engineering, engineering technology, quality technology, materials science, statistics, or a closely related technical field.

  • Interest in manufacturing, product quality, measurement, or process improvement.

  • A thoughtful approach to solving problems and checking your work.

  • Willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and work with people in different roles.

  • Ability to organize information and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • Availability for a full-time, on-site summer internship. Limited start-date flexibility may be available for academic calendars.

All college class levels are welcome. Previous internship experience is not required. Coursework, labs, projects, volunteering, student activities, and other jobs can demonstrate your potential.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • A cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

  • Coursework or projects involving statistics, measurement, manufacturing, materials, or process improvement.

  • Experience using Excel or another tool to organize and analyze data.

  • Exposure to drawings, measurement tools, inspection methods, or structured problem-solving.

What You Will Gain

  • Ownership of a project with a clear business purpose and defined deliverable.

  • Coaching and feedback from experienced team members.

  • Practical experience working with manufacturing data, products, and processes.

  • Opportunities to collaborate across functions and present your work to leadership.

  • A closer look at potential career paths in Quality and manufacturing.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

The physical demands below represent those required to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Sit at a workstation and use a computer for extended periods.

  • Move throughout manufacturing areas to observe equipment, processes, and production activities.

  • Occasionally lift and carry tools, samples, or parts weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, and reach when observing equipment or components.

  • Review drawings, gauges, measurement equipment, and other visual information.

  • Wear required personal protective equipment, which may include safety glasses, hearing protection, and safety footwear.

  • Work in office and manufacturing environments where noise, temperature variation, and airborne particulates may be present.

What to Expect After Applying

Our hiring process includes an application, Criteria assessments, application and assessment review, a recruiter screen, and a 45-minute interview with the hiring team. Candidates selected for an offer receive a conditional offer followed by required pre-employment screening before hire.

This position requires a pre-employment drug screen after a conditional offer. A criminal background check may also be required, depending on the role. Screening and employment decisions are administered consistent with applicable law.

About MacLean-Fogg

MacLean-Fogg is a fourth-generation, family-owned American manufacturing company headquartered in Mundelein, Illinois. Founded in 1925, we design and manufacture engineered components and solutions for automotive and industrial markets.

Our portfolio includes MacLean-Fogg Component Solutions, OMCO, Mallard Manufacturing, and Threadstrong. Across our companies, we share a commitment to Safety, Integrity, People, Excellence, and Stewardship while investing in our people, manufacturing capabilities, customers, and communities.

Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodations

MacLean-Fogg and its affiliated companies are equal opportunity employers. We provide equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply, complete an assessment, or participate in the hiring process, contact careers@macleanfogg.com.

title: Truckmedarbejder til aftenhold søges i Ansager
description:
Vi søger en stabil og arbejdsom truckmedarbejder til et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat hos en fødevareproduktionsvirksomhed i Ansager.

Stillingen er med henblik på fastansættelse, og virksomheden ønsker gennem vikariatet at lære den rette medarbejder godt at kende. For den rette kandidat er der derfor gode muligheder for at blive en fast del af arbejdspladsen.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift i både produktionen og på lageret. En stor del af arbejdet består af at sørge for, at paller bliver håndteret og kørt fra produktionsområdet til lageret, men du skal også være indstillet på at hjælpe til med andre opgaver, når der er behov for det.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Palletering og truckkørsel fra produktionsbånd til lager

  • Truckkørsel og øvrige lageropgaver

  • Hjælp i produktionen samt betjening og pasning af maskiner

  • Andre praktiske og forefaldende opgaver i produktionen og på lageret

Arbejdet består i høj grad af faste og rutineprægede opgaver. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med en struktureret arbejdsdag, hvor mange af opgaverne gentager sig. Du skal kunne bevare fokus gennem hele vagten, arbejde selvstændigt og være god til selv at holde dig i gang.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du er stabil og ansvarsbevidst. Du møder til tiden, tager dine arbejdsopgaver seriøst og er ikke bange for at tage fat. Samtidig skal du være fleksibel og klar til at hjælpe til både på lageret og i produktionen.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har gyldigt truckcertifikat

  • Kan tale og forstå dansk

  • Er stabil, arbejdsom og møder til tiden

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Trives med faste og rutineprægede arbejdsopgaver

Har du erfaring fra lager, produktion eller fødevareindustrien, er det en fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at arbejde.

Arbejdstid: Mandag til torsdag kl. 13.30–22.45.

Arbejdssted: Ansager.

Opstart: Efter aftale.

Der er tale om et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Send dit CV til mo@teamly.dk og skriv “ANSAGER AFTEN” i emnefeltet.

Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende, så send gerne dit CV hurtigst muligt.

title: Client Service Representative
description:
Join the Team Reopening GoodNeighbor Vista Boulevard Animal Hospital


GoodNeighbor Vista Boulevard Animal Hospital is excited to reopen our veterinary hospital in Sparks, Nevada, with a planned opening in mid-November. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a fresh start, helping build a welcoming culture and exceptional client experience from day one.


We are seeking a compassionate, professional, and service-driven Client Service Representative (CSR) to join our team. As the first point of contact for our clients and patients, you will play a vital role in creating positive experiences, supporting our medical team, and helping establish the standard of care and hospitality that defines GoodNeighbor Vista Boulevard Animal Hospital.


Why This Opportunity Is Special

The reopening of GoodNeighbor Vista Boulevard Animal Hospital presents a rare opportunity to help shape the culture, client experience, and daily operations of a newly renovated hospital. As a founding team member, your contributions will have a lasting impact on our patients, clients, and community.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience, $14-17/hour
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Employee pet care discounts
  • Career growth opportunities within a growing veterinary organization
  • A collaborative, supportive, and team-focused work environment

What You'll Do


Client Experience

  • Deliver exceptional customer service and create welcoming experiences for every client and patient
  • Build lasting relationships with pet owners through empathy, professionalism, and effective communication
  • Assist clients with appointment scheduling, check-in, check-out, and follow-up communications
  • Address client questions and concerns with professionalism and compassion

Front Desk Operations

  • Connect patients with doctors and veterinary team members efficiently
  • Maintain accurate client and patient records
  • Process payments and financial transactions accurately
  • Manage phone calls, emails, and appointment requests
  • Support daily hospital operations and administrative tasks

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with veterinarians and support staff to ensure a seamless client experience
  • Help establish and uphold hospital standards, policies, and procedures
  • Contribute to a positive, supportive, and collaborative team culture
  • Adapt to the evolving needs of a growing hospital environment

What We're Looking For

  • 1-2 years' client service representative experience required, preferably within the animal health industry but not required
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to multitask and remain calm in a fast-paced and emotionally charged environment
  • Comfortable using computers, phone systems, and practice management software
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to teamwork
  • Passion for supporting pets, clients, and fellow team members

Be Part of Something New


If you're excited about helping launch a newly renovated veterinary hospital and creating exceptional experiences for pets and their families, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help us welcome the Sparks community back to GoodNeighbor Vista Boulevard Animal Hospital when we open our doors in mid-November.

title: Student Experience Associate – Mandarin-Speaking
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Student Experience Associate – Mandarin-Speaking based in India.

The Student Experience Associate will provide personalized support to Mandarin-speaking students and families throughout their academic journey.
You will build trusted relationships with students and parents, acting as a key point of contact for questions, guidance, and ongoing support.
The role combines student services, onboarding, administration, communication, and proactive problem-solving.
You will help tailor the student experience to the needs of Mandarin-speaking families and contribute to improvements for the Chinese market.
Working closely with academic, product, admissions, and sales teams, you will help resolve challenges and improve support processes.
The position requires strong empathy, organization, technological confidence, and the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
This is a full-time opportunity requiring availability Tuesday through Saturday, with working hours aligned to China Standard Time.

Accountabilities

  • Provide high-quality, personalized support to Mandarin-speaking students and parents, helping create positive academic outcomes and a strong overall student experience.

  • Respond promptly and effectively to student and family questions, providing solutions that consider individual goals, academic performance, and potential barriers.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with students and parents through regular check-ins and proactive communication.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact using communication channels such as WhatsApp, email, and Zoom.

  • Manage administrative processes including subject changes, withdrawals, and re-enrolments.

  • Maintain accurate information across administrative and educational systems and become proficient in the tools required to support students effectively.

  • Lead and continuously improve student and parent onboarding processes.

  • Organize orientation sessions for new students and conduct check-in calls with students and families throughout the academic year.

  • Adapt onboarding and orientation processes for Mandarin-speaking families and the Chinese market, incorporating feedback from families and internal teams.

  • Collaborate with academic, product, admissions, sales, and other teams to identify and resolve student-related challenges.

  • Contribute to projects and initiatives designed to improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of student support systems.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and proactively contribute ideas that enhance the student and family experience.

    • Requirements

    • Fluent written and spoken Mandarin and English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with students, parents, and internal stakeholders.

    • Genuine enthusiasm for supporting students and families throughout their academic journey.

    • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport, trust, and productive relationships with diverse stakeholders.

    • Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a practical, solution-focused approach to student and family needs.

    • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

    • Strong adaptability and a willingness to learn new systems, processes, and technologies quickly.

    • High level of technological confidence and ability to work effectively with online administrative and educational platforms.

    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and effective time-management abilities.

    • Ability to remain calm and resilient when handling competing priorities, challenging situations, or periods of high workload.

    • Empathetic and student-focused approach, with the ability to understand different perspectives and provide thoughtful support.

    • Collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and willingness to work across teams and functions.

    • High degree of flexibility and comfort adapting to changing processes, priorities, and student needs.

    • Availability to work full-time, 40 hours per week, Tuesday through Saturday from 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM GMT+8 / China Standard Time, plus availability for one additional meeting per week outside these hours to accommodate international team collaboration.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment.

      • Full-time position with a 40-hour working week.

      • Opportunity to support students and families across international markets.

      • Direct involvement in improving the experience of Mandarin-speaking students and families.

      • Opportunity to collaborate with academic, product, admissions, sales, and other international teams.

      • Exposure to education technology, digital learning systems, and globally distributed operations.

      • Role with meaningful responsibility for student satisfaction, engagement, and academic support.

      • Flexible remote environment designed to support collaboration across multiple time zones.

      • Opportunity to contribute to the development and localization of student support processes for the Chinese market.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman / Crew Leader Job Description


Job Summary

The Foreman/Crew Leader is a working leader responsible for supervising a 2–4 person crew on commercial fence installation projects. This role combines hands on installation work with daily leadership, planning, and oversight responsibilities. The Foreman ensures projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to company quality standards while maintaining strong communication with management and developing the skills of crew members.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Superintendent, Production Manager, and/or Project Manager to understand project scope, timelines, and potential issues
  • Demonstrate expert knowledge of materials, tools, and installation methods for all common fence types
  • Lead, supervise, and direct crew members, assigning tasks and sequencing work to maximize efficiency
  • Plan daily tasks and workflow to align with overall project schedules
  • Inspect work performed by the crew and provide constructive feedback
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe job site at all times
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, including safety rules, drug free workplace standards, cell phone usage, and accurate timekeeping
  • Oversee proper operation, inspection, and maintenance of tools, equipment, and vehicles
  • Maintain a clean, well organized work truck and ensure crew members respect company equipment
  • Manage safe and efficient storage of materials on the truck or at the job site
  • Communicate regularly with the Superintendent and/or Production Manager regarding progress and unexpected issues
  • Track inventory of supplies and expendable materials; request additional materials as needed
  • Provide input during project planning when requested
  • Ensure efficient loading, travel, and arrival to and from job sites
  • Complete projects within allotted timeframes and without callbacks
  • Organize and lead job layout, material staging, and unloading
  • Demonstrate pride in workmanship and openness to guidance and feedback
  • Promote teamwork, cooperation, and respect among crew members
  • Train, mentor, and motivate crew members to build a productive and skilled team
  • Model reliability, professionalism, and consistent effort, representing the company positively with or without supervision


Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of fence installation experience
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Physical strength, coordination, and endurance to perform daily installation tasks
  • Ability to lift 50+ lbs. consistently
  • Professional demeanor, integrity, and reliability
  • Valid driver’s license required (CDL preferred)


Physical Demands

  • Employees must be able to talk and hear regularly, use hands and fingers to operate tools, and stand, walk, kneel, squat, and reach for extended periods.
  • Occasional lifting or moving of 50+ pounds is required.
  • Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.


Work Environment

  • Work is performed around moving mechanical parts and may involve exposure to moderate noise, fumes, or airborne particles.
  • Tasks may occur outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

title: Care Advocate
description:
Seven Starling is a leading virtual provider of women's behavioral health services supporting every stage of motherhood. Seven Starling's holistic clinical model combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat common perinatal mood disorders like postpartum depression and anxiety, with 94% of patients seeing a clinically significant improvement in their symptoms after completing the program. Seven Starling partners with OBGYN clinics across the country and leading health plans including UnitedHealthCare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna to make care easily accessible and affordable.

Position Overview

Seven Starling is looking to add a world-class Care Advocate to join our Care Support team. Our ideal candidate is an experienced support professional who is passionate about improving women’s mental health outcomes, and is energized by the opportunity to ensure our patients receive compassionate and effective mental health care and our clinicians treating them receive world class support. You will excel in this role if you have a strong attention to detail, love staying organized, enjoy learning new systems and tools, have experience in high-volume settings, and are skilled at developing and implementing scalable processes that help our operations run efficiently.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and providers, addressing their questions, concerns, and needs in a professional and empathetic manner.

  • Assist with scheduling and rescheduling patient appointments to maximize patient engagement and success, including managing conflicts and optimizing appointment schedules.

  • Maintain accurate patient records and documentation, ensuring data is up-to-date and compliant with privacy regulations.

  • Assist in the resolution of patient or provider issues or complaints, escalating more complex concerns to the appropriate team members or supervisors.

  • Serve as the “voice of the patient”, keeping a close eye on data and trends from your support work and surfacing learnings to the appropriate team members or supervisors.

  • Provide support to patients and providers navigating the healthcare system, including explaining procedures, insurance processes, and available resources.

  • Coordinate care activities, including follow-up appointments, outside referrals, and coordination with other healthcare providers as needed.

  • Collaborate with healthcare professionals and administrative staff to ensure seamless patient care and communication.

  • Participate in ongoing training and development to stay current with best practices and organizational changes.

  • Propose updates to key processes as needed to maintain them.

Who you are

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a patient support, customer service, or healthcare-related role.

  • Experience in a remote work environment.

  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, especially in a high-volume setting. Strong attention to detail.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact effectively with patients, families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.

  • Proficiency in using standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).

  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to patient support.

  • High school diploma or equivalent; additional coursework in healthcare administration or a related field is a plus.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive paid time off

  • Competitive parental leave and return to work policy

  • One-time stipend to enhance your work from home experience

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401K

  • Annual stipend for your choice of wellness benefits

  • Annual professional development stipend

  • Virtual team events

title: Demonstrador de Software
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Demonstrador de Software based in Brazil.

This role is central to the software sales process, helping prospective and existing customers understand how project solutions can support their business. You will demonstrate software solutions designed for the furniture industry, both remotely and in person. The position combines product knowledge, customer engagement, technical preparation, and needs assessment. You will help prospects explore relevant functionalities, answer questions, and provide technical insights throughout the sales and post-sales journey. The role also involves preparing demonstration environments, training materials, and technical briefings that support commercial teams. It offers an opportunity to work closely with customers and sales professionals in a collaborative, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Prepare demonstration environments, including computers, systems, databases, and other resources required for successful presentations.
  • Demonstrate project and design software solutions to furniture-industry customers through remote and in-person sessions.
  • Explain product functionalities, answer customer questions, and provide technical support throughout demonstrations and post-sales activities.
  • Complete demonstration reports after each presentation to ensure customer and activity records remain accurate and up to date.
  • Develop training materials and resources to support the commercial team.
  • Prepare technical briefs that help Sales Executives develop accurate and relevant commercial proposals.
  • Conduct customer and prospect discovery sessions to diagnose needs, understand requirements, and identify appropriate solutions.
  • Provide technical support and product expertise to the commercial team whenever required.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of furniture-industry processes to ensure demonstrations are relevant to customer workflows and business needs.
